title: Define when eligible products may remain available on backorder
scenarioDescription: A merchant wants to keep taking orders on items waiting for restock, but only where the supplier can deliver by the promised date. In this case, the immediate task is to define when eligible products may remain available on backorder. The workflow should produce an item-by-item decision plus the wording that must appear at checkout for anything kept on sale.
howToSolve: Review, per product waiting on replenishment, the sellable quantity and the committed stock, the supplier's confirmed replenishment date with their record of meeting past dates, the inbound quantity already on a purchase order, and the delivery promise the merchant states for that product's destination. Decide item by item that a product may stay purchasable only where a confirmed replenishment date exists, the supplier's record supports it and the date lands inside the promise made to the customer, set the quantity exposed to no more than the inbound quantity on record, and hold every product failing one of those tests with the failed condition named. Deliver a backorder policy listing each product with its decision, the exposed quantity, the expected ship date and the condition that would reverse the decision, give the exact checkout wording each approved product must carry including the expected ship timing, and check that every product left on sale has that wording attached in the supplied channel settings.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [sellable and committed quantities per product awaiting replenishment, supplier replenishment dates with their past reliability record, inbound purchase order quantities, and the delivery promise stated per destination]. Decide item by item that a product may stay purchasable only where a confirmed replenishment date exists, the supplier's record supports it and the date lands inside the promise made to the customer, set the quantity exposed to no more than the inbound quantity on record, and hold every product failing one of those tests with the failed condition named. Return a backorder policy with eligible items and customer wording for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: When may a product stay on sale with no stock?
faqs.answer: When a confirmed replenishment date exists, the supplier has met dates before, and that date still lands inside the promise made to the customer, with anything short of all three held. A supplier's verbal estimate with no date on record does not qualify.

faqs.question: What must the customer see before paying?
faqs.answer: The expected ship timing the merchant states for that product, shown at checkout and in the confirmation, because silence about delay is what turns a backorder into a complaint. Where a channel cannot display it, the product is held rather than sold.

faqs.question: Should the backorder quantity be capped?
faqs.answer: Yes, at the inbound quantity already on a purchase order, so sales cannot exceed what is arriving. Unlimited backorders build a queue the supplier may not fill, and the cap is raised only when a further confirmed receipt is recorded.

zh_faqs.question: 什么情况下缺货商品可以继续售卖？

zh_faqs.question: 客户付款前必须看到什么？

zh_faqs.question: 预售数量需要设上限吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 需要，上限为采购单上已有的在途数量，这样售出量不会超过实际到货量；不设上限会堆出供应商未必能填完的订单队列。只有当记录中新增了一笔已确认收货，才可以上调上限。

faqs.question: How do you tell whether a product qualifies for a new tag?
faqs.answer: Each approved label in the vocabulary carries attribute conditions, such as product type or a required option, and a product qualifies only when its record satisfies every condition; products missing the attribute are flagged instead of receiving the label, because a tag applied without its condition would silently pull wrong items into the collection.

faqs.question: Why record the tag set before the change?
faqs.answer: The before state is what makes the addition reviewable and reversible; if a collection later matches more products than expected, the recorded prior tags show whether the new label or an unintended match caused the drift.

faqs.question: What does the final check compare?
faqs.answer: The delivered table is reconciled against the storefront by confirming that products marked as tagged now match the target collection filter and that products listed as skipped still carry their original tag sets; any mismatch between table and filter means an edit landed on the wrong identifier.

zh_howToSolve: 收集所选商品组内每件商品的标识符与现有标签集、附带各标签属性条件的已批准标签词表，以及将要使用这些新标签的系列规则。仅为属性满足条件的商品追加已批准标签，保留所有无关的既有标签，并标记缺少必需属性或属性冲突的商品，避免标签把错误的商品带进系列。输出逐件列出标识符、变更前标签、新增标签与变更后标签的对照表，再核对每件带新标签的商品都能命中目标系列筛选条件，且未改动商品数量与原本已有该标签的商品数一致。

zh_faqs.question: 如何判断一件商品是否符合新标签的添加条件？
zh_faqs.answer: 词表中每个已批准标签都带有属性条件，例如商品类型或必需选项，只有记录同时满足全部条件才可加标签；缺少该属性的商品会被标记而非直接打标，因为不满足条件就加标签会把错误的商品悄悄带进系列。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要记录变更前的标签状态？
zh_faqs.answer: 变更前状态让新增可复核也可回退；如果之后系列匹配到的商品比预期多，对照先前记录的标签即可判断是新标签造成还是误匹配导致。

zh_faqs.question: 最终核对要比较什么？
zh_faqs.answer: 把交付的对照表与店铺前台核对，确认表中标记为已加标签的商品确实命中目标系列筛选条件，被跳过的商品仍保留原有标签集；表与筛选结果不一致说明编辑落到了错误的标识上。

The workflow should produce a reversible removal list naming the dependent collections and filters, with the resulting tag state for each product.
howToSolve: Gather the products in the requested scope with their complete tag sets, the exact tags scheduled for retirement, and every collection, saved filter, navigation item and automation that references those tags by name. Delete only the listed tags from each product in scope, preserving every other label exactly, and for each dependent workflow record whether it becomes empty, falls back to another condition, or needs a merchant decision before the tag disappears. Deliver a reversible removal list showing each product's tag set before and after plus the affected workflows with their dependency status, then verify after applying that the removed tags no longer match any storefront filter and the untouched tags still resolve to their original product groups.

faqs.question: How are dependent collections handled during removal?
faqs.answer: Each dependent workflow is listed with its fallback behaviour before any tag is deleted; a collection that would become empty or a filter that would match nothing is escalated for a merchant decision, because removing a depended-upon tag silently reshapes the storefront.

faqs.question: Why capture the full tag set and not just the removed tag?
faqs.answer: Restoring the retired label later requires knowing which of its products also carried other tags at removal time, and the full per-product snapshot is also the evidence that unrelated labels survived the batch unchanged.

faqs.question: How do you confirm unrelated tags were untouched?
faqs.answer: After applying, re-export the tag sets and compare them against the before column of the removal list product by product; every non-target label must resolve to the same product group it matched before the change, and any difference marks an edit that exceeded its scope.

zh_faqs.question: 移除标签时如何处理依赖它的系列？

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要记录完整标签集而不只记被删标签？
zh_faqs.answer: 日后恢复停用标签时，需要知道删除时哪些商品还带有其他标签；逐件的完整快照也是证明无关标签在批次中未被改动的证据。

zh_faqs.question: 怎样确认无关标签未被误改？

title: Replace selected description content using a verified template
scenarioDescription: Only some paragraphs must match an approved template; the sections carrying product-specific facts have to stay as they are. In this case, the immediate task is to replace selected description content using a verified template. The workflow should produce an updated copy set with the replaced ranges marked, verified against the merchant's records.
howToSolve: Identify the products in scope by identifier, the exact description blocks scheduled for replacement such as shared care or shipping wording, and the approved template text with its variable slots. Apply the template only to the selected blocks while leaving product-specific fact sections character-for-character untouched, filling each variable slot from the product's record and flagging any slot the record cannot supply. Deliver the updated copy set with replaced ranges marked, the prior text preserved per product for rollback, and a verification pass confirming that only scoped blocks changed and every unchanged section matches its pre-edit version.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Apply the template only to the selected blocks while leaving product-specific fact sections character-for-character untouched, filling each variable slot from the product's record and flagging any slot the record cannot supply. Return an updated copy set with the replaced ranges marked, verified against the merchant's records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is the untouched scope proven?
faqs.answer: The verification pass compares every non-target section against its pre-edit copy character by character and reports only the scoped blocks as changed; a single difference outside the marked ranges means the replacement bled into product facts and the batch must be stopped.

faqs.question: What fills the template's variable slots?
faqs.answer: Values come only from each product's record, and a slot with no matching field is flagged and left unfilled rather than defaulted, because an invented value in shared boilerplate propagates across the whole batch at once.

faqs.question: When is the rollback copy used?
faqs.answer: The preserved prior text is restored if the new template wording proves inaccurate or the merchant withdraws approval, and it also serves as the baseline for the change report's before column.

zh_faqs.question: 如何证明范围外内容未被改动？

zh_faqs.question: 模板变量槽位由什么填充？

zh_faqs.question: 回滚文本什么时候使用？

title: Diagnose product CSV import failures by row and field
scenarioDescription: An import was rejected and the error report does not say which row or field caused each failure. In this case, the immediate task is to diagnose product CSV import failures by row and field. The workflow should produce a corrected sample plus a per-row exception list, with each message traced back to the merchant's own file.
howToSolve: Collect the rejected file exactly as uploaded, the error report returned, its header row as it stood at upload, the identifier column, and any rows the merchant knows were written before the failure. Attach each message to a specific row and column by reading the reported position against that header, classify it as structural — a wrong column name, a bad delimiter, an unexpected encoding — or as value-level on one field, and propose the narrowest correction that clears the message without touching cells that were already valid. Deliver a corrected sample containing one row of each error class plus a per-row exception list naming row, field, message, class and proposed fix, then re-run only that sample, reconcile corrected, still-failing and already-written rows against the original file, and state which rows must not be sent again.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me diagnose product CSV import failures by row and field. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the rejected file as uploaded, the returned error report, the header row as it stood at upload, the identifier column, and the rows known to have been written before the failure]. Attach each message to a specific row and column by reading the reported position against that header, classify it as structural — a wrong column name, a bad delimiter, an unexpected encoding — or as value-level on one field, and propose the narrowest correction that clears the message without touching cells that were already valid. Return a corrected sample plus a per-row exception list for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How do you tell a structural fault from a value fault?
faqs.answer: A structural fault repeats across many rows and follows a column, such as every row tripping on one header or parsing one field short; a value fault names individual cells. Structure is fixed first because it often clears dozens of messages at once, so messages are grouped by column before any cell is edited.

faqs.question: Should the whole file be re-uploaded?
faqs.answer: Rarely. Re-sending it uncorrected repeats every failure and duplicates rows already written, which is why rows created before the failure get identified first. Only corrected rows and previously rejected rows go back, and the result is reconciled against the run record rather than the file as originally sent.

faqs.question: Why re-run on a sample rather than the full file?
faqs.answer: A sample holding one row per error class proves each fix works while risking very few writes, and it yields a clean report to compare against. Uploading everything first makes every remaining failure look identical to the original rejection, with no way to tell which correction failed.

zh_title: 按行与字段定位商品 CSV 导入失败原因

zh_howToSolve: 收集被拒收文件的上传原件、系统返回的报错报告、上传当时的表头行、标识符所在列，以及商家已知在失败前就已写入的行。把每条报错对照该表头读取其报告位置，挂到具体的行与列上，并分类为结构性问题，例如列名有误、分隔符错误、编码不符，或某个字段上的取值问题，随后给出能清除该报错、又不改动原本合法单元格的最小修正。输出包含每类错误各一行的修正样例，以及注明行号、字段、报错原文、类别与建议修正的逐行例外清单；然后只对这份样例重跑，把已修正、仍然失败与失败前已写入的行数与原文件核对，并说明哪些行不得再次发送。

zh_faqs.question: 如何区分结构性问题和取值问题？

zh_faqs.question: 整份文件需要重新上传吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 通常不必。未修正就重发会重复每一次失败，并让已经写入的行重复创建，这也是为什么要先识别失败前已写入的行。只需把已修正的行和此前被拒的行发回去，并以运行台账而非最初发送的文件为基准核对结果。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么先重跑样例而不是整份文件？
zh_faqs.answer: 每类错误各取一行的样例，既能验证每项修正生效，又把写入风险压到极低，还能产出一份干净的报告用于比对。若先整份上传，任何残留的失败都与最初的拒收看起来毫无差别，根本分不清是哪一处修正没起作用。

faqs.question: Can the hierarchy deviate per product?

faqs.question: What if the theme cannot reorder a section?

faqs.question: How is a question marked partial?

faqs.question: Can one checklist serve the whole catalog?
faqs.answer: It works as a base of universally essential questions, but each product adds its own from its specification and support record, since sizing, compatibility and care questions differ; reusing the base without extension is what let pages ship with unexplained terms.

zh_faqs.question: 一份检查表能覆盖整个目录吗？

faqs.question: How is a rounding difference told from a real error?
faqs.answer: A difference within the rounding step the merchant has stated, appearing on every variant alike, is expected behaviour and should be recorded rather than fixed. A single variant off by more points at one specific field.

faqs.question: Should a compare-at price be checked against the same rule?
faqs.answer: No, it is a reference figure and may legitimately sit above the price. Check only that it stays higher than the current price and that nothing renders where the record leaves it empty.

faqs.question: What if the storefront and the record agree but both look wrong?
faqs.answer: The fault is then in the data rather than the display, so raise it as a price error against the record. Fixing the template in that case hides the wrong figure behind a render that now looks correct.

faqs.question: What hides a variant that exists in the catalog?
faqs.answer: An option value that no longer matches, a variant left unpublished, or zero availability. Check each in turn because the fixes differ: realign the value, publish the variant, or restock it.

faqs.question: How is an unclear option label identified?
faqs.answer: A label a buyer cannot map to a recorded value, such as two options sharing a name or one value written in different casing. Test it by asking which catalog value the label actually selects.

faqs.question: Should option names change as part of the fix?
faqs.answer: Only with the merchant agreement, because renaming breaks saved links and historical reporting. Where a rename is approved, keep the old value working as an alias during the transition.

zh_faqs.question: 如何判断一个选项标签含糊？

zh_faqs.question: 修复时可以顺带调整选项名称吗？

faqs.question: Why attribute one cause at a time?
faqs.answer: Because heavy files, delivery conditions and page behaviour all produce the same visible delay, and a combined diagnosis hides which fix actually works; each finding names the single cause the request-level measurement supports, so the fix can be tested on its own.

faqs.question: How is compression decided per image?
faqs.answer: By the placement each file serves: hero images keep more quality because they face the buyer full-size, while thumbnails can be compressed harder; the rule follows the stated placement rather than applying one compression level across the gallery.

faqs.question: How is improvement proven?
faqs.answer: The same image request is measured again after the change and compared with the baseline recorded in the collection step; a finding closes only when the re-measurement shows the delay removed, not when the file has merely been edited.

scenarioDescription: Shoppers report the button does nothing on specific product pages, and the affected URLs, variants, devices and error evidence are on hand. In this case, the immediate task is to diagnose a failing add-to-cart interaction. The workflow should separate stock or script faults from a poorly placed control and give a retest checklist.

Reproduce the interaction on the recorded variant and device where access allows and classify each case by evidence, as an availability or selling-plan block when the variant is unsellable or requires a plan, as a script or network failure when the request errors or never leaves the page, and as a placement or confirmation problem only when the request succeeds and the cart updates but the shopper saw no feedback. Deliver the diagnosis naming the class of every reported case with the evidence behind it plus a retest checklist, then verify it by confirming that each case falls into exactly one class and that any case left unclassified is listed with what is still needed to decide.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the affected product URLs and handles, the variant selected in each report, the reported device and browser, the shopper's signed-in state, and any captured console, network or order evidence]. Reproduce the interaction on the recorded variant and device where access allows and classify each case by evidence, as an availability or selling-plan block when the variant is unsellable or requires a plan, as a script or network failure when the request errors or never leaves the page, and as a placement or confirmation problem only when the request succeeds and the cart updates but the shopper saw no feedback. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is a stock problem told apart from a script failure?
faqs.answer: By where the request stops: if the variant is unsellable or needs a selling plan the control is disabled or the request is refused before any error appears, while a script failure shows a request that errors or never leaves the page. A request that succeeds and adds the line points instead at confirmation the theme never showed.

faqs.question: What if the fault cannot be reproduced?
faqs.answer: The case stays on the checklist as unclassified, recorded with the variant, device and time reported, because intermittent script loading, network conditions and session state can fail once and still be real. It is retested after any related change rather than closed for lack of a second sighting.

faqs.question: Why check the cart state as well as the click?
faqs.answer: A click can register while the cart drawer shows nothing, so the shopper experiences a dead button even though the line was added. Confirming cart contents after the click separates a control that truly failed from a confirmation the theme never displayed.

zh_faqs.question: 库存问题和脚本故障如何区分？

zh_faqs.question: 问题复现不出来怎么办？

zh_faqs.question: 为什么除了点击还要检查购物车状态？

faqs.question: What turns a small control into a blocking fault?
faqs.answer: Being unreachable or covered at the moment of the tap, for instance beneath a sticky cart bar or behind a consent banner, is blocking. A control that is merely small or close to its neighbour is friction, and the two are listed separately because only the first stops the purchase outright.

faqs.question: Why test after scrolling rather than only at page load?
faqs.answer: Sticky headers and cart bars shift and overlay the control as the page moves, so a control clear on load can be covered once the shopper reaches the buy area. The retest walks the real path from the product image to confirmation instead of inspecting a static screenshot.

faqs.question: Is an emulator enough for the mobile check?
faqs.answer: It shows layout and overlap but not touch behaviour, autofill or the mobile keyboard, so emulator findings are confirmed on at least one real device per reported viewport. Where no real device is available, that limitation is written on the finding instead of presenting it as verified.

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要在滚动之后测试，而不只看页面刚加载时？
zh_faqs.answer: 吸顶导航和购物车栏会随页面滚动而移动并覆盖控件，因此加载时畅通的控件可能在买家滑到购买区时被挡住。复测要走从商品图到确认反馈的真实路径，而不是只看一张静态截图。

zh_faqs.question: 移动端检查只用模拟器够吗？

zh_howToSolve: 列出页面上现有全部信任标识，再收集可能支撑它们书面记录，如证书、保障条款、支付方式确认和平台政策页面，并注明每个标识要化解的买家顾虑。只保留有记录支撑的标识并让每个标识与对应顾虑配对，无来源的徽标一律移除或替换，并记录每次移除的原因。交付通过审核的标识清单及其摆放位置、每个徽标的来源记录和移除日志，再在发布前核实每个在用标识都指向当前有效、未过期的记录。

zh_faqs.question: 竞品在用的标识我们可以照搬吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不可以。每个标识都要对应商家真实持有的安排，缺乏支撑的图标等于陈述了关于店铺的不实内容。竞品页面不能作为商家自身资质的证据。

zh_faqs.question: 标识能替代文字版的政策吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不能。徽标只表明政策存在，却不承载任何条款，买家仍需通过链接文字了解条件、时限和除外情形。每个徽标都要与它的来源文件配对保留。

zh_faqs.question: 一个页面应该放几个信任标识？
zh_faqs.answer: 只放真正能回应已记录顾虑的那几个，一排缺乏解释的图标终会沦为装饰。若相邻的配送或退货文案已经解答了该顾虑，重复的徽标并无增益。

title: Present genuine reviews and other supported social proof
scenarioDescription: Reviews and usage evidence exist but sit in one block at the bottom, far from the doubts that stop an order. In this case, the immediate task is to present genuine reviews and other supported social proof. The workflow should produce the selected proof with suggested placements and sources, matched to where each hesitation occurs on the page.
howToSolve: Collect the genuine reviews with their dates and verified status, the rating distribution, and any usage evidence such as customer photos or purchase counts, together with the page positions where buyer hesitations actually occur. Select proof items that speak to each hesitation, keeping a balanced mix that includes critical reviews, and trim only for length so neither meaning nor emphasis departs from the original wording. Deliver the selected proof with its suggested placement next to the hesitation it addresses plus its source and date, then verify each displayed item exists in the records word for word and the selection is not exclusively positive.

faqs.question: Can reviews be edited to read better?
faqs.answer: They can be trimmed for length with ellipses, but not reworded, reordered to shift emphasis, or condensed into prose that alters the rating. The displayed text must match the stored review, because the page is quoting a customer, not writing marketing copy.

faqs.question: Should only positive reviews be shown?
faqs.answer: No. A selection that includes critical reviews is more credible, and complaints often answer the exact hesitation blocking other buyers. Exclude a review only for relevance or verified-policy reasons, never for its rating.

faqs.question: Where should social proof sit?
faqs.answer: Next to the hesitation it addresses, such as sizing doubt near the size selector or durability doubt near the specifications. Pooling all proof into one bottom block leaves those questions unanswered at the moment they arise.

zh_faqs.question: 评价可以改得更通顺吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 可以删减篇幅并加省略号，但不能改写措辞、调整顺序改变强调点，或改写成偏离评分的概括。展示文字必须与留存的评价逐字一致，因为页面是在引用顾客，而不是写营销文案。

zh_faqs.question: 只展示好评合适吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不合适。含批评评价的组合更可信，而且抱怨往往恰好回答了其他买家下单前的顾虑。剔除评价只能基于相关性或核实政策，绝不能因为评分低而删。

zh_faqs.question: 口碑佐证应该放在哪里？
zh_faqs.answer: 紧邻它回应的顾虑，比如尺码疑虑放在尺码选择器旁，耐用性疑虑放在规格旁。把所有佐证堆进页面底部一个大块，会让疑问产生的那一刻得不到回答。

title: Measure conversion performance for individual product pages
scenarioDescription: Some product pages sell well while others barely convert, but the two were never compared on one basis. The task is to measure page performance using sessions that view a page and subsequently purchase its product within that session. The workflow produces per-page viewing and purchasing session counts, rates and an experiment backlog, while keeping overlapping page audiences separate from distinct store orders.
howToSolve: Collect timestamped product-page views and purchase events with session identifiers, product identifiers and order identifiers for one merchant-defined window, deduplicating views to one per page per session and excluding sessions whose observation period is incomplete. For each page, divide sessions that viewed that page and subsequently purchased its product within the same session by sessions that viewed that page, counting each qualifying session once per page and reporting pages below the merchant's minimum session count with raw counts only. Deliver the page-session counts, qualifying purchase-session counts, rates and experiment backlog, verify each numerator is a subset of its denominator, reconcile distinct linked orders against the order export, and explain that page totals overlap and must not be summed as store orders.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me measure conversion performance for individual product pages. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [timestamped product-page and purchase events with session, product and order identifiers, the reporting window, and the merchant's minimum session count]. For each page, divide sessions that viewed that page and subsequently purchased its product within the same session by sessions that viewed that page, counting each qualifying session once per page and reporting pages below the merchant's minimum session count with raw counts only. Deliver the page-session counts, qualifying purchase-session counts, rates and experiment backlog, verify each numerator is a subset of its denominator, reconcile distinct linked orders against the order export, and explain that page totals overlap and must not be summed as store orders for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is a page-level rate computed?
faqs.answer: Use purchasing sessions divided by viewing sessions for that page, requiring the view to precede purchase of its product in the same session. Count each qualifying session once per page; orders without a linked page view do not enter the numerator.

faqs.question: How are repeat views and cross-page browsing counted?
faqs.answer: Count one view per page per session, so reloads do not inflate that page's denominator. A session can qualify for several pages, so page counts overlap and their sum must not be reconciled to the store's distinct order count.

faqs.question: When is a page treated as low-traffic?
faqs.answer: Apply the merchant's minimum viewing-session count and show raw counts below it without ranking. Exclude sessions whose observation period is incomplete, and mark rates unverified if session-level view-to-purchase links cannot be supplied.

zh_title: 衡量单个商品页的转化表现
zh_scenarioDescription: 有些商品页明显能卖，有些几乎不出单，却从未按同一口径比较。本场景用浏览该页并在同一会话内随后购买对应商品的会话来衡量表现，产出逐页浏览会话数、购买会话数、转化率与实验待办，并将页面间交叠的受众与全店去重订单分开核对。
zh_howToSolve: 收集商家指定窗口内带时间戳的商品页浏览与购买事件，以及会话标识、商品标识和订单标识；浏览按每会话每页一次去重，观察期尚未结束的会话暂不纳入统计。对每个页面，以浏览该页的会话数为分母，以同一会话内先浏览该页、后购买对应商品的会话数为分子，每会话每页最多计一次；低于商家最低会话数门槛的页面仅展示原始计数。交付页面会话数、购买会话数、转化率与实验待办，核实每页分子属于分母集合，并将去重后的关联订单与订单导出核对；说明不同页面的会话与订单可能重叠，不能把页面计数相加当作全店订单。

zh_faqs.question: 页面级转化率应如何计算？
zh_faqs.answer: 分母为浏览该页的会话数，分子为同会话内先浏览该页再购买对应商品的会话数，每会话每页只计一次；无法关联到该页浏览的订单不能计入分子。

zh_faqs.question: 重复浏览和跨页浏览怎么计数？
zh_faqs.answer: 同一会话中每页只计一次浏览，刷新不增加分母；一个会话可以属于多个页面，因此页面计数存在交叠，不能将其合计与全店去重订单总数要求相等。

zh_faqs.question: 什么情况下页面按低流量处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 采用商家给定的最低浏览会话数，低于门槛只列原始计数、不排名；观察尚未结束的会话暂不纳入，缺少会话级浏览到购买关联时标注转化率未验证。

title: Build a prioritized store conversion improvement workflow
scenarioDescription: A long list of improvement ideas has accumulated, but nothing in it says which item should be done first or why. In this case, the immediate task is to build a prioritized store conversion improvement workflow. The workflow should produce a conversion diagnosis and experiment backlog, ordered by a priority rule the merchant's own records can support.
howToSolve: Collect every candidate improvement with the records it rests on, including the page or segment, the counts observed and the period they cover, together with the effort and owner the merchant assigns, the metric each change would move, the traffic volume available to test it, the stated priority rule, and any items already in progress. Score each candidate with that one rule only, comparing evidence strength against the effort recorded, and mark as unranked any item whose evidence cannot be recomputed from the supplied records or whose traffic is below the merchant's stated minimum for a test, listing those with raw counts instead of a rank. Deliver a conversion diagnosis and an experiment backlog ordered by that rule, each entry carrying its evidence, its success and guardrail metric, its owner and the record it can be checked against, then reconcile the backlog count with the candidate list the merchant submitted and note every item whose rank rests on a definition differing from the store-wide rate.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me build a prioritized store conversion improvement workflow. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [each candidate improvement with its supporting page or segment counts and period, the merchant-assigned effort and owner, the metric each change would move, the testable traffic volume, the stated priority rule, and the items already in progress]. Score each candidate with that one rule only, comparing evidence strength against the effort recorded, and mark as unranked any item whose evidence cannot be recomputed from the supplied records or whose traffic is below the merchant's stated minimum for a test, listing those with raw counts instead of a rank. Return a conversion diagnosis and experiment backlog with every priority verified against the merchant's records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: What evidence must back a candidate change?
faqs.answer: Each item must point to a record the merchant holds, such as the counts for the page or segment it concerns, the period those counts cover and the metric it would move. Evidence is what makes the ranking defensible rather than a matter of taste; an idea traced only to a preference is listed as unevidenced and is not ranked.

faqs.question: How is effort recorded for each item?
faqs.answer: Effort is recorded in the terms the merchant uses, naming the owner, the work involved and whether the change can be tested on a subset of traffic. Recording it this way keeps the rule reproducible when the backlog is reviewed later; where effort is unknown, the item is marked as unestimated and ranked after the items with a recorded effort.

faqs.question: What happens to ideas with no supporting records?
faqs.answer: They are listed in a separate section with the reason, rather than dropped or ranked by enthusiasm. Such ideas often become testable once tracking covers the step they concern, so keeping them visible preserves them; they enter the ranked backlog only once a record can be produced for them.

zh_faqs.question: 候选改动需要什么证据支撑？

zh_faqs.question: 每个条目的工作量如何记录？

zh_faqs.question: 没有记录支撑的想法怎么处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 它们被单独列在一节里并写明原因，既不丢弃，也不按热情高低排序。这类想法往往在补齐相关环节的追踪之后就变得可测，保留可见性很重要；只有当能拿出对应记录时，它们才进入正式排序的待办清单。

faqs.question: How is the journey divided into steps?
faqs.answer: The journey is divided wherever the shopper must act to continue, such as selecting a variant, entering an address or choosing a payment method, and every step is written down before any counts are pulled. Fixed boundaries keep the audit repeatable; steps with no recorded event are marked as unmeasured instead of being filled with an estimate.

faqs.question: When is a friction point called confirmed?
faqs.answer: A friction point is confirmed only when a record supports it, meaning the step counts for the period show the loss, or a condition such as an error is documented. Confirmation is about evidence, not severity; a step that feels slow but shows no loss is reported as a hypothesis with the record that would test it.

faqs.question: Where do hypotheses go in the report?
faqs.answer: Hypotheses are listed in their own section with the observation behind them and the record that would confirm or drop them, never mixed into the supported findings. Keeping them apart protects the ranked list from opinion; once the merchant adds the missing tracking for that step, a hypothesis can be retested and moved across.

zh_faqs.question: 假设在报告中放在哪里？

faqs.question: How are visits that never reach a product identified?
faqs.answer: A session is counted as not reaching a product when its event records contain no product view anywhere in the window, so landing on a blog post and leaving counts as well. This keeps the diagnosis on the merchant's records rather than on figures from another tool; sessions with incomplete event records are listed as unmeasured.

faqs.question: Should traffic sources be compared on their own?
faqs.answer: Yes. faqs.question: How is the earlier window chosen?
faqs.answer: The comparison window should be one the merchant can reproduce from the same records, and it is recorded alongside the result. zh_faqs.question: 如何识别从未触达商品的访问？

faqs.question: When is a page too small to judge?
faqs.answer: When its view count sits below the merchant's stated minimum for the period, in which case the page is reported as insufficiently measured rather than weak. A rate built on few views moves with a handful of sessions and sends the operator after a cause that is only noise.

faqs.question: Why check the traffic source before the page content?
faqs.answer: A change in campaign or source mix can bring visitors with weaker purchase intent, which lowers the rate on a page that has not changed at all. Comparing the source split with earlier periods tells you whether the page or the audience moved before any content is rewritten.

faqs.question: What proves the identified cause was the real one?
faqs.answer: A stated check that would fail if the cause were something else, such as restored availability lifting additions on a blocked variant, or the absence of any added line in the cart showing a control fault. Naming that check lets the fix be confirmed rather than assumed.

faqs.question: Should losses be ranked by rate or by volume?
faqs.answer: By the number of sessions lost, because a steep rate on a small segment can hide a shallow rate on a large one that costs far more sessions. Both figures are shown side by side so the ranking reflects size while the rate keeps the comparison fair across segments.

faqs.question: How are repeat views and repeat additions counted?
faqs.answer: One view per page per session and one addition per variant per session, so reloading a page or tapping the control twice does not inflate either step. Without that rule a slow-loading page looks like strong interest and a double tap looks like two shoppers.

faqs.question: What if a loss cannot be explained by the records?
faqs.answer: It is reported as unexplained with the segment and the size of the gap, and the additional record needed to decide is named. Inventing a cause to fill the row leads the operator to change a page that was never the problem.

faqs.question: How is an edit linked to a change in orders?
faqs.answer: An edit is linked only when it predates the movement in the page's counts and no other dated change in that window, such as a price change or a source-mix shift, explains it first. faqs.question: Why pair a success metric with a guardrail?
faqs.answer: The guardrail is a second metric that must not worsen while the success metric improves, such as the order count measured with the same denominator. Without it a change can lift add-to-carts while orders fall and still be called a win; both metrics are fixed before the test starts, so the result cannot be judged afterwards on whatever moved.

faqs.question: Can a page be tested with little traffic?
faqs.answer: A page whose traffic is below the merchant's stated minimum for a window is reported with raw counts and given neither a rate nor a test. With few visits a single order moves the figure, so those pages either wait for more traffic or are grouped with similar pages so the combined volume supports a conclusion.

zh_faqs.answer: 只有改动发生在指标变动之前，且同一时间窗内不存在更早成立的其他解释（例如调价或来源构成变化）时，才建立关联。时点本身不构成证明，因此要连同已考虑过的替代解释一起记录；无法从商家记录中确定日期的改动一律列为无法归因。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么成功指标要配一个护栏指标？
zh_faqs.answer: 护栏指标是第二个必须不恶化的指标，例如用同一分母衡量的订单数。没有它，某项改动可能推高了加购却让订单下降，仍被当成成功；两个指标都要在测试开始前定好，这样事后就不能拿任意变动的指标来下结论。

zh_faqs.question: 流量很少的页面可以做测试吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 浏览量低于商家设定最低量的页面只报原始计数，不给比率也不安排测试。访问量太少时一笔订单就能明显改变结果，任何测试结论都不稳定；这类页面要么等流量积累，要么与相似页面合并，使合计样本量足以支撑结论。

title: Plan a controlled comparison of product-page variants
scenarioDescription: Two product-page variants are running together, but price, availability or seasonal demand shifted during the run. In this case, the immediate task is to plan a controlled comparison of product-page variants. The workflow should produce an A/B test plan and decision framework, validated against the merchant's own product records.
howToSolve: Collect the two product-page variants, the traffic split and assignment rule, the conversion metric in scope, the product record with its price and availability across the whole window, and the merchant's stated observation window and minimum sample size. Compare the variants only where both pointed at the same product at the same price and availability throughout the window, mark as contaminated any day on which price, stock or a promotion differed, and treat a comparison with fewer visitors than the merchant's stated minimum as inconclusive rather than as a loss. Deliver an A/B test plan with the decision framework, restate the result with the contaminated days excluded and the sample size shown, then reconcile the attributed orders against the order export and name the products the finding covers.

faqs.question: What invalidates a product-page comparison?
faqs.answer: Any change to price, availability or an active promotion during the window contaminates the comparison, because the variant and the change cannot be separated in the result; those days are excluded and reported separately, and if too much of the window is contaminated the run is repeated rather than interpreted.

faqs.question: How large does the sample need to be?
faqs.answer: It must reach the merchant's stated minimum per variant before any difference is called a result, since a small sample turns normal variation into an apparent win; below that threshold the outcome is recorded as inconclusive and the window is extended instead of the weaker variant being removed.

faqs.question: Does the result apply to other products?
faqs.answer: It applies to the product tested and to products the merchant can show share its traffic and price behaviour, because a layout change that wins on a high-traffic product can lose on a slow one; the plan names the product scope explicitly so the finding is not generalised by habit.

zh_faqs.question: 样本量需要多大？

zh_faqs.question: 结论能否推广到其他商品？

zh_faqs.question: FAQ板块应放在页面什么位置？
zh_faqs.answer: 放在购买信息下方、靠近评价的位置，具体遵循商家既定的规则。若放在加购区之上，会把真正促成决策的内容挤到页面更下方。

zh_faqs.question: 什么样的问题不该放进FAQ？
zh_faqs.answer: 描述中已经回答的问题就不必再放。FAQ的价值在于覆盖主文案之后仍然悬而未决的内容，例如保养、版型、兼容性或配送条款。

zh_faqs.question: 记录里答不上来的问题怎么处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 标记为缺口，连问题原文一起交给商家。默默略过，意味着上线后同样的客服工单还会继续涌入，而且页面上看起来什么问题都已解答。

The workflow should produce feature descriptions that carry their source, mark attributes with no recorded origin and list the gaps still open.
howToSolve: Start from the documented specifications, the variant attributes on record, the approved terminology and units, and the feature text currently on the page so any drift can be measured. Describe each feature using only the attributes those records confirm, keep the recorded unit and term rather than a looser synonym, and mark any attribute with no recorded origin as unverified instead of inferring it from a similar product. Deliver the feature descriptions with their source beside each attribute, then verify the wording against the supplied records, list the attributes still missing an origin and note every point where the new text differs from what the page says today.

faqs.question: How is drift from the documentation measured?
faqs.answer: Compare the current page text against the documented attribute by attribute and record each difference. A rewrite that matches the documentation in meaning but not in wording is still drift, and it is worth noting.

faqs.question: Can an attribute be written from a photo or a sample?
faqs.answer: No, only from a record, because appearance does not establish a measured value. Mark it unverified and request the figure, since a written attribute becomes a promise at the moment of checkout.

faqs.question: Should units and terminology be standardised while describing?
faqs.answer: Yes, to the units and terms the merchant has approved, but keep the conversion visible. Changing a unit silently leaves the new text disagreeing with every record that still uses the old one.

zh_faqs.question: 与文档的偏离程度如何衡量？

zh_faqs.question: 描述时要统一单位与术语吗？

Mark every screen where two prompts of equal weight compete or where a label does not name the step it triggers, assign one primary action per screen and demote or relocate the rest, and keep labels consistent for the same step while changing only those whose wording does not match what the control actually does. Deliver the revised plan listing the screens changed, the wording before and after, and the check that shows the change worked, then verify it against the supplied journey data by confirming that each screen has exactly one primary action and that no step was left without a prompt.

faqs.question: What happens to a secondary prompt once a primary is chosen?
faqs.answer: It is demoted in weight or moved out of the buy area, never removed without a decision, because prompts such as save for later or ask a question still serve shoppers. Deleting them silently removes a path some buyers used and the journey data will not explain the change.

faqs.question: How is a competing prompt identified?
faqs.answer: Two prompts of equal visual weight sitting in the same region of a screen with different destinations, or a label describing something other than what the control does. The plan records the before and after wording so a reviewer can see which conflict was resolved and how.

faqs.question: Does restyling the button count as optimisation?
faqs.answer: Only alongside wording and position, because contrast makes a prompt visible while the label and its place decide whether it is understood. A restyle on its own is recorded as a visual change and is not expected to move the step rate by itself.

zh_faqs.question: 定了主行动之后，次行动入口怎么处理？

zh_faqs.question: 什么样的入口算得上互相争夺？
zh_faqs.answer: 同一屏同一区域内两个视觉权重相当、去向却不同的入口，或者文案描述与控件实际行为不符的入口都算。方案要记录改前与改后的文案，让复核的人看得出解决了哪处冲突、又是怎么解决的。

zh_faqs.question: 只改按钮样式算不算优化？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有与文案和位置一起改才算，因为对比度只让入口被看见，而文案和位置才决定它是否被理解。单纯改样式在方案里记为视觉调整，不应指望它单独推动环节比率的提升。

faqs.question: How are generated frames checked against the product?
faqs.answer: Each frame is compared with the reference photography on colour, proportion, finish and markings, and every difference is logged as drift; a frame only passes when the item is recognisable as the same product, since buyers treat the image as evidence of what will arrive.

faqs.question: What keeps concepts from implying unsupported features?
faqs.answer: The concept step cross-checks each scene against the verified appearance record and specification, so staging that suggests water resistance, scale or materials the product lacks is flagged and reworked before any frame is generated.

faqs.question: How many concepts are produced?
faqs.answer: One per placement the merchant has stated, each tied to a named purpose and output size; producing extra unattached variants wastes generation effort and multiplies the drift that must later be checked against the reference.

zh_faqs.question: 生成画面如何与实物核对？

title: Generate a product image brief from reference assets

Write a brief that pins shape, colour, markings and composition to the lead reference, states which details come from which source, and names the elements that must not drift, so generation has no room to invent product features. faqs.question: Which reference leads when assets disagree?
faqs.answer: The one shot under neutral lighting with the product most fully visible; when a secondary angle contradicts it on colour or markings, the discrepancy is recorded in the brief and resolved against the verified product record, never averaged into the image.

faqs.question: What must the brief pin versus leave open?

faqs.question: How is a generated image verified before use?
faqs.answer: By walking the same checklist used to write the brief — shape, colour, markings, composition — against the lead reference and logging each mismatch; the image is then paired with verified photography until the merchant accepts generated visuals as the sole representation.

zh_faqs.question: 说明中哪些必须锁定、哪些可以放开？
zh_faqs.answer: 形状、颜色、识别性标识与构图必须锁定到参考，因为这些地方一旦偏离就会失实；背景风格与取景可在投放位的尺寸规则内留有余地，前提是不暗示商品不具备的特性。

zh_faqs.question: 半透明或反光区域如何处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 单独建立蒙版并采用更柔和的边缘处理，保留其透出的内容，因为强行做不透明切割会抹掉恰恰是材质特征的细节，留下扁平且明显经过修图的轮廓。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要在原始放大比例下检查？

zh_faqs.question: 接触阴影要随背景一起去除吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 若商家的呈现规范要求保留自然落点就应保留，只有目标背景明确要求无阴影的平铺效果时才去除，因为缺少阴影的商品会显得悬浮脱节。

faqs.question: How is the light direction read from the source?
faqs.answer: Take it from the object's own shading and cast shadow rather than assuming a studio default, because the highlight side and shadow side in the image are the only evidence of where the light actually was.

faqs.question: Should the product be recolored after replacement?
faqs.answer: Only to correct color spill from the previous background and never to change the product, because catalogue images are read as a record of the item and a shifted hue invites a mismatch claim.

faqs.question: How is consistency kept across a set?
faqs.answer: Fix one background value, one shadow treatment and one export setting, then apply them unchanged to every image, because per-image adjustments are what make a grid look uneven.

zh_faqs.question: 如何从原图判断光照方向？

faqs.question: Why one brief per product instead of one for all?
faqs.answer: A shared template keeps the set consistent, but each brief must carry that product's own reference details — colour, markings, preserved features — because a single blanket brief lets one product's attributes bleed into another's image, and the mismatch usually only surfaces after generation.

faqs.question: How is batch consistency verified?
faqs.answer: Each output is checked twice: against its own reference for product accuracy, and against sibling outputs for lighting, angle and background treatment; both checks are logged per image so a single off-style frame is traced to its brief rather than regenerating the whole batch.

faqs.question: What happens to products without references?
faqs.answer: They are held out with the reason recorded and a reference requested from the merchant; generating without one risks an image that does not match stock, and inserting it later means re-checking the whole set's consistency anyway.

faqs.question: Should mixed shooting conditions be normalized first?

faqs.question: How is a frame judged as needing rework?
faqs.answer: Compare its edges with the accepted reference at full zoom and rework any frame where detail is lost, halos appear or the contact shadow breaks; borderline frames are listed rather than silently passed.

faqs.question: What record should the batch carry afterwards?
faqs.answer: The settings applied, the frames reworked with reasons and the files skipped, because a later reshoot or a new background specification can then be applied without re-deciding every single image.

title: Build a complete product page from verified product data

In this case, the immediate task is to build a complete product page from verified product data. The workflow should produce a page specification with its asset list, leaving unsupported fields blank instead of filling them with plausible text.
howToSolve: Assemble the verified product data covering variant attributes, pricing and availability, the approved image set, and the current policy text from the merchant's records, listing every field where two exports disagree for resolution before use. Fill each page section from that verified data, resolve recorded conflicts against the merchant's confirmed authoritative source, and leave any field without support empty and marked pending rather than filling it with plausible text. faqs.question: How are conflicting exports handled?
faqs.answer: Each disagreement is listed at collection and resolved against the source the merchant confirms as authoritative, with the ruling recorded; a page is never built on an unresolved conflict, because whichever value loses creates an order the store cannot fulfil as described.

faqs.question: Why leave unsupported fields blank?
faqs.answer: Because plausible placeholder text reads as a claim the record cannot back and reaches buyers as if verified; blank pending fields with a named need keep the publish step honest and show exactly what must be sourced before launch.

faqs.question: What does the delivery verify?
faqs.answer: Every populated field is checked back against the supplied records, the asset list is matched to the images actually referenced in the specification, and the pending-field count is stated so the merchant knows the page's completeness before publishing.

zh_faqs.question: 导出文件冲突时怎么处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 在收集阶段把每处分歧列成清单，按商家确认的权威来源裁定并记录结论；页面绝不建立在未解决的冲突上，因为落选的那个值可能导致店铺无法按页面描述履约。

zh_faqs.question: 无依据的字段为什么要留空？
zh_faqs.answer: 因为看似合理的占位文案读起来像记录无法支撑的主张，发布后会被买家当成已核实内容采信；留空并注明待补项与所需内容，才能让发布环节如实掌握还缺什么。

zh_faqs.question: 交付时要核验什么？
zh_faqs.answer: 每个已填充字段回溯对照所提供的记录，素材清单与页面说明中实际引用的图片一一对应，并写明待补字段数量，让商家在发布前了解页面的完整程度。

title: Generate an AI-assisted product-page draft
scenarioDescription: Drafting pages one by one is slow, yet generating them freely yields confident sentences the data never supported. In this case, the immediate task is to generate an AI-assisted product-page draft. The workflow should produce a draft whose copy comes only from verified inputs, listing every unsupported line and every asset still outstanding.
howToSolve: Collect the verified product facts, the existing image inventory, audience and tone notes, and the section structure the merchant wants, and record which record certifies each fact so every claim can be traced to a source. Generate each section's copy only from those certified inputs, tag every line no input supports as unverified, and leave any required field whose value is missing marked rather than filled with plausible wording. Deliver the draft with a per-section asset list and an unresolved-input register, then verify line by line that every factual claim maps to a named record and that each unverified tag is resolved or cut before publication.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [verified product facts, existing image inventory, audience and tone notes, the merchant's section structure, and the source record certifying each fact]. Generate each section's copy only from those certified inputs, tag every line no input supports as unverified, and leave any required field whose value is missing marked rather than filled with plausible wording. Return the draft with its asset requirements and the unresolved inputs listed, checked against those records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Can generated copy be published without review?
faqs.answer: No. The generator recombines only the inputs it was given, so a fluent sentence can still assert a spec, fit or material that no record confirms. Every line must be traced to a certified input, and any line still tagged unverified must be cut or resolved before the page goes live.

faqs.question: What inputs does the generator need?
faqs.answer: Verified specifications, the image inventory, audience and tone notes, the applicable policy wording, and the intended section structure. Missing inputs do not stop generation, but they force either generic filler or unverified claims, so the draft lists each gap as unresolved instead.

faqs.question: Does a draft include the images?
faqs.answer: It lists each required asset with its purpose, target section and required size, drawn from the image inventory. Slots with no verified image are marked outstanding rather than filled with placeholder or stock visuals that imply the product looks different.

faqs.question: Should one template serve the whole catalog?
faqs.answer: Use one default where products share the same decision steps, but route products needing comparison tables, sizing detail or configuration to their own structure. The routing rule names the product attribute that triggers the alternate template, so assignment stays consistent as the catalog grows.

faqs.question: What makes a template a poor fit?
faqs.answer: When a required piece of information has no dedicated slot, it gets pushed into a section buyers skip or buried below detail they never reach. The check is whether each blocker question has an answering section, in the order buyers actually ask it.

faqs.question: Can a template be adjusted later?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rework it once page evidence such as scroll depth or support questions shows buyers missing a section, and record which purchase question the adjustment serves. Keeping that mapping documented prevents the next template choice from repeating the same gap.

title: Organize product-page sections around purchase questions
scenarioDescription: The theme offers plenty of sections, but nobody has written down which purchase question each one is there to settle. In this case, the immediate task is to organize product-page sections around purchase questions. The workflow should produce a section plan naming the question each section answers, ordered so blockers are resolved before supporting detail.
howToSolve: List the sections the theme makes available and write down every purchase question a buyer must settle before ordering for this product, sourcing the questions from the audience notes and support history rather than guesses. Assign each question to the section that answers it, order the sections so questions blocking a purchase are resolved before supporting detail, and mark both questions with no matching section and sections serving no question. Deliver a section plan naming the question each section answers and its position, with orphan questions and purposeless sections listed for the merchant's decision, then verify every recorded question is traceable to exactly one section.

faqs.question: How many sections should a product page have?
faqs.answer: Only as many as the question inventory requires, because each extra section pushes the answers buyers need further down the page. Any section that answers no recorded question is a candidate for removal rather than decoration between real answers.

faqs.question: Should specifications appear before benefits?
faqs.answer: Follow the buyer's decision steps from the audience notes, not a fixed rule. For spec-led purchases such as tools or components, early specifications answer blockers; for emotion-led purchases they are supporting detail and follow the benefits.

faqs.question: Can one section answer several questions?
faqs.answer: Yes when the questions are closely related, but the plan still lists each question separately under that section so coverage can be checked. A section absorbing unlisted questions hides gaps the moment the plan is reused on another product.

faqs.question: Can supplier text be published as written?
faqs.answer: Rarely. It is written for trade buyers and front-loads internal codes and wholesale terms that mean nothing to a shopper. Restructure it into the buyer's question order and check every retained figure against the store's record before anything goes live.

faqs.question: What if supplier data conflicts with store records?
faqs.answer: Follow the verified store record and log the conflict with both values, because the store owns what the page claims. Conflicts are settled by confirming with the merchant, never by quietly picking the more favourable figure.

faqs.question: Which assets are usually still missing?
faqs.answer: Store-standard photography at the required sizes, sizing and care wording, and any warranty or policy text, all of which must come from the merchant rather than the supplier. The draft lists each gap by section so no slot ships empty.

zh_faqs.question: 供应商提供的文案可以直接上架吗？

zh_faqs.question: 供应商数据与店铺记录冲突怎么办？

zh_faqs.question: 通常还缺哪些素材？

faqs.question: Should a batch share one page structure?

faqs.question: How are exceptions handled in a batch?
faqs.answer: They are pulled into a separate list naming the missing or non-conforming field, so the rest of the batch proceeds to review without waiting. Each exception stays out of the publish queue until its named field is supplied and checked.

faqs.question: Is a batch draft ready to publish?
faqs.answer: No. Each draft is reviewed against its own record, its required assets confirmed attached, and the count check passed first. Publishing straight from a batch draft risks carrying one unresolved exception live alongside everything else.

title: Audit store health across accessible evidence
scenarioDescription: A merchant suspects several store problems at once but has never separated what can be proven from guesswork. In this case, the immediate task is to audit store health across accessible evidence. The workflow should test each suspected issue against reachable records, producing an audit of confirmed findings alongside open questions.
howToSolve: Gather the store URLs and the areas the merchant wants examined, the catalog reports, order and fulfillment exports and configuration records reachable for this pass, the list of issues already suspected with the reason each is suspected, and an explicit note of which systems are not accessible. Test each suspected issue against the reachable records and record it as a confirmed finding only where the evidence supports it, as an open question where the evidence is missing or contradictory, and as not reviewed where the area cannot be reached, refusing to score any area in the last group. Deliver an audit separating confirmed findings from open questions, each finding carrying the affected records, the evidence and the next check and each open question carrying the check that would settle it, then reconcile the number of findings against the number of suspected issues entered so nothing silently disappears.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me audit store health across accessible evidence. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the store URLs and areas in scope, catalog reports, order and fulfillment exports, configuration records reachable for this pass, the suspected issues with their reasons, and a list of systems not accessible]. Test each suspected issue against the reachable records and record it as a confirmed finding only where the evidence supports it, as an open question where the evidence is missing or contradictory, and as not reviewed where the area cannot be reached, refusing to score any area in the last group. Return an audit with confirmed findings and open questions for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is a suspicion turned into a finding?
faqs.answer: Only when a reachable record supports it, and the finding then names the affected records, the evidence and the next check. Where evidence is missing the item stays an open question with the check that would settle it, never a finding and never silently closed.

faqs.question: Can the audit speak about systems it cannot reach?
faqs.answer: It can list the checks those systems would require, but must not report an unreachable area as verified healthy or verified broken. Such an area is marked not reviewed with the access needed, since scoring it would invent a result the evidence cannot carry.

faqs.question: Does the audit produce a health score?
faqs.answer: A score can summarise confirmed findings but does not itself say what to fix, so each finding keeps its affected records, evidence and next check. Areas marked not reviewed are excluded from the score rather than counted as passing.

zh_faqs.question: 怀疑项怎样才能变成已确认发现？

zh_faqs.question: 审计能对无法访问的系统下结论吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 可以列出这些系统所需的检查项，但不能把无法触及的范围报成已核实健康或已确认故障，应标为未检查并注明所需的访问权限。给它打分等于凭空造出一个证据支撑不了的结果。

zh_faqs.question: 审计会给出健康评分吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 评分可以概括已确认发现，但它本身并不能说明该修什么，因此每条发现仍要保留受影响的记录、支撑证据与下一步检查。标为未检查的范围不参与评分，而不是按通过计入。

title: Review the store's current operational health
scenarioDescription: After a round of configuration changes and imports, the merchant wants one honest picture of how the store runs now. In this case, the immediate task is to review the store's current operational health. The workflow should snapshot the catalog, order and fulfillment records and flag every place where behaviour departs from the intended setup.
howToSolve: Snapshot the current catalog state, the order and fulfillment statuses in force, the inventory quantities published per channel, and the configuration changes and imports applied in the period the merchant names, capturing the snapshot time alongside the records. Compare what the snapshot shows against the setup the merchant intends, recording each departure with the area, the records affected, the change most likely to have caused it and whether customers can currently see it, and treating a departure explained by a recent import as still open until the correction is verified. Deliver a health summary listing current status per area in scope, the deviations found and the watch items that sit inside tolerance but are worth re-checking, state plainly which areas were not reviewed because no records were supplied, and reconcile the deviating records listed against the counts in the snapshot.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me review the store's current operational health. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the current catalog state, order and fulfillment statuses in force, inventory quantities published per channel, and the configuration changes and imports applied in the named period]. Compare what the snapshot shows against the setup the merchant intends, recording each departure with the area, the records affected, the change most likely to have caused it and whether customers can currently see it, and treating a departure explained by a recent import as still open until the correction is verified. Return a health summary with current status and watch items for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: What counts as a health issue here?
faqs.answer: Any place where observed behaviour departs from the setup the merchant intends, recorded with the area, the affected records and the likely cause. A difference that is intentional, meaning a setting the merchant changed on purpose, is noted as expected rather than a deviation.

faqs.question: Does a clean check prove the store is healthy?
faqs.answer: No, it means no departure was found among the checks performed on the records supplied at the snapshot time. Areas with no records supplied are listed as not reviewed rather than assumed sound, and behaviour can change with the next import.

faqs.question: Why pair each deviation with recent changes?
faqs.answer: Because a recent configuration edit or import usually explains a newly appearing deviation and points straight at the correction, while without it the team must re-derive the cause. Where no change lines up, the deviation is flagged as unexplained and needs its own investigation.

zh_faqs.question: 检查结果干净能证明店铺健康吗？

title: Audit website issues affecting the shopping experience

In this case, the immediate task is to audit website issues affecting the shopping experience. The workflow should follow the supplied URLs from landing page to cart, recording where a visitor gets blocked, misled or slowed and which pages are affected.

Classify each observation as blocking, misleading or merely slow, and set aside anything seen once and never reproduced as unconfirmed rather than as a finding, so the list carries only what a visitor would actually meet. faqs.question: How many passes does a page need before a finding counts?
faqs.answer: At least two passes on the same device and entry path, with the observation recorded both times. A single pass can catch a transient network stall or a cached state, so repeating the walk separates a stable defect from a moment.

faqs.question: Should a slow page be reported as a defect?
faqs.answer: Report it with the observed cause named rather than as a defect by default. Heavy media, third-party scripts and theme settings all produce delay, and the fix differs for each, so the report should say what was seen slowing the page.

faqs.question: What if a supplied URL cannot be opened?
faqs.answer: Record it as unreachable with the response seen and keep it on the list. Dropping it quietly hides a blocking problem that a shopper would meet at exactly that step of the path.

zh_faqs.question: 页面变慢就应该当作缺陷上报吗？

faqs.question: What makes the next cycle comparable to this one?

faqs.question: How should a check with no accessible system be recorded?
faqs.answer: As unchecked, with the reason the evidence was unavailable. Leaving the check out shortens the report but quietly narrows what the audit actually covered.

faqs.answer: Only where the merchant asks for one, and always beside the evidence behind it. A grade on its own does not say which check failed or what the reader should do next.

faqs.question: How is a repeatable error separated from a one-off?
faqs.answer: By reproducing it under the recorded conditions and getting the same result. One occurrence may come from a transient network or cache state, so it belongs in the log at low priority rather than driving the fix order.

faqs.question: What happens to an error that clears before anyone looks?
faqs.answer: It stays in the log as unconfirmed with the reported conditions and the last time seen. Marking it resolved would claim a fix that nobody verified.

title: Locate missing pages returning 404 errors
scenarioDescription: Shoppers land on empty pages after a catalog cleanup, and the merchant cannot tell whether a page was removed or a link points at the wrong address. howToSolve: Collect every URL reported missing with the HTTP status actually returned when it was checked, the referring page or traffic source that sent the visit, and for each handle whether it was hidden, renamed or deleted during the cleanup. Classify each case as a destination that no longer exists, a renamed handle whose replacement page is live, or a link written with the wrong address, and choose the repair from that class so only the renamed class gets pointed at a new page while mistyped links are corrected where they are written. Deliver an error inventory with repair and verification steps giving each URL its class, the replacement page or the source edit proposed and the check that closes it, requiring the original URL and its referring page to be requested again with the returned status recorded, and leaving open anything that still errors or reaches a page nobody intended.

faqs.question: When should a missing page be redirected instead of left returning an error?
faqs.answer: Only when a genuinely equivalent page exists, such as the product under its new handle or its closest live replacement; pointing everything at the homepage hides real removals, misleads whoever followed the link and leaves future audits unable to tell what was actually withdrawn.

faqs.question: How do you tell a renamed handle from a mistyped link?
faqs.answer: Compare the failing address with the handle history and the anchor text used: a renamed handle matches a known page except for the old handle segment and has a live successor, while a mistyped link usually fails to match any handle ever used and points at a page that still exists under its correct spelling.

faqs.question: Does the fix count as done once the new link works?
faqs.answer: Not until both sides are retested, meaning the original address and the page that linked to it, with the returned status written down; a link repaired only in the inventory often still survives in navigation or in a block an app generates, so re-read those sources in place too.

zh_howToSolve: 收集所有被反馈缺失的URL及其实际检测时返回的HTTP状态、带来这次访问的来源页面或流量渠道，以及每个handle在清理中被隐藏、改名还是删除。把每个问题归为「目标已不存在」「已改名且有在线替代页」或「链接写错地址」三类，并按类别选择修复方式：只有改名类指向新页面，写错的链接则在书写处直接更正。输出含修复与验证步骤的错误清单，逐条写明类别、建议的替代页或来源处修改以及确认方法，要求同时重新请求原URL和来源页面并记录返回状态，仍在报错或落到非预期页面的条目保持未关闭。

zh_faqs.question: 什么时候该给缺失页面做跳转，而不是保留报错？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有在确实存在等价页面时，例如商品换了新的handle或有最接近的在售替代页。把所有地址都指向首页会掩盖真实的商品下架，既误导跟随链接而来的访客，也让日后的复核无法分清到底下架了什么。

zh_faqs.question: 如何区分改名handle与写错的链接？
zh_faqs.answer: 把失效地址与handle变更历史和链接锚文本对照：改名的handle除旧片段外都能对上某个已知页面且有在线后继页；链接写错则通常匹配不上任何历史handle，而目标页面本身在其正确拼写下仍然可访问。

zh_faqs.question: 新链接能打开就算修好了吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不算，必须同时复测原地址和指向它的那个页面，并记录返回的状态码。只在错误清单里修好的链接，往往还残留在导航或某个应用生成的区块中，因此这些来源位置也要就地复查。

title: Investigate reported server errors affecting store pages
scenarioDescription: Server errors appear intermittently after a theme or app change, and the merchant cannot say which URLs or how often. In this case, the immediate task is to investigate reported server errors affecting store pages. The workflow should produce an error inventory with repair and verification steps separating reproducible failures from intermittent ones.
howToSolve: Record each failing URL with its timestamp in the store's timezone, the request that triggered it and whether the visitor was signed in or checking out, plus the theme deploys, app installs and setting changes logged shortly before the errors began. Replay each reported request on demand to separate failures that reproduce every time from those that surface only under one condition, aligning error timestamps with the deploy record to name the most recent change that could explain them and marking anything that never reproduces as unconfirmed rather than fixed. Deliver an error inventory with repair and verification steps giving each item its trigger, the steps that reproduce it, its reproduced or unconfirmed status, the suspected change and the rollback or patch proposed, then require the failed request to run clean repeatedly across the merchant's observation window before the item can be closed.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me investigate reported server errors affecting store pages. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [each failing URL with timestamps in the store timezone, the triggering request and whether the visitor was signed in or checking out, plus the theme deploys, app installs and setting changes logged before the errors began]. Replay each reported request on demand to separate failures that reproduce every time from those that surface only under one condition, aligning error timestamps with the deploy record to name the most recent change that could explain them and marking anything that never reproduces as unconfirmed rather than fixed. Return an error inventory with repair and verification steps, marking each item as reproduced or unconfirmed for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why does every report need a timestamp and a timezone?
faqs.answer: Because timestamps line failures up with deploys, traffic peaks and app events, and a mismatched timezone shifts all of it; without both you cannot say whether an error began before or after the change everyone suspects.

faqs.question: What if the error never reproduces?
faqs.answer: Leave it on the inventory as unconfirmed with everything known about its conditions instead of closing it, because intermittent failures tend to cluster around one trigger such as an empty cart, a specific checkout step or signed-in visitors, and losing those details loses the only lead available.

faqs.question: Are these failures always Shopify's responsibility?
faqs.answer: No, custom theme code, a recently installed app or a script added to the checkout is the likelier cause right after a change, so read the deploy record alongside the errors; platform-wide incidents appear regardless of recent changes and tend to hit every page rather than one template.

zh_faqs.question: 为什么每条记录都要带时间戳和时区？

zh_faqs.question: 始终无法复现的报错怎么处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 连同已知的出现条件一起留在清单上，标记为未确认而非关闭。间歇性失败往往围绕某个触发因素聚集，例如空购物车、某个结账步骤或已登录访客，丢掉这些细节就等于丢掉仅有的线索。

zh_faqs.question: 这类失败一定是Shopify的责任吗？

title: Diagnose page-loading failures from available evidence
scenarioDescription: Customers report that pages hang or stop halfway, yet the same URLs sometimes open normally on another device. In this case, the immediate task is to diagnose page-loading failures from available evidence. The workflow should produce an error inventory with repair and verification steps, putting each failure down to rendering, assets or server response.
howToSolve: Collect each reported URL with the device class, browser and connection used, whether the visitor was signed in or relying on an app-injected feature, and the timings on record separating the wait for the first byte from the time images, fonts and scripts take to finish. Read the failed request and resource timings to place each case in one class, calling it a server response problem when nothing renders and the wait for the first byte dominates, an asset failure when the page arrives but listed images, fonts or scripts never complete or return their own errors, and a rendering delay when content appears late or only after interaction, leaving conflicting cases marked undetermined. Deliver an error inventory with repair and verification steps tying every failure to the measurement that supports it, require the same URL to be retested on the same device class and connection until the behaviour repeats consistently, and list alongside it any reported page whose timings were never captured so absence of evidence is not read as success.
