zh_faqs.question: 只有一方声明了配对会怎样？
zh_faqs.answer: 该配对判为未解决。回指要求两个URL都返回完整集合，因此单向声明应连同未能给出回应的URL一起报告，而不能当作有效配对。只声明自身的版本同样按未解决上报，因为它没有提供关于其他版本的任何信号。

zh_faqs.question: 是否必须声明兜底版本？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有商家确实为未匹配的访客提供语言选择器或默认页面时才需要；没有这类目标时，声明只会增加一个无法核验的地址。核查会先记录店铺是否真的提供了兜底，再判断该组，这样缺失就会被读作刻意选择而非疏漏。

zh_faqs.question: 会跳转的版本可以参与声明吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 应声明跳转后的最终地址。经过跳转才能到达的声明返回的是目标页而非被声明URL的信号，会让整组看起来自洽，实际却指向别处。若跳转是有意为之，则把目标URL记为该版本，旧地址退出该组。

title: Audit multilingual page relationships and search signals
scenarioDescription: After expanding into new markets, the merchant has lost track of which translations are complete and whether search signals line up. The workflow should compare each market's URLs, translations and hreflang pairs, separating translation gaps from conflicts.
howToSolve: Collect each market's URL set, the translated content for every version with the fields still untranslated, the hreflang pairs declared, the canonical each version targets, the market redirects configured and the publication and pricing state of each market. Compare the versions on translation completeness, on whether each canonical targets its own version and on whether the pairings and market signals agree, recording separately a translation gap where content is missing or partial and a signal conflict where the declarations disagree, and noting where a redirect hides the version a crawler reaches. Deliver a URL-level diagnosis with evidence and follow-up checks grouped by market that separates translation gaps from signal conflicts, then confirm that every market URL set is accounted for, that each version carries a translation status, and that no market is judged on signals alone while its content is untranslated.

faqs.question: How is an untranslated version classified?
faqs.answer: As a translation gap, kept separate from signal conflicts so neither masks the other. Declarations can be technically complete while the page still serves the default language, and reporting only the signal lets that pass. The audit records which fields are untranslated, so the fix is content work rather than a tag change.

faqs.question: Do market redirects change what is audited?
faqs.answer: Yes. The audit follows the URL a crawler reaches, then records whether a visitor is redirected away from it, because an automatic redirect can serve one market while the declarations describe another. Where the redirect target differs from the declared version, both URLs are reported rather than the visitor's experience alone.

faqs.question: What if a market's URLs are not live yet?
faqs.answer: They are recorded as not published, excluded from the pairing checks and listed separately, since a URL that does not resolve cannot return a reciprocal signal. Including them produces unresolved pairs that look like faults in the live markets and hides the real question of when that market goes public.

zh_faqs.question: 尚未翻译的版本会被归为哪一类？
zh_faqs.answer: 归为翻译缺口，并与信号冲突分开记录，避免两者互相掩盖。声明在技术上可以完整无误，而页面仍在使用默认语言，只报信号就会放过去。审计会记录哪些字段未翻译，因此修复工作落在内容上，而不是改标签。

zh_faqs.question: 市场跳转会改变审计对象吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 会。审计跟随抓取程序到达的URL，同时记录访客是否被跳转离开，因为自动跳转可能出现「访客看到的是甲市场、声明描述的却是乙市场」。当跳转目标与声明版本不一致时，应同时报告两个URL，而不是只描述访客的体验。

zh_faqs.question: 某市场的URL还没上线怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 记为未发布，排除在配对核查之外并单独列出，因为无法访问的URL不可能返回回指信号。把它们纳入核查只会产生看似已上线市场故障的未解决配对，反而掩盖了该市场何时上线这个真正的问题。

faqs.question: Which properties should be compared first?
faqs.answer: Price, availability and product identity, because those are what shopping surfaces read and what shoppers compare against the page. Description mismatches matter less and rarely mislead a buyer.

faqs.question: How is an empty property recorded?
faqs.answer: As missing rather than wrong, with a note on whether the value exists in the merchant's own records. Adding a value with no source behind it creates a mismatch that is harder to find later.

faqs.question: Does one template correction fix every product page?
faqs.answer: Only where the underlying product data is complete. Pages with a missing field or variant-specific pricing still render something different and have to be rechecked individually.

zh_faqs.question: 属性存在但为空应如何记录？

zh_faqs.question: 一次模板修正能解决所有商品页吗？

title: Audit collection pages for search-intent alignment
scenarioDescription: Nobody has reviewed the published collections as a set, so vague copy and overlapping pages go unnoticed. In this case, the immediate task is to audit collection pages for search-intent alignment. The output should be an inventory with each page scored against its stated intent, noting where copy, overlap or missing products weaken it.
howToSolve: Inventory every published collection using the store's own collection index as the source of the list, recording its URL, title element, meta description, opening copy, product count, included products, index status and the internal links pointing at it. Score each page against the single buyer intent it claims to serve, downgrading pages whose product set does not serve that intent, whose copy repeats another page or inherited template boilerplate, or whose included products are missing or unavailable, recording the specific reason for each downgrade. Deliver a collection-level SEO brief carrying revised copy and one recommended action per URL, reconcile the inventoried URL count against the store's published collection list so nothing is skipped, and separate pages needing copy edits from those needing a scope change.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Score each page against the single buyer intent it claims to serve, downgrading pages whose product set does not serve that intent, whose copy repeats another page or inherited template boilerplate, or whose included products are missing or unavailable, recording the specific reason for each downgrade. Return a collection-level SEO brief and revised copy with the audit findings checked against the merchant's records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is a collection scored against the intent it claims?
faqs.answer: By checking three things together: the products included really serve the claimed intent, the copy states it in the shopper's words, and nothing else in the store targets the same term. Missing any one is recorded as a downgrade with the reason named, never as a bare score.

faqs.question: How is duplicated or boilerplate copy recorded?
faqs.answer: As a downgrade tied to the other URL carrying the same wording, rather than as a rewrite task alone. Two pages sharing a paragraph usually means two pages competing for one intent, so the scope question must be settled before new copy is drafted for either.

faqs.question: Should a low product count fail the audit?
faqs.answer: Only when the page cannot serve the intent it claims. A narrow collection with clear copy and complete product data passes, while a larger collection whose included products are all unavailable fails because there is nothing left for the shopper to buy.

zh_faqs.question: 集合页如何对照其宣称意图评分？

zh_faqs.question: 重复或套话文案应如何记录？
zh_faqs.answer: 作为一处降级记录，并关联使用相同表述的另一个URL，而不只是记为待改写。两页共用一段话通常意味着它们在争夺同一意图，因此要先解决范围问题再动笔改写文案。

zh_faqs.question: 商品数量少就一定不合格吗？

title: Diagnose why visits are not becoming orders
scenarioDescription: Sessions are being recorded while the order count stays empty, and there is no trace of how far those visits actually got. In this case, the immediate task is to diagnose why visits are not becoming orders. The workflow should produce a conversion diagnosis and experiment backlog, following each visit through the events the merchant already captures.
howToSolve: Pull the session records for the window with the ordered events captured for each one, the order table for the same window including cancelled, draft and test orders, the tracking configuration and consent settings in force, and the checkout and payment gateway records, so that an absent order and an unrecorded one can be told apart. Trace each session to the last event it produced and count sessions by that stopping point, first ruling out a measurement failure by confirming that the events the store is expected to send do arrive for a test session, and only then treating a stopping point as a behavioural one. Deliver a conversion diagnosis and an experiment backlog naming the step where sessions stop with the counts behind it and the tracking checks already cleared, then reconcile the session count with the merchant's own visit record and the order count with the order export, and list any step whose events are missing entirely as unmeasured rather than as a zero.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me diagnose why visits are not becoming orders. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [session records with the ordered event sequence per session, the order table for the same window including cancelled, draft and test orders, the tracking and consent configuration in force, and checkout and payment gateway records]. Trace each session to the last event it produced and count sessions by that stopping point, first ruling out a measurement failure by confirming that the events the store is expected to send do arrive for a test session, and only then treating a stopping point as a behavioural one. Return a conversion diagnosis and experiment backlog with the stopping point checked against the supplied records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: What must be ruled out before blaming behaviour?
faqs.answer: Before any behavioural conclusion, run a test session end to end, check its events against what the store should send, and query the order table for cancelled, draft and test orders. Ruling measurement out first stops a broken tag being read as a shopper problem; if the check fails, the finding is a tracking fault, not a conversion one.

faqs.question: How is the stopping point found for a session?
faqs.answer: Each session is followed through its own event sequence, and the last event it produced is the step where it stopped, counted across all sessions for the window. Sessions whose sequence is incomplete because an event is missing are counted separately, because a gap in the record is not the same as a shopper leaving at that step.

faqs.question: Are test orders part of the count?
faqs.answer: Test orders, draft orders and cancelled orders are identified in the order table and reported apart from the live count. Including them can make a period look as if it converted when it did not, and excluding them without saying so can hide a real order; the rule applied is stated in the output so the figure can be reproduced.

zh_title: 诊断访问无法转化为订单的原因
zh_scenarioDescription: 会话有记录而订单始终为零，这些访问究竟推进到了哪一步也没有留下痕迹。此时的直接任务是诊断访问为什么没有转化为订单。流程应产出转化诊断与实验待办清单，沿着商家已采集的事件逐一追踪每次访问的去向。
zh_howToSolve: 提取该时间窗内带有按序事件记录的会话、同一时间窗的订单表（含已取消、草稿与测试订单）、当时生效的追踪配置与授权设置，以及结算与支付网关记录，以便区分订单是真的没有产生还是没有被记录下来。把每次会话追踪到它产生的最后一个事件，并按停止位置统计会话数；在此之前先用一次测试会话确认店铺应当上报的事件确实到达，排除衡量故障，之后才把停止位置当作行为层面的结论。交付转化诊断与实验待办清单，写明会话停止的步骤及其计数与已排除的追踪检查，再把会话数与商家自己的访问记录核对、把订单数与订单导出核对，并把完全缺失事件的步骤列为未衡量而不是计为零。
zh_aiPrompt:
你是一名 Shopify 运营专家。请帮我处理「shopify traffic but no orders」这一问题，所属方向为「转化分析与优化」。

店铺背景：[填写品类、目标市场、目标客群]
处理范围：[填写商品、页面、客户、活动或日期范围]
可提供的数据：[填写已有资料]

请按以下方式工作：
1. 先说明完成该任务需要哪些关键数据，并标记缺失项。
2. 把每次会话追踪到它产生的最后一个事件，并按停止位置统计会话数；在此之前先用一次测试会话确认店铺应当上报的事件确实到达，排除衡量故障，之后才把停止位置当作行为层面的结论。
3. 输出问题判断、建议方案、优先级、所需人工确认事项和验证方法。
4. 所有商品属性、指标、客户信息和营销结论必须以我提供的数据为依据；没有证据时请明确写“待确认”，不要猜测。
5. 如涉及发布、发信、改价、修改商品或账户操作，在我明确授权且工具已连接前，仅输出草案或操作步骤；完成操作后再报告已验证的结果。

zh_faqs.question: 在归因为买家行为之前要排除什么？
zh_faqs.answer: 先完整走一遍测试会话，核对其事件与店铺应当上报的内容是否一致，并在订单表中查询看板可能隐藏的已取消、草稿和测试订单。先排除衡量问题，可以避免把损坏的埋点误读成买家问题；若检查不通过，结论就是追踪故障而非转化问题。

zh_faqs.question: 如何确定一次会话停在哪一步？
zh_faqs.answer: 沿每次会话自己的事件序列追踪，它产生的最后一个事件就是停止位置，然后按停止位置统计整个时间窗的会话数。因事件缺失而序列不完整的会话单独计数，因为记录上的空缺并不等于买家就在该步骤离开。

zh_faqs.question: 测试订单算不算在订单数里？
zh_faqs.answer: 测试订单、草稿订单与已取消订单在订单表中被识别出来，并与真实成交分开报告。计入会让某个周期看起来有转化，不说明就剔除又可能掩盖真实订单；所采用的规则会写进输出，保证结果可以复算。

title: Analyze losses across the store conversion funnel
scenarioDescription: Funnel reports exist for every stage, yet the stage boundaries were drawn at different times, so the numbers do not chain together. In this case, the immediate task is to analyze losses across the store conversion funnel. The workflow should produce a conversion diagnosis and experiment backlog, with each step count traced back to the merchant's own records.
howToSolve: Write down each funnel step with the event and the session rule that puts a visitor into it, then pull the count for every step over one window from the same source where possible, recording the definition, the tool and the date each step boundary was set, the segment splits required, and the order export for the same window. Check that consecutive steps chain, meaning a visitor counted in a later step is also counted in every earlier step and the counts never rise going down the funnel, express each fall as a share of the preceding step, and mark as non-comparable any pair of steps whose definitions or boundary dates differ. Deliver a conversion diagnosis and an experiment backlog naming the step with the largest fall, its share, the conditions recorded at that step and the proposed test, then reconcile the final step count with the merchant's order export for the window and list every step whose count could not be traced back to a record.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me analyze losses across the store conversion funnel. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [each funnel step with its entry event and session rule, the count per step over one window, the definition, tool and boundary date recorded for each step, the segment splits required, and the order export for the same window]. Check that consecutive steps chain, meaning a visitor counted in a later step is also counted in every earlier step and the counts never rise going down the funnel, express each fall as a share of the preceding step, and mark as non-comparable any pair of steps whose definitions or boundary dates differ. Return a conversion diagnosis and experiment backlog with every step count reconciled against the supplied records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: What makes two funnel steps comparable?
faqs.answer: Two steps are comparable when both count the same visitors under one session rule over one window, and neither count comes from a source with a different attribution rule. Where a step boundary was set on a different date, that pair is marked non-comparable and given raw counts, because a definition change looks like a change in behaviour.

faqs.question: Why must steps chain downwards?
faqs.answer: A visitor reaching a later step must also appear in every earlier step, so the counts can only stay level or fall as the funnel narrows. A rise between consecutive steps means the two count different populations or windows; that pair is flagged and redefined before any loss is calculated, otherwise the loss figure describes nothing real.

faqs.question: Can a funnel be rebuilt from one tool alone?
faqs.answer: Only where one tool records every event the funnel needs, and that is checked step by step rather than assumed. Where a step lives in a second system, the join key, the window and the timezone are recorded with the count; steps that cannot be joined are reported as unmeasured so the funnel is not completed with an estimate.

zh_title: 分析店铺转化漏斗各环节的流失
zh_scenarioDescription: 漏斗各阶段的报表都有，但阶段边界是在不同时间划定的，导致各环节的计数无法前后衔接。此时的直接任务是分析店铺转化漏斗各环节的流失情况。流程应产出转化诊断与实验待办清单，并把每个环节的计数回溯到商家自己的记录。
zh_howToSolve: 先写明漏斗每个步骤由哪个事件、哪条会话规则把访客计入，再从同一来源（如有可能）提取同一时间窗内各步骤的计数，记录每个步骤的定义、所用工具和边界设定的日期、需要的细分维度，以及同一时间窗的订单导出。检查相邻步骤能否前后衔接，即进入后一步骤的访客必然也计入前面所有步骤、计数沿漏斗向下不会回升，并把每次下降表示为占上一步骤的比例；定义或边界日期不一致的步骤对一律标注为不可比。交付转化诊断与实验待办清单，指明下降最大的步骤及其比例、该步骤记录到的条件与建议测试，再把最后一步的计数与商家该时间窗的订单导出核对，并列出所有无法回溯到具体记录的步骤。
zh_aiPrompt:
你是一名 Shopify 运营专家。请帮我处理「shopify conversion funnel analysis」这一问题，所属方向为「转化分析与优化」。

店铺背景：[填写品类、目标市场、目标客群]
处理范围：[填写商品、页面、客户、活动或日期范围]
可提供的数据：[填写已有资料]

请按以下方式工作：
1. 先说明完成该任务需要哪些关键数据，并标记缺失项。
2. 检查相邻步骤能否前后衔接，即进入后一步骤的访客必然也计入前面所有步骤、计数沿漏斗向下不会回升，并把每次下降表示为占上一步骤的比例；定义或边界日期不一致的步骤对一律标注为不可比。
3. 输出问题判断、建议方案、优先级、所需人工确认事项和验证方法。
4. 所有商品属性、指标、客户信息和营销结论必须以我提供的数据为依据；没有证据时请明确写“待确认”，不要猜测。
5. 如涉及发布、发信、改价、修改商品或账户操作，在我明确授权且工具已连接前，仅输出草案或操作步骤；完成操作后再报告已验证的结果。

zh_faqs.question: 两个漏斗步骤怎样才算可比？
zh_faqs.answer: 两个步骤在同一时间窗内、按同一条会话规则统计同一批访客，且计数都不来自归因或去重规则不同的数据源时，才算可比。若某步骤的边界是在别的日期划定的，这一对就标注为不可比并只报原始计数，因为定义变更与行为变化在数据上长得一模一样。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么步骤计数必须逐级向下？
zh_faqs.answer: 到达后一步骤的访客必然也出现在前面所有步骤中，因此计数沿漏斗只能持平或下降。相邻步骤之间出现回升，说明两者统计的并非同一批人或同一时间窗；这一对要先标记并重新定义，否则算出的流失描述不了任何真实情况。

zh_faqs.question: 漏斗能只靠一个工具重建吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有在该工具记录了漏斗所需的全部事件时才行，而且这一步要逐步检查而不是直接假定。某步骤若存在于另一个系统，就要把关联键、时间窗与时区连同计数一起记录；无法关联的步骤报为未衡量，不用估算补齐漏斗。

title: Measure checkout completion using a consistent definition
scenarioDescription: Two dashboards report different checkout completion rates because each one counts starts and completed orders differently. In this case, the immediate task is to measure checkout completion using a consistent definition. The output should be one written definition applied across devices and regions, with the counts reconciled.
howToSolve: Write down, before any count is pulled, what counts as a checkout start, what counts as a completed order and whether cancelled or refunded orders are removed, then pull start counts and completed orders for one reporting window with device, region and currency recorded on every row. Compute the completion rate as completed orders divided by checkout starts with that single definition applied to every device and region, report any breakdown whose start count sits below the merchant's stated minimum session threshold as raw counts instead of a rate, and flag orders whose currency conversion moves them outside the window. Publish the written definition beside the rate, reconcile the sum of the device and region breakdowns against the period total and against the count of completed orders in the order export, and state which cancelled or refused orders were removed.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me measure checkout completion using a consistent definition. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the written definitions of checkout start and completed order, start counts and completed orders for one reporting window, device, region and currency on each row, and the merchant's stated minimum session threshold]. Compute the completion rate as completed orders divided by checkout starts with that single definition applied to every device and region, report any breakdown whose start count sits below the merchant's stated minimum session threshold as raw counts instead of a rate, and flag orders whose currency conversion moves them outside the window. Return a checkout drop-off report and prioritized remediation tests with the counts reconciled against the supplied records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: When is a shopper counted as having started checkout?
faqs.answer: Only on the event the merchant named in advance, such as the first recorded checkout step, and never on a cart view. The rule must stay fixed across every reporting window, because switching start definitions between periods produces a difference that looks like a performance change but is only a counting change.

faqs.question: Should refunded or cancelled orders stay in the numerator?
faqs.answer: Choose one treatment and document it, since removing them changes what the rate measures. Whatever is chosen has to be applied identically to every period compared, otherwise the trend mixes two definitions rather than showing the real movement of the funnel.

faqs.question: Why do two dashboards disagree on the same period?
faqs.answer: Almost always in the denominator, because one counts cart views and the other counts the first checkout step. Before deciding which number is right, write both start definitions side by side and rebuild each rate on one shared definition, then check the totals against the order export.

zh_title: 用一致的口径衡量结账完成率
zh_scenarioDescription: 两个看板给出的结账完成率不同，因为对结账发起和已完成订单的判定标准不一样。当前任务是用一致的口径衡量结账完成率。最终应先书面给出统一定义，再在所有设备与地区上套用，并把计数与所提供记录核对一致。
zh_howToSolve: 在提取任何计数之前，先书面写明什么算一次结账发起、什么算一单已完成订单，以及是否剔除取消或退款的订单，再提取同一报告周期内的发起量与已完成订单，并在每一行标注设备、地区和币种。用同一套定义把完成率算作已完成订单除以结账发起数，在所有设备与地区上统一套用，遇到发起量低于商家所设最低会话门槛的分组则改为报告原始计数而非比率，并标出因币种换算被移出周期的订单。公布比率时同时给出书面定义，将各设备与各地区的分组之和与周期总计以及订单导出中的已完成订单数核对一致，并说明剔除了哪些取消或被拒的订单。

zh_faqs.question: 买家在什么环节被计为发起结账？
zh_faqs.answer: 只按商家事先指定的事件计算，例如漏斗中记录的第一个结账步骤，而不把加购后的购物车浏览计入。该规则要在每个报告周期保持一致，因为切换发起口径产生的差异看似表现变化，实际只是计数方式的改变。

zh_faqs.question: 退款或取消的订单要留在分子里吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 需选定一种处理方式并记录下来，因为剔除与否会改变比率所衡量的对象。无论选择哪种，都必须在所对比的每个周期中一致执行，否则趋势线混合了两种口径，而非漏斗的真实变化。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么两个看板在同一周期上不一致？
zh_faqs.answer: 问题通常出在分母：一个统计购物车浏览，另一个统计第一个结账步骤。在判断哪个数字正确之前，先把两种发起来源并列写清，用一套统一定义重算各自的完成率，再与订单导出核对总数。

title: Analyze cart abandonment by relevant shopper segments
scenarioDescription: The merchant wants to know whether particular shopper groups abandon more than others, but the reports in use mix several definitions. In this case, the immediate task is to analyze cart abandonment by relevant shopper segments. The output should be comparable segment rates with the counts reconciled against the merchant's own cart data.
howToSolve: Collect carts created in the merchant's stated cohort window with identifiers, creation times, segment attributes and linked order times, recording a fixed follow-up duration and a data cutoff before classifying any cart as completed or abandoned. Include only carts whose full follow-up duration has elapsed by the cutoff, classify completion by whether a linked order arrived within that cart's follow-up window, and assign each mature cart to one exclusive segment while reporting immature carts separately as awaiting observation. Deliver each mature segment's completed and abandoned counts, denominator and rate with the follow-up rule, show low-count groups without ranking, and reconcile mature plus awaiting-observation carts to the cohort export without changing past classifications for purchases outside the fixed follow-up window.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me analyze cart abandonment by relevant shopper segments. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [cart identifiers, creation and linked order timestamps, cohort window, segment attributes, fixed follow-up duration, data cutoff and minimum segment count]. Include only carts whose full follow-up duration has elapsed by the cutoff, classify completion by whether a linked order arrived within that cart's follow-up window, and assign each mature cart to one exclusive segment while reporting immature carts separately as awaiting observation. Deliver each mature segment's completed and abandoned counts, denominator and rate with the follow-up rule, show low-count groups without ranking, and reconcile mature plus awaiting-observation carts to the cohort export without changing past classifications for purchases outside the fixed follow-up window for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Can one cart belong to two segments?
faqs.answer: No. Each cart is assigned once by the rule stated before the run, because double counting would inflate two segments at once and break the reconciliation against the cart total.

faqs.question: When is a cart counted as abandoned?
faqs.answer: A mature cart is abandoned when no linked order arrived within its fixed follow-up window. Carts whose windows have not elapsed are awaiting observation, not abandoned; purchases after that window do not revise this fixed-cohort metric.

faqs.question: Why report a small segment without a rate?
faqs.answer: A rate built on very few carts moves sharply with no change in behavior at all, so those segments are shown with their raw counts and kept out of the comparison.

zh_title: 按相关买家分群分析弃购情况
zh_scenarioDescription: 商家想知道某些买家分群是否更容易弃购，但现有报表混用了多种口径。当前任务是按相关买家分群分析弃购情况。最终应产出可横向对比的分群弃购率，并把分群计数与商家自己的购物车数据核对一致。
zh_howToSolve: 收集商家指定创建期内的购物车标识、创建时间、分群属性与关联订单时间，并在分类之前固定每车的跟进时长和数据截止时点，避免把观察尚未结束的购物车直接判为弃购。仅将截至数据截止时点已走完整个跟进窗口的购物车纳入比率，关联订单在该车跟进窗口内到达才算成交；每个成熟购物车仅归入一个互斥分群，尚未成熟的单独标为待观察。按成熟分群输出成交数、弃购数、分母与比率，附跟进规则，低计数组不排名；核对成熟与待观察购物车之和等于创建期导出总数，固定跟进窗口之外的后续购买不回写该批历史分类。

3. 输出问题判断、建议方案、优先级、所需人工确认事项和验证方法，并完成以下交付核查：按成熟分群输出成交数、弃购数、分母与比率，附跟进规则，低计数组不排名；核对成熟与待观察购物车之和等于创建期导出总数，固定跟进窗口之外的后续购买不回写该批历史分类。
4. 所有结论以提供的数据为依据，缺失时标记待确认，不猜测。
5. 涉及店铺操作时仅在明确授权且工具已连接后执行，并在核实结果后报告完成。

zh_faqs.question: 一个购物车能同时归入两个分群吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不能。执行前先声明规则并让每个购物车只归入一次，重复计数会同时抬高两个分群，也会破坏与购物车总数的核对。

zh_faqs.question: 购物车在什么情况下算作弃购？
zh_faqs.answer: 完整跟进窗口结束仍无窗口内关联订单的成熟购物车才算弃购；未走完窗口的属于待观察，窗口结束之后的购买不回写这一固定同期群指标，避免历史分类随查询时间变化。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么小分群不给出比率？
zh_faqs.answer: 基于极少购物车算出的比率会在行为毫无变化时剧烈波动，因此这些分群只展示原始计数，不参与横向比较。

faqs.question: Why rank by effort as well as reach?

faqs.question: Which carts can be included in a recovery message test?
faqs.answer: Only those carrying an identifier and a contact permission that allows it; carts missing either are still counted in the analysis but stay out of any outreach experiment.

zh_faqs.question: 哪些购物车可以纳入挽回消息测试？

faqs.question: Why fix the sales definition before reporting?

faqs.question: Should refunds reduce the original order period?
faqs.answer: Choose one treatment and state it. Reducing the original period keeps a sale and its refund together, while reducing the issue period matches cash; mixing the two across periods makes a quiet month look recovered, so the choice is recorded rather than left implicit.

faqs.question: How are currency and timezone handled?
faqs.answer: State one reporting currency with the conversion basis, meaning the store rate at order time or the rate on the reporting day, and one timezone for day boundaries, then apply both to every period. Mixing either places the same order in different windows across reports.

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要在做报表之前先固定销售额口径？

zh_faqs.question: 退款应该冲减原订单所属期间吗？

zh_faqs.question: 货币与时区应该如何处理？

faqs.question: Which date field should the report use?
faqs.answer: One field, chosen in advance and applied to every period, usually order creation or payment capture. Switching fields mid-series silently moves orders between periods, so the field is named on the report and any later change is marked as a restatement.

faqs.question: Should discounts be a separate line?
faqs.answer: Yes. A net figure hides how much of the gross was discounted and whether discounting deepened or eased, so discounts appear on their own line between gross and net. Taxes and shipping are shown separately for the same reason, since neither is revenue.

faqs.question: What does reconciliation actually prove?
faqs.answer: That the report was built from complete records. The walk from source orders to the reported figure exposes missing filters and dropped sources, and an unexplained gap is reported as a gap rather than absorbed into rounding.

faqs.question: How many metrics belong on the dashboard?

faqs.question: Should each tile show its source field?

faqs.question: What if two tiles disagree?
faqs.answer: Reconcile them rather than averaging. Disagreement usually means different status filters or date fields sit behind the same word, so the two definitions are compared side by side and one is chosen for the shared term, with the other renamed.

faqs.question: Should a past day be restated after a late refund?

faqs.question: Is the same month last year a fair benchmark?
faqs.answer: It is the most common benchmark, but only after confirming promotions, trading days and assortment were comparable. Where last year carried a campaign this year did not, the report says so beside the comparison rather than presenting the gap as performance.

faqs.question: Which segments are worth analysing?
faqs.answer: The ones the merchant acts on, such as product category, channel or customer type. Splitting by a dimension nobody can influence produces a finding with no owner, and each extra dimension also thins the records behind every cell until the movement is mostly noise.

faqs.question: Should the cause be given with the movement?
faqs.answer: No. The report states the measured movement per segment first, then lists the candidate explanations the records support, keeping the two apart. Merging them lets a plausible story outlive the data that contradicted it.

faqs.question: Why use more than two periods?
faqs.answer: Two points show movement without direction. Several periods show whether a change is a sustained shift or ordinary variation, and they reveal a trend that began earlier than the comparison window the merchant had in mind.

faqs.answer: Exclude them and say so on the report, because mixing them with real orders distorts both volume and value. Identifying them from the records supplied is more reliable than filtering on a name pattern that may also catch real customers.

faqs.question: Why do two exports show different counts?
faqs.answer: Usually a different status or date basis, taken at a different moment. Compare the inclusion rules before assuming a data error, then rebuild both from the same order ID list to confirm the difference.

faqs.question: How should refunds appear in the order report?
faqs.answer: Report gross and refunded amounts separately, then apply the merchant's stated net rule in one place. Netting row by row hides how much revenue was returned and makes later reconciliation harder.

faqs.question: Do edited orders change the count?

faqs.question: What is recorded for a rate before it is trusted?

faqs.question: How are two rates reconciled into one figure?

faqs.question: What if a component cannot be recomputed?

faqs.question: What does one attribution rule change?
faqs.answer: Changing the attribution rule moves orders between channels without changing a single order in the store, so the ranking is rebuilt from the raw records under the one rule the merchant chooses. The rule, its lookback period and the window are written beside the ranking, because a channel that wins under one rule can lose under another.

faqs.question: Do assisting channels deserve credit?
faqs.answer: A channel that rarely closes but often appears earlier in the path is reported with the sessions and orders it touched under the chosen rule rather than being dropped. faqs.question: Which channels are left out of the ranking?

zh_faqs.question: 哪些渠道不进入排序？

zh_faqs.question: 峰值逐年提前时怎么处理？

faqs.question: Why is the window truncated for recent cohorts?

faqs.question: Why report return rate and orders per returner separately?

faqs.question: How is a cohort's membership checked?
faqs.answer: Every customer appears in exactly one cohort, fixed by their first-purchase date and never reassigned when they buy again later, so cohort sizes sum to the distinct buyers in the order history; anyone whose first purchase predates the history is listed separately as having an unobserved start.

faqs.question: Which orders feed each of the three scores?

faqs.question: How are band boundaries set?

faqs.question: How is a customer kept out of two segments at once?
faqs.answer: Rules are evaluated in one stated order and the first match wins, which makes the segments mutually exclusive for reporting; where the merchant wants overlapping campaign audiences, that is declared explicitly and the overlapping group is reported separately from the reporting segmentation.

faqs.question: When does the segmentation have to be rebuilt?
faqs.answer: Whenever the data or the definitions move: after each refresh of the order history, after any change to a membership rule or to the refund treatment, and after the evaluation order is edited, because a rule changed without a rebuild leaves the tables silently describing the previous definition.

zh_faqs.question: 如何避免客户同时落入两个分群？
zh_faqs.answer: 规则按一个既定顺序执行，命中第一条即归属，这样用于报表的分群彼此互斥；若商家确实需要可重叠的投放人群，须明确声明，并把重叠人群与用于报表的分群分开汇报。

zh_faqs.question: 什么时候必须重算分群？

Apply that one measure to every customer over the same span, ranking them by the resulting value and stating whether refunds are netted out before or after ranking, then check how much of the total sits with the top-ranked accounts rather than reporting the ranking alone. faqs.question: Can the measure switch between revenue and margin mid-report?
faqs.answer: No, one measure is chosen for the whole ranking and named in the output, because a list mixing gross revenue for some customers with net margin for others cannot be ordered meaningfully; if the merchant wants both, they are produced as two separate rankings compared side by side.

faqs.question: Why is the concentration check part of the report?
faqs.answer: Because a ranking where most of the total sits with a handful of accounts carries different risk from a broad spread of similar customers; the report states how much of the total the top group holds so decisions about service levels and retention spend rest on the shape of the list, not the order of names.

faqs.question: How are refunds and cancelled orders handled?
faqs.answer: Exactly as the merchant's stated treatment directs, applied to every customer before ranking, because netting refunds for some accounts and not others changes positions without any change in behaviour; orders still in dispute at the analysis date are listed rather than silently included or dropped.

howToSolve: Gather customer-keyed order history with dates and totals, first-purchase dates, the reporting window, the merchant's stated repeat definition, and the refund treatment chosen up front. Group customers into cohorts by first-purchase date inside the window, compute each cohort's repeat rate as customers with at least one qualifying later order divided by cohort size, and report repeat frequency as a separate column rather than inside the rate. Deliver the cohort table with a caveat for cohorts whose members have not yet had a full window to reorder, then reconcile cohort sizes and repeat counts against the customer-level order export before publishing.

faqs.question: How does the window limit which cohorts can be compared?
faqs.answer: Only cohorts whose members have had a full stated window since first purchase can be compared like for like. Later cohorts have had less opportunity to reorder, so their lower rates reflect time, not behaviour. They are reported with a caveat rather than ranked against mature cohorts.

faqs.question: Are the repeat rate and repeat frequency the same figure?
faqs.answer: No. The rate is the share of a cohort with at least one qualifying later order; frequency counts how many later orders those repeaters placed. Mixing them lets a few high-frequency buyers look like broad repeat behaviour. Both are reported, in separate columns, under the same stated repeat definition.

faqs.question: Where do refunded orders enter the calculation?
faqs.answer: The refund treatment chosen up front decides it, and the same choice applies to every cohort. If fully refunded orders are excluded, a customer whose only later order was refunded counts as a non-repeater. Partially refunded orders still count as purchases unless the merchant's rule says otherwise, and the chosen rule is printed with the table.

title: Analyze the time between customer purchases
scenarioDescription: Intervals are averaged across everyone, mixing customers with several orders and people who only bought once. In this case, the immediate task is to analyze the time between customer purchases. The workflow should produce a repeat-purchase cohort analysis, using the merchant's order history with customer identifiers, refund rules and observation window.
howToSolve: Collect order history with customer identifiers and dates, first-purchase dates, the refund rule, the observation window, and campaign markers where the merchant records them. Measure the gap between each cohort's first and second eligible orders, applying the refund rule to decide which orders count, separating campaign-driven purchases where identified, and excluding one-time buyers from the interval statistic instead of scoring them as long gaps. Deliver a cohort table with interval ranges plus the cohort's share of one-time buyers, and state the coverage caveat that gaps longer than the window remaining are censored, reconciling counts with the order export.

Measure the gap between each cohort's first and second eligible orders, applying the refund rule to decide which orders count, separating campaign-driven purchases where identified, and excluding one-time buyers from the interval statistic instead of scoring them as long gaps. Return a repeat-purchase cohort analysis for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why are one-time buyers excluded rather than counted as long intervals?
faqs.answer: Their gap has not ended, so any value assigned would be an assumption rather than a measurement. Scoring them as extreme intervals would drag the statistic down and misstate the true pace of repeaters. They are reported separately as the cohort's share of one-time buyers.

faqs.question: How does the observation window censor the longest gaps?
faqs.answer: A first-to-second gap longer than the time remaining in the observation window cannot be observed yet, so long gaps are missing from the data rather than absent in reality. The cohort table states the window so readers can see which cohorts are still maturing. Treating the current maximum as the true maximum would understate intervals.

faqs.question: Which orders count toward an interval?
faqs.answer: Only eligible orders: inside the observation window, passing the refund rule, and placed by the identified customer. Campaign-driven purchases are separated where the merchant records the campaign, because a discount-driven spike can compress a gap below the customer's usual pace. The eligibility rule is printed with the table so the count can be re-derived.

zh_faqs.answer: 他们的间隔尚未结束，任何赋值都是假设而非测量。按极端间隔计入会拉低统计、错估复购者的真实节奏。他们作为群体中一次性买家的占比单独呈现。

zh_faqs.question: 观察窗口如何删失最长间隔？
zh_faqs.answer: 长于观察窗口剩余时间的第一至第二笔间隔暂时观测不到，长间隔是缺失而非不存在。群体表写明窗口，读者可以看出哪些群体仍在成熟。把当前最大值当作真实上限会低估间隔。

zh_faqs.question: 哪些订单计入间隔？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有有效订单：位于观察窗口内、通过退款规则、且由可识别客户下达。有促销记录处将促销订单单独拆出，因为折扣带动的购买会把间隔压到客户平常节奏之下。表旁写明资格规则，使计数可以复算。

title: Identify patterns in customer purchase behavior
scenarioDescription: The merchant suspects customers buy in predictable combinations and at predictable times, but has never checked the order data. In this case, the immediate task is to identify patterns in customer purchase behavior. The workflow should produce a customer segment table and interpretation guide, keeping only patterns the merchant's order history repeats.
howToSolve: Collect the order history with customer identifiers, order dates, line items and their categories, order values and refund entries for one stated span, together with the analysis date, the catalogue mapping used for categories and any promotion calendar the merchant keeps. Test each candidate pattern, meaning the interval between orders, the category sequence and the items bought in one basket, against the history by counting how many customers and orders repeat it, keeping only patterns that recur across separate customers and periods and discarding anything resting on one account or one promotion. Deliver a customer segment table and an interpretation guide listing every retained pattern with the customers and orders supporting it, verify the supporting counts against the order export, and mark each pattern as observed inside or outside promotion periods.

faqs.question: What keeps an observed sequence from being called a pattern?
faqs.answer: It must recur across separate customers and more than one period and be checked against promotion periods, because a sequence seen once in a single account during a campaign is an observation; retained patterns carry the count of supporting customers and orders so the reader can judge the weight.

faqs.question: Should timing and basket composition be examined together?
faqs.answer: Yes, because the interval between orders rarely explains why a customer returns on its own; the analysis reads spacing, category sequence and items appearing in one basket over the same span, and reports a pattern only where they agree rather than picking whichever looks strongest.

faqs.question: How are promotions kept from distorting the result?
faqs.answer: Orders are tagged with the merchant's promotion calendar and each pattern is marked as observed inside or outside those periods, because campaigns compress intervals and enlarge baskets; a pattern appearing only during campaigns is reported as promotion-driven, not as standing behaviour.

zh_title: 识别客户购买行为中的规律性
zh_scenarioDescription: 商家怀疑客户在商品组合和购买时点上有规律，却从未用订单数据验证过。此时的直接任务是识别客户购买行为中反复出现的规律。流程应产出客户分群表与解读说明，只保留商家自己的订单历史中确实重复出现的模式。
zh_howToSolve: 收集既定期间内的订单历史，包含客户标识、下单日期、行项商品及其品类、订单金额与退款记录，同时确定分析基准日、品类所依据的商品目录映射，以及商家维护的促销日历。把每个候选模式——下单间隔、品类先后顺序、同一购物车内的商品组合——放回历史中检验，统计重复出现该模式的客户数与订单数，只保留跨不同客户、跨不同时期反复出现的模式，凡仅依赖单一账户或单次促销的一律剔除。输出客户分群表与解读说明，逐条列出保留下来的模式及其支撑的客户数与订单数，把这些计数回溯订单导出记录核对一致，并标注每个模式是在促销期内还是促销期外观察到的。

zh_faqs.question: 观察到的序列要满足什么才算一种模式？
zh_faqs.answer: 必须跨不同客户、跨多个时期反复出现，并对照促销期逐一检查；因为只出现在单个账户、且恰逢某次活动的序列只是一次观察。保留下来的模式都会附上支撑它的客户数与订单数，让读者自行判断分量。

zh_faqs.question: 购买间隔与商品组合要一起看吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 要一起看。仅凭下单间隔通常解释不了客户为什么回来；分析会在同一期间内同时考察间隔长短、品类先后顺序和同一购物车内的商品组合，只有三者相互印证时才认定为模式，而不是挑看起来最明显的那一项。

zh_faqs.question: 如何避免促销干扰结论？
zh_faqs.answer: 用商家维护的促销日历给订单打标，并注明每个模式是在促销期内还是促销期外观察到的；因为活动会压缩购买间隔、放大单次购买量。只在活动期间出现的模式会被标注为由促销驱动，而不当作客户的常态行为。

title: Calculate observed customer value and separate projections
scenarioDescription: Two spreadsheets quote different customer values because one folds forecast revenue into the total and the other never subtracts refunds. In this case, the immediate task is to calculate observed customer value and separate projections. The workflow should produce an LTV analysis reconciled against completed orders in the merchant's records.
howToSolve: Collect customer order history with dates and values, the value basis the merchant has chosen between revenue and margin, the treatment for refunds, cancellations, taxes and shipping, the currency and reporting window, and the inputs any projection is allowed to use. Compute observed value first as the net of completed orders inside the window under the stated basis, currency and refund treatment, then build any projection as a separate figure from the merchant's stated method and horizon with each assumption written next to it, never folding the two into one number. Deliver an LTV analysis showing observed value, projected value and assumptions in separate columns, reconcile the observed totals against the order export line by line, and mark customers whose history is too short for the stated method as observed only.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [customer order history with dates and values, the chosen revenue or margin basis, the refund, tax and shipping treatment, the currency and reporting window, and the inputs permitted for any projection]. Compute observed value first as the net of completed orders inside the window under the stated basis, currency and refund treatment, then build any projection as a separate figure from the merchant's stated method and horizon with each assumption written next to it, never folding the two into one number. Return an LTV analysis with transparent assumptions for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why not publish a single value per customer?
faqs.answer: Because the observed part is measured from orders and the projected part rests on assumptions; publishing one number hides that split and makes two periods incomparable as soon as the assumption behind the projection changes.

faqs.question: Which orders enter the observed figure?
faqs.answer: Completed orders inside the reporting window under the merchant's stated status and refund treatment, net of refunds where the rule says so, with pending, cancelled and out-of-window orders excluded and the exclusions listed so the total can be reproduced.

faqs.question: When is a projection not worth showing?
faqs.answer: When the customer's history is too short for the merchant's stated method, in which case the page reports observed value only rather than extending a thin pattern into a number that looks as firm as the measured part.

zh_faqs.question: 哪些订单进入已观测数值？

title: Compare customer lifetime value across relevant segments
scenarioDescription: Segments are being ranked against one another although some were measured over a longer window and others on a different value basis. In this case, the immediate task is to compare customer lifetime value across relevant segments. The workflow should produce an LTV analysis with transparent assumptions tied to the segment definitions actually in use.
howToSolve: Pull every segment definition currently in use together with the date range each one was measured over, the value basis behind each figure such as gross revenue or margin after refunds, and the full order history of the customers in each segment from first order to the analysis cut-off. Recompute every segment on one common window anchored at each customer's own first order rather than the calendar period the segment was created in, hold the value basis constant by excluding cancelled and refunded orders and stating whether shipping and tax are counted, and mark any segment below the merchant's stated minimum customer count as indicative instead of ranking it. Deliver a segment LTV comparison listing for each segment its customer count, the window and basis actually applied, and the original figure beside the recomputed one with the reason for the gap, and reconcile the sum of segment customers against the customer export before publishing.

Recompute every segment on one common window anchored at each customer's own first order rather than the calendar period the segment was created in, hold the value basis constant by excluding cancelled and refunded orders and stating whether shipping and tax are counted, and mark any segment below the merchant's stated minimum customer count as indicative instead of ranking it. Return an LTV analysis with transparent assumptions for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is the comparison window anchored?
faqs.answer: Each customer enters the window at their own first order and is measured to the same cut-off date, so every segment gets equal time to accumulate value; customers acquired after the cut-off are excluded, and a segment whose original window cannot be reconstructed is reported as unreconciled rather than ranked.

faqs.question: What happens to a segment below the stated minimum?
faqs.answer: It is listed with its customer count and its figures marked indicative, because a value per customer swings sharply on a handful of accounts and a rank would overstate the difference; it stays in the table with the flag so it is not silently dropped from the comparison.

faqs.question: How is a gap between original and recomputed figures explained?
faqs.answer: Each gap is attributed to one of three causes: a different window, a different value basis, or a changed segment definition; where a gap survives all three, it is treated as a data problem and the figure is withheld until the customer records reconcile.

zh_faqs.question: 对比窗口以什么为起点？

zh_faqs.question: 低于设定下限的分群怎么处理？

zh_faqs.question: 原始数值与重算数值的差异如何解释？

title: Report traffic volume and quality by source
scenarioDescription: Every source label in the reports is spelled differently, so the merchant can only rank channels on session counts. In this case, the immediate task is to report traffic volume and quality by source. The workflow should produce a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats, ranking sources on quality beside volume and isolating unattributed traffic.
howToSolve: Assemble the sessions, orders, revenue and device split recorded for every source label inside one fixed date range, one attribution setting and one timezone, together with the merchant's channel naming map and the labels already recorded as unattributed. Apply the naming map so every spelling that denotes the same source is merged under one channel, keep unresolvable labels in their own unattributed category instead of distributing them, then rank the channels on volume beside order behaviour rather than on volume alone. Deliver a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats stating the date range, attribution setting and timezone used, then confirm that the merged session totals still sum to the store-wide session count for the window and list every label the naming map could not resolve.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the sessions, orders, revenue and device split recorded for every source label inside one fixed date range, one attribution setting and one timezone, the merchant's channel naming map, and the labels already recorded as unattributed]. Apply the naming map so every spelling that denotes the same source is merged under one channel, keep unresolvable labels in their own unattributed category instead of distributing them, then rank the channels on volume beside order behaviour rather than on volume alone. Return a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats, keeping unattributed traffic in its own category for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How are similar source labels merged?
faqs.answer: Through the merchant's channel naming map, applied once and recorded, with the raw label kept in an appendix so any merge can be reversed and checked. Merging on resemblance alone would combine sources that behave differently, so a label with no mapping entry stays unattributed rather than being guessed into a channel.

faqs.question: Why does the total differ from the store's session count?
faqs.answer: Usually because of timezone, attribution window or bot filtering applied on one side and not the other. The report names the settings used on both sides and shows the difference as a reconciliation line, so a gap becomes a stated caveat rather than a silent discrepancy that undermines every figure beneath it.

faqs.question: Should a source with no orders be dropped?
faqs.answer: No. It keeps its row with its volume and an empty order count, because removing it would present a channel mix that never existed. Such sources are simply ranked below those that convert, and the caveats note where their volume is too small to judge quality in either direction.

zh_title: 按来源统计流量规模与质量
zh_scenarioDescription: 报表里的来源标签各写各的写法，商家只能按会话数粗略排序，看不出哪个渠道的访客真正下单。此时的首要任务是按来源统计流量规模与质量。流程应统一命名与归因口径，把规模与质量并列排序，产出带口径说明的渠道流量分析。
zh_howToSolve: 先在一个固定日期区间、统一归因设置与时区下，汇总每个来源标签记录的会话、订单、金额与设备拆分，并取来商家的渠道命名映射表以及已标记为无法归因的标签。再套用命名映射，把指代同一来源的各种写法合并到同一渠道下，无法解析的标签保留在单独的未归因类别中而不做分摊，然后让各渠道的规模指标与下单表现并列排序，而非只按规模排序。最后输出带口径说明的渠道流量分析，写明所用的日期区间、归因设置与时区，并核对合并后的会话合计仍等于该时间窗的店铺会话总数，同时列出命名映射无法解析的每个标签。
zh_aiPrompt:
你是一名 Shopify 运营专家。请帮我处理「shopify traffic source report」这一问题，所属方向为「流量来源分析」。

店铺背景：[填写品类、目标市场、目标客群]
处理范围：[填写商品、页面、客户、活动或日期范围]
可提供的数据：[填写已有资料]

请按以下方式工作：
1. 先说明完成该任务需要哪些关键数据，并标记缺失项。
2. 再套用命名映射，把指代同一来源的各种写法合并到同一渠道下，无法解析的标签保留在单独的未归因类别中而不做分摊，然后让各渠道的规模指标与下单表现并列排序，而非只按规模排序。
3. 输出问题判断、建议方案、优先级、所需人工确认事项和验证方法。
4. 所有商品属性、指标、客户信息和营销结论必须以我提供的数据为依据；没有证据时请明确写“待确认”，不要猜测。
5. 如涉及发布、发信、改价、修改商品或账户操作，在我明确授权且工具已连接前，仅输出草案或操作步骤；完成操作后再报告已验证的结果。

zh_faqs.question: 相近的来源标签如何合并？
zh_faqs.answer: 依据商家的渠道命名映射表合并，只执行一次并做好记录，同时在附录保留原始标签，便于随时还原和复核。仅凭名称相似就合并会把表现不同的来源混在一起，因此映射表中没有对应项的标签应留在未归因，而不是猜着塞进某个渠道。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么合计与店铺会话数对不上？
zh_faqs.answer: 通常源于时区、归因窗口或机器流量过滤只在一侧生效。报告要写明两侧各自使用的设置，并把差额作为一行对账项列出，让差异成为公开声明的口径说明，而不是一个悄悄削弱后续所有数字的不一致。

zh_faqs.question: 没有订单的来源应该剔除吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不应该。它保留自己的行、带上流量规模与空的订单数，因为剔除会呈现一个从未存在过的渠道结构。这类来源只是排在能产生转化的来源之后，并在口径说明中注明其流量规模尚不足以判断质量好坏。

title: Analyze organic traffic performance over matched periods
scenarioDescription: Search visitors arrive steadily, but the merchant has no matched periods to compare them against. In this case, the immediate task is to analyze organic traffic performance over matched periods. The workflow should produce a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats, holding attribution rules fixed while comparing landing pages and orders.
howToSolve: Take the organic search sessions, the landing pages they reached, the queries where the records carry them, the orders and revenue attributed to them, two periods of equal length under the same attribution setting, and the dates of any content or template change between them. Compare volume, engagement and order behaviour across the two matched periods with attribution held constant, split brand and store-name searches from category queries where the records allow it, and mark any period with gaps or incomplete records rather than comparing it as though it were whole. Deliver a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats that attributes the movement to the landing pages the split actually supports, then confirm that both periods contain the same number of days and that the landing page totals reconcile with the organic session total for each period.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me analyze organic traffic performance over matched periods. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the organic search sessions, the landing pages they reached, the queries where the records carry them, the orders and revenue attributed to them, two equal-length periods under one attribution setting, and the dates of any content or template change between them]. Compare volume, engagement and order behaviour across the two matched periods with attribution held constant, split brand and store-name searches from category queries where the records allow it, and mark any period with gaps or incomplete records rather than comparing it as though it were whole. Return a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats, noting any period where the records are incomplete for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why split brand searches from category ones?
faqs.answer: They behave differently: someone searching the store name usually already knows it and follows a different path from someone searching a category need. Combining them lets a shift in brand demand hide movement in the category terms the merchant is trying to win, so the split is reported wherever the records allow it.

faqs.question: What if a site change falls inside one period?
faqs.answer: Record it as a confounder against that period and stop short of attributing the movement to search alone, because the change and the traffic shift cannot be separated using these records. Where possible the comparison is repeated on dates that avoid the change, and the caveat names the change date either way.

faqs.question: Should every landing page be analysed?
faqs.answer: Only those with enough volume to support a statement; the rest is reported as one combined line rather than dropped, so the totals still reconcile. Landing pages whose movement sits inside normal variation are listed without a cause, since a small change on a small page supports no conclusion.

zh_title: 在可比周期内分析自然流量表现
zh_scenarioDescription: 自然搜索带来稳定的访客，但商家缺少等长的对比周期，说不清这个渠道究竟是变好还是变差。此时的首要任务是在可比周期内分析自然流量表现。流程应在归因规则不变的前提下比较两段周期的落地页、会话与订单，产出带口径说明的渠道流量分析。
zh_howToSolve: 先取自然搜索的会话、到达的落地页、记录中带有查询词的部分、归因到这些会话的订单与金额，以及在相同归因设置下两段等长周期，并取两周期之间任何内容或模板改动的日期。再在归因规则保持不变的前提下，比较两段匹配周期的流量规模、互动与下单表现，在记录允许时把搜索店铺名称的品牌词与品类词分开，并把存在缺口或记录不完整的周期单独标注，而不是当作完整周期来比较。最后输出带口径说明的渠道流量分析，只把变化归因到落地页拆分确实支持的那部分，并确认两段周期天数相同，且各周期落地页合计与该周期自然会话总数对得上。

2. 再在归因规则保持不变的前提下，比较两段匹配周期的流量规模、互动与下单表现，在记录允许时把搜索店铺名称的品牌词与品类词分开，并把存在缺口或记录不完整的周期单独标注，而不是当作完整周期来比较。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要分开看品牌词与品类词？
zh_faqs.answer: 两者行为不同：搜索店铺名称的人通常已经认识这家店，转化路径与搜索品类需求的人不一样。混在一起会让品牌需求的变化掩盖商家真正想争取的品类词表现，因此只要记录允许，就应分开报告。

zh_faqs.question: 某段周期内发生了站点改动怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 把该改动记为这段周期的干扰因素，并且不要独自把变化归因于搜索，因为仅凭这些记录无法区分改动与流量变化的影响。若有可能，应避开改动日期重做一次对比，并且无论如何在口径说明中写明改动日期。

zh_faqs.question: 每个落地页都要单独分析吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 只分析流量规模足以支撑判断的页面，其余合并为一行合计而不是省略，这样总数依然能对账。变化幅度落在正常波动内的落地页只列出、不给成因，因为小页面上的小幅变化不足以支撑任何结论。

title: Review keyword performance and identify research priorities
scenarioDescription: A ranking report circulates every month, but nobody can separate the measured movements from the assumed ones. In this case, the immediate task is to review keyword performance and identify research priorities. The workflow should produce a keyword-to-page map and research priorities rechecked against the merchant's own tracking data.
howToSolve: Collect each tracked term with the page assigned to it, the reporting window the merchant's data covers, the source and definition behind every metric in that window (impressions, clicks, position or orders), the matching prior window used as baseline, and the date each term entered tracking so new entries can be separated from established ones. Compare each term against its own baseline in the same window length and on the same page, mark as measured only movements supported by records from both windows, mark as unmeasured any movement where the page assignment, tracking setup or metric definition changed, and set aside terms whose history is too short to compare rather than reading a trend into them. Deliver a keyword-to-page map with each term's measured movement, baseline, evidence source and a research priority, then recheck every claim against the supplied records and list separately the terms marked unmeasured or insufficient.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me review keyword performance and identify research priorities. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [each tracked term with its assigned page, the reporting window the data covers, the source and definition behind every metric in that window, the matching prior window used as baseline, and the date each term entered tracking]. Compare each term against its own baseline in the same window length and on the same page, mark as measured only movements supported by records from both windows, mark as unmeasured any movement where the page assignment, tracking setup or metric definition changed, and set aside terms whose history is too short to compare rather than reading a trend into them. Return the review with research priorities, rechecking each claim against the supplied records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why compare a term only with its own baseline?
faqs.answer: Because a term's movement is only meaningful against the same page and the same window length, and using one shared baseline hides that some pages changed while others did not; where no matching prior window exists the term is recorded as insufficient, not as declining.

faqs.question: How is a ranking change classified as measured or assumed?
faqs.answer: A change counts as measured only when both windows carry records from the same source and definition and the page assignment is unchanged; if the tracking setup, the page or the definition changed in between, the movement is labelled unmeasured and listed for rechecking instead of being reported as a result.

faqs.question: What happens to a term with too little history?
faqs.answer: It is marked insufficient and kept on the map with its page, because sparse records cannot separate a real movement from noise; the term becomes eligible for review once it has a comparable window, and until then no priority is derived from it.

zh_category: 关键词研究与 SEO 机会
zh_title: 复盘关键词表现并确定调研优先级
zh_scenarioDescription: 每月都有一份排名报告在传阅，但哪些变动是实测的、哪些只是推测，谁也分不清。本场景的首要任务是复盘关键词表现并确定调研优先级。产出为关键词到页面的映射与调研优先级，并重新核销到自有的跟踪数据。
zh_howToSolve: 收集每个已跟踪关键词及其归属页面、数据实际覆盖的复盘周期、该周期内每一项指标（展示、点击、排名或订单）的来源与定义、作为基准的上一周期，以及每个词开始被跟踪的日期，以便把新加入的词与已有历史积累的词区分开。把每个词与它在相同周期长度、相同页面上的自身基准做比较，只有在两个周期都有记录支撑的变动才记为实测，凡页面归属、跟踪配置或指标定义发生变化的变动一律记为未实测，历史过短无法比较的词单独搁置，不据此读出趋势。交付关键词到页面的映射，逐词标注实测变动、基准值、证据来源与调研优先级，再对照提供的记录核销每一项判断，并把标记为未实测或数据不足的词单独列出。

可提供的数据：[填写已有资料]

1. 先说明完成该任务需要哪些关键数据，并标记缺失项。
2. 把每个词与它在相同周期长度、相同页面上的自身基准做比较，只有在两个周期都有记录支撑的变动才记为实测，凡页面归属、跟踪配置或指标定义发生变化的变动一律记为未实测，历史过短无法比较的词单独搁置，不据此读出趋势。

5. 如涉及发布、发信、改价、修改商品或账户操作，在我明确授权且工具已连接前，仅输出草案或操作步骤；完成操作后再报告已验证的结果。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么每个词只与自身的基准比较？
zh_faqs.answer: 因为只有在相同页面、相同周期长度下，一个词的变动才有意义，统一套用一个基准会掩盖部分页面已发生变化的事实；若找不到可比的上一周期，该词应记为数据不足，而不是记为下滑。

zh_faqs.question: 排名变动如何判定为实测还是推测？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有当两个周期都来自同一来源、采用同一定义，且页面归属未变时，变动才算实测；若期间的跟踪配置、页面或指标定义发生了变化，该变动标注为未实测并列入待复核，而不作为结论上报。

zh_faqs.question: 历史数据过少的词如何处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 标记为数据不足并连同其归属页面保留在映射中，因为稀疏的记录无法区分真实变动与噪声；待该词积累了可比较的周期后方可纳入复盘，在此之前不从中推导任何优先级。

title: Analyze paid traffic quality and conversion
scenarioDescription: Ad-tagged sessions keep arriving, yet the merchant cannot separate campaigns that produce orders from campaigns that only add visits. In this case, the immediate task is to analyze paid traffic quality and conversion. The workflow should produce a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats, matching each campaign's sessions and orders to its spend.
howToSolve: Collect the campaign-tagged sessions, the tagging parameters each campaign uses, the spend and date ranges recorded for each campaign, the store's order and revenue records, the conversion goal the merchant names and any spend with no tag attached. Match each campaign's sessions, orders and recorded spend inside one common date range, separate the campaigns whose orders the store records from those that only added visits, and flag every campaign whose tags are missing, whose parameters disagree with the naming map, or whose spend dates do not cover the range. Deliver a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats carrying one row per campaign with its sessions, orders and spend, then confirm that the tagged sessions counted equal the sum of the campaign rows and report untagged spend as its own line instead of folding it into a campaign.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me analyze paid traffic quality and conversion. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the campaign-tagged sessions, the tagging parameters each campaign uses, the spend and date ranges recorded for each campaign, the store's order and revenue records, the conversion goal the merchant names, and any spend with no tag attached]. Match each campaign's sessions, orders and recorded spend inside one common date range, separate the campaigns whose orders the store records from those that only added visits, and flag every campaign whose tags are missing, whose parameters disagree with the naming map, or whose spend dates do not cover the range. Return a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats, flagging campaigns whose tags or dates are inconsistent for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why not use the ad platform's conversions?
faqs.answer: The platform and the store attribute differently, so mixing them puts two definitions in one row and neither figure can be checked. The analysis uses the store's own session and order records consistently on both sides and names the attribution setting, keeping the platform figures as a directional cross-check in the caveats.

faqs.question: What if a campaign's dates do not match its spend?
faqs.answer: Flag the row and leave the comparison uncomputed, because a ratio built across mismatched ranges describes neither period. The report sets the two ranges side by side and asks for the corrected spend dates, rather than stretching one side so the row looks complete.

faqs.question: Can a campaign with no orders still be worth keeping?
faqs.answer: It is reported as producing no orders inside the window rather than as a failure, since the merchant's stated goal and the length of the buying cycle decide its value. The row keeps its sessions and spend so the decision is made on record, and the caveats note where the window is too short to judge it.

zh_faqs.question: 为什么不直接用广告平台的转化数据？
zh_faqs.answer: 平台与店铺的归因口径不同，混用会让同一行里出现两套定义，两个数字都无法核验。分析始终统一使用店铺自身的会话与订单记录，并写明归因设置；平台数据只作为方向性交叉核对，记入口径说明。

zh_faqs.question: 活动的日期与支出记录对不上怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 标记该行并不计算对比值，因为跨不匹配区间算出的比值对哪一段都不成立。报告会把两个日期区间并排列出，并请补齐正确的支出日期，而不是拉伸其中一侧让这一行看起来完整。

zh_faqs.question: 没有带来订单的活动还值得保留吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 报告只说明它在该时间窗内没有产生订单，而不直接判为失败，因为价值取决于商家设定的目标与购买周期的长短。该行保留会话与支出，让决策有据可依，并在口径说明中注明时间窗过短、尚不足以评判的情况。

title: Compare traffic from social media sources

Deliver a channel traffic analysis with measurement caveats carrying one row per platform with its volume, engagement and orders, then confirm that the tagged sessions per platform reconcile with that platform's total and note the platforms where untagged visits make up most of the traffic.

faqs.question: Why does one platform show sessions but no posts?
faqs.answer: Usually because the visits are untagged, paid, or shared onward where no link parameter survives, so the report records the platform total and leaves the gap unexplained. Showing the tagged and untagged rows side by side tells the merchant how much of that platform's traffic can be attributed at all.

faqs.question: Should traffic be attributed to single posts?
faqs.answer: Only where the merchant records which link or parameter each post used, otherwise a post-level split would be invented. Where that record exists the movement is matched to the publish date, and where it does not the platform is reported as a whole with the posting schedule attached as context.

faqs.question: How is a viral post told from a campaign?
faqs.answer: By timing and tagging together: a paid push carries parameters and spend on the same dates, while a post that spreads carries neither. Where the timing matches an untagged post, the movement is marked as suspected rather than confirmed, and the report names the evidence that would settle it.

zh_title: 对比各社交媒体来源的流量
zh_scenarioDescription: 同一周内内容在多个社交平台发布，各自带来不同流量，商家需要判断下一轮投放该押在哪个平台。此时的首要任务是对比各社交媒体来源的流量。流程应把平台的规模与订单表现对应到当时发布的内容，产出带口径说明的渠道流量分析。
zh_howToSolve: 先收集各社交平台记录的会话、互动与订单、所用的活动标记与链接参数、含每条内容发布日期的发布排期，以及该时间窗内商家在各平台上投放的付费与自然运营动作。再从流量规模、互动与下单表现对比各平台，只有在发布日期与变化时间都能在商家记录中吻合时才把变化归因到某条内容，并始终把付费访问与未标记的免费访问分开。最后输出带口径说明的渠道流量分析，每个平台一行并给出规模、互动与订单，核对各平台带标记的会话数与该平台总数一致，并注明哪些平台的流量主要来自未标记访问。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么某个平台有会话却没有对应内容发布？
zh_faqs.answer: 通常因为这些访问未加标记、属于付费投放，或是被二次分享后链接参数丢失，因此报告只记录该平台总量并保留未解释的部分。把已标记与未标记两行并排展示，能让商家看清这个平台的流量究竟有多少可以归因。

zh_faqs.question: 流量应归因到单条内容吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有在商家记录了每条内容使用的链接或参数时才做，否则单条级别的拆分就是凭空编造。有该记录时把变化与发布日期匹配；没有时则按平台整体报告，并把发布排期作为背景附上。

zh_faqs.question: 如何区分爆款内容与付费投放？
zh_faqs.answer: 同时看时间与标记：付费投放会在相同日期上带有参数与支出记录，而自然传播的内容两者都没有。若时间只与一条未带标记的内容吻合，则该变化标记为疑似而非已确认，并注明还能用什么证据来定论。

faqs.question: Should referrals from the store's own domain be removed?
faqs.answer: Flag them rather than delete them, because they usually mark a payment or redirect step that breaks the session instead of a real referring site. The row keeps its volume and is noted as a self-referral, so the reconciliation still balances and whoever fixes the tagging can see how much traffic the break was moving.

faqs.question: How is an unrecognised domain judged?
faqs.answer: Against the partnership and affiliate records first; if nothing names it, the domain keeps its own row with its landing pages and order behaviour instead of being folded into a partner bucket. Volume alone never promotes a domain to known partner, and the caveats list unresolved domains for the merchant to confirm.

faqs.question: Can tagging move traffic out of referrals?
faqs.answer: Yes. Once a link carries campaign parameters the visit is reclassified to that campaign, so a domain can appear to lose traffic that was merely relabelled. The report names the tagging changes on record in the window and compares channel totals before and after, rather than reading the change as a drop in referrals.

zh_faqs.question: 来自店铺自身域名的引荐要剔除吗？

zh_faqs.question: 陌生域名该如何判定？

zh_faqs.question: 加标记会让流量从引荐渠道流失吗？

title: Reconcile marketing attribution with store outcomes
scenarioDescription: Each platform reports its own conversions, and several of them claim the same order as their own win. In this case, the immediate task is to reconcile marketing attribution with store outcomes. The workflow should produce a record-level reconciliation showing matched orders, overlaps and unmatched claims against the merchant's own data.
howToSolve: Collect each platform's reported conversions with their timestamps and order identifiers where present, the matching store orders, and the attribution window and model in force. Match platform claims to store orders on order identifier, timestamp and currency, then separate the rows into matched, overlapping where several platforms claim one order, and unmatched where no store order supports the claim, rather than netting the totals. Deliver a record-level reconciliation with a channel return view built only on matched rows, then reconcile the matched total against the order export and list every unmatched claim with its platform and period.

Match platform claims to store orders on order identifier, timestamp and currency, then separate the rows into matched, overlapping where several platforms claim one order, and unmatched where no store order supports the claim, rather than netting the totals. Return the reconciliation and channel return report for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why does attributed revenue exceed store sales?
faqs.answer: Overlap is the usual cause, because platforms credit the same order under different windows. The reconciliation keeps the overlaps visible instead of averaging them away, so the return figure counts each order once while the claim count stays auditable.

faqs.question: Is one attribution model correct?
faqs.answer: No model is universally right, so pick one, apply it to every channel in the report, and record the choice with the results. The comparison stays valid across periods only while the model and window stay unchanged.

faqs.question: What happens to orders with no platform claim?
faqs.answer: Keep them in a separate unattributed group. They are real revenue the platforms did not credit, and excluding them would make the return figure look better than the business actually performed.

zh_faqs.question: 为什么归因收入合计会超过店铺销售额？

zh_faqs.question: 是否存在唯一正确的归因模型？

zh_faqs.question: 没有平台认领的订单如何处理？

title: Build a campaign performance dashboard
scenarioDescription: Reporting is scattered and no single view answers the daily questions, so the metrics to show must follow the decisions they support. In this case, the immediate task is to build a campaign performance dashboard. The workflow should return a layout grouped by funnel stage, with a definition and source for every metric.
howToSolve: Record the decisions the dashboard has to support each day, the metrics and breakdowns each decision needs, the source report standing behind every metric, and the reporting timezone and currency the sources share. Group the metrics by funnel stage with one denominator written beside every rate, and mark any metric whose source report is missing, delayed or collected on a different calendar as unavailable rather than zero so no tile shows a figure that no record supports. Deliver the dashboard layout with a definition and a source for every metric, then verify it by rebuilding one reporting window from the raw source reports and confirming that each tile reproduces the same figure.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period].
