zh_faqs.question: 什么依据才能让内容离开某个状态？
zh_faqs.answer: 每次流转都要事先写明它所需的依据，例如必填字段是否完成、素材是否已附上、该条目的审批是否已记录。依据必须落在记录里而不是口头确认，这样日志日后才能复算；凡商家没有定义检查项的流转，一律标注为未定义，而不是默认它可以通过。

zh_faqs.question: 撰写人可以审批自己的内容吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 在商家设定的流程里，审批是与撰写分开的角色，审批人会被记录在条目上。角色分离能让这道检查真正起到复核作用；若确有一人身兼两职，也应由商家明确决定，且日志中仍要显示审批人，让这个例外始终可见。

zh_faqs.question: 流转被驳回后条目会怎样？
zh_faqs.answer: 被驳回的流转会把条目留在原有状态，并把阻塞的检查项、原因和时间戳写入日志。没有依据就不会推进，也不会自动重试，因为自动重试可能把审核人已经否决的内容发布出去；只有在相应检查项于后续运行通过后条目才会前进。

title: Build a relevant keyword research shortlist
scenarioDescription: Research tends to start from whatever terms someone remembers rather than from what the store actually sells. In this case, the immediate task is to build a relevant keyword research shortlist. The workflow should produce a keyword-to-page map and research priorities anchored in the merchant's own catalog.
howToSolve: Gather the seed terms already on record, the product catalog with its categories and attributes, the target market and language, and any keyword evidence the merchant holds, recording for each seed term where it came from so the source can be cited later. Match every candidate term to at least one live catalog item or a planned one, group terms by the buying task behind them, and drop terms with no plausible catalog match or whose intent the store cannot serve, marking the dropped ones with the reason rather than deleting them silently. Deliver a ranked research shortlist with each term's matched catalog items, intended page, evidence and confidence, then verify the term count against the seed list plus expansions and confirm every retained term traces to a real catalog item and a stated source.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me build a relevant keyword research shortlist. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the seed terms on record with their origin, the product catalog with categories and attributes, the target market and language, and any keyword evidence the merchant holds]. Match every candidate term to at least one live catalog item or a planned one, group terms by the buying task behind them, and drop terms with no plausible catalog match or whose intent the store cannot serve, marking the dropped ones with the reason rather than deleting them silently. Return a ranked research shortlist with page assignments, with scope verified against the merchant's records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is relevance to the catalog decided?
faqs.answer: A term is kept when at least one live catalog item can answer it under its own attributes, and it is dropped when the store can only serve it by stretching a category; the reason is recorded for every dropped term, so the decision can be revisited when the catalog changes.

faqs.question: Should terms with no evidence still appear?
faqs.answer: Yes, as candidates marked unmeasured, because excluding them hides demand the tracking data has not yet covered; they sit in a separate section of the shortlist and carry no priority until the merchant's records or a later review supports them.

faqs.question: What stops the shortlist from drifting back to broad head terms?
faqs.answer: Require each entry to name the catalog items and the buyer task behind it; a broad category word survives only where it maps to a real collection page, and anything that needs a new page is labelled with the page it would require.

zh_faqs.question: 关键词与商品目录的相关性如何判定？

zh_faqs.question: 还没有数据支撑的词是否应保留？

zh_faqs.question: 如何避免清单又退回宽泛的大词？

title: Group search terms by shared intent
scenarioDescription: A raw export mixes informational lookups with purchase-ready searches, so one page ends up serving several intents at once. In this case, the immediate task is to group search terms by shared intent. The workflow should produce a keyword-to-page map and research priorities built from the merchant's own term list and catalog.
howToSolve: Collect the raw term list with any evidence attached, the product catalog and collection structure, the pages the store already publishes, and the audience descriptions on record, noting for each term the wording and the page it currently lands on. Cluster terms by the task and page intent behind them rather than by shared wording, keep brand terms apart from generic ones, assign each cluster to exactly one existing or intended page, and split any cluster whose members require different answers on the same page. Deliver a keyword-to-page map listing every cluster with its member terms, the assigned page, the intent statement and the terms left unassigned, then verify that the term count across clusters equals the input list and that no page carries two clusters with conflicting intent.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me group search terms by shared intent. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the raw term list with attached evidence, the catalog and collection structure, the pages the store already publishes, and the audience descriptions on record]. Cluster terms by the task and page intent behind them rather than by shared wording, keep brand terms apart from generic ones, assign each cluster to exactly one existing or intended page, and split any cluster whose members require different answers on the same page. Return a keyword-to-page map and research priorities verified against the supplied records, noting any assignment gap for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why not cluster on shared wording alone?
faqs.answer: Shared wording often covers different intents, so a cluster built on wording puts buyers with opposite needs on one page; the test is whether one page can answer every member, and where it cannot, the cluster is split even if the terms look alike.

faqs.question: Where do brand terms go?
faqs.answer: Keep them in their own cluster mapped to the brand or store page, because visitors searching a name expect that destination and not a category answer; mixing them into a generic cluster makes the page try to serve both, which weakens the match for the generic terms.

faqs.question: What happens to a term that fits nowhere?
faqs.answer: It is listed as unassigned with the reason, usually a missing page or an intent the catalog does not serve; unassigned terms become either a content request or evidence that the term should leave the list, but they are never forced into a neighbouring cluster.

zh_faqs.question: 为什么不按措辞相似来聚类？
zh_faqs.answer: 措辞相似的词往往对应不同意图，按措辞聚类会把需求相反的买家放到同一个页面上；判据是这个页面能否回答所有成员词，若不能，即使这些词看起来很像也应拆分。

zh_faqs.question: 品牌词应该放在哪里？
zh_faqs.answer: 单独聚为一类并映射到品牌页或店铺首页，因为搜索品牌名的访客期待的是这个落地页，而不是某个类目答案；把品牌词混入通用聚类会让页面两头兼顾，反而削弱对通用词的匹配。

zh_faqs.question: 无处归属的词怎么处理？

title: Identify specific long-tail search questions
scenarioDescription: Specific buyer questions bring the most qualified visitors, yet the content plan still covers only broad head terms. In this case, the immediate task is to identify specific long-tail search questions. The workflow should produce a keyword-to-page map and research priorities checked against the merchant's own catalog.
howToSolve: Gather the catalog with its attributes and variants, the support questions and customer language the merchant has on record, the audience and market, and any keyword evidence available, keeping every candidate phrase with the record it was drawn from. Keep phrases that name a concrete need, product, attribute or situation and can be answered by a specific catalog item or existing page, separate them from broad category words, and mark as unmeasured demand any specific phrase the merchant's records do not yet show being searched. Deliver a keyword-to-page map with each specific phrase's matched item or page, the question it answers and its measured or unmeasured status, then verify that every retained phrase traces to a catalog item or a recorded customer question and that no broad head term was left in the list.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me identify specific long-tail search questions. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the catalog with attributes and variants, the support questions and customer language on record, the audience and market, and any keyword evidence available]. Keep phrases that name a concrete need, product, attribute or situation and can be answered by a specific catalog item or existing page, separate them from broad category words, and mark as unmeasured demand any specific phrase the merchant's records do not yet show being searched. Return a keyword-to-page map and research priorities, checking each long-tail term against the supplied records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How specific must a phrase be to count as long-tail?
faqs.answer: It has to name something a buyer would actually ask about: a product, an attribute, a use case or a situation; a single category word stays on the head-term side, and a phrase that only adds a modifier without changing the answer is treated as a variant of the head term.

faqs.question: Where should candidate long-tail questions come from?
faqs.answer: From the catalog attributes, support tickets, review language and the audience notes the merchant already holds, because those show how buyers describe the need; invented phrasings are excluded, or labelled as hypotheses when the merchant wants them tested.

faqs.question: When should a long-tail phrase get its own page?
faqs.answer: Only when no existing page answers it well and the catalog can carry the topic on its own; where several phrases share one intent they extend a current page, and a phrase needing a page the merchant will not build is recorded as a content request rather than a live priority.

zh_faqs.question: 一条短语要多具体才算长尾？

zh_faqs.question: 候选的具体提问应该从哪里提炼？

zh_faqs.question: 什么情况下长尾短语需要独立页面？

title: Draft useful SEO content around a defined intent
scenarioDescription: Pages are being written around a keyword list, so the copy reads as filler and covers the same ground twice. In this case, the immediate task is to draft useful SEO content around a defined intent. The workflow should produce an article brief or draft noting which statements still require support from the records.
howToSolve: Collect the target intent and the role this page plays in the site, the product facts and records available to support statements, the pages already covering nearby topics, and the internal destinations a reader should reach next. Write to that intent in natural language, cut any sentence added only to carry a phrase, and mark each remaining statement the supplied records do not yet support. Deliver the article brief or draft with an unsupported-statement list naming the record that would settle each one, confirm the page answers the intent without sending the reader elsewhere, and note which existing page it overlaps.

faqs.question: How is keyword stuffing avoided?
faqs.answer: By writing the answer first and treating the phrase as a description of intent; a sentence stays only if it still reads naturally to a visitor, and any phrase placed for its own sake is cut.

faqs.question: What should happen to an unsupported statement?
faqs.answer: It is listed with the record that could support it and either sourced before publishing or removed, because an unsourced claim is the part of the page most likely to be challenged later.

faqs.question: How is the page checked against existing coverage?
faqs.answer: Its intent is compared with the pages the store already publishes, and where two pages serve the same intent one is consolidated or given a narrower scope rather than left competing.

faqs.question: Should every variant share one page title?
faqs.answer: Shared titles waste matches on variant-specific searches, so include the distinguishing attribute where the merchant's rules allow it. Apply the pattern uniformly across the catalog so titles do not end up half-specific and half-generic.

faqs.question: Does repeating a keyword improve relevance?
faqs.answer: Repetition reads as padding and rarely improves matching. The stronger change is covering the real attributes buyers search on, such as material, use case and compatible models, because those match distinct queries instead of one repeated term.

faqs.question: What should happen when the intended search intent is unclear?
faqs.answer: Record it as unresolved and propose the most likely intent grounded in the product facts. Forcing a guessed intent into the copy pulls in traffic the page cannot satisfy, which shows up as visits that leave without engaging.

zh_faqs.question: 重复关键词能提升相关性吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 堆砌读起来像凑字数，也难得提升匹配。更有效的改动是覆盖买家真正会搜的属性，如材质、用途和兼容型号，它们匹配的是不同搜索词而不是同一个词的反复出现。

zh_faqs.question: 目标搜索意图不明确时怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 记为未解决项，并依据商品事实给出最可能的意图。把猜的意图硬写进文案会引来页面满足不了的流量，表现为访客进来不做任何互动就离开。

faqs.question: How do two overlapping collections get separated?
faqs.answer: By giving each a distinct intent and a product membership that follows it, or by merging them and redirecting the losing URL. Leaving both live on the same term means neither can settle, so a decision is recorded for every competing pair rather than deferred.

faqs.question: Where does the target term belong on the page?
faqs.answer: In the title element, the URL handle and the opening copy where it reads naturally, once each. Repeating it through every paragraph does not strengthen the page and usually signals that the copy was written for a search engine instead of the shopper choosing a product.

faqs.question: What happens to collections created for internal reasons?
faqs.answer: They are judged on whether they serve any buyer search. Those without a distinct intent are merged into a related page with a redirect or excluded, while pages serving a genuine subspace keep their membership rewritten to match the title they carry.

zh_faqs.question: 目标词应出现在页面的哪些位置？

zh_faqs.question: 出于内部原因创建的集合页怎么处理？

For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: What must generated collection copy never assert?
faqs.answer: Anything about price, availability, delivery time or materials the product records do not state. Those values move without the copy moving, so each claim has to trace to a supplied field, or the sentence stays empty and flagged for the merchant to fill.

faqs.question: How much introductory copy is enough?
faqs.answer: Enough to explain what the collection contains and how the options differ, and nothing added merely to reach a length. Sentences that only restate the title belong below the grid or nowhere, because padding dilutes the specific detail the shopper came for.

faqs.question: Can the draft be published as generated?
faqs.answer: No, it must be re-read against the live product list first. A draft built from a stale extract can describe items the collection no longer includes, or omit the variants that now carry the page, so verification precedes publication every time.

zh_faqs.question: 生成的集合页文案绝不能断言什么？
zh_faqs.answer: 不能断言商品记录里没有的价格、可售状态、配送时长或材质。这些数值变化时文案不会同步更新，因此每处表述都必须能追溯到某个提供的字段，否则该句应留空并标记等待商家填写。

zh_faqs.question: 开头文案写多少才够？
zh_faqs.answer: 讲清这个系列包含什么、各选项有何区别即可，不要为了达到篇幅而追加内容。只复述标题的句子应放在商品网格下方或干脆删掉，因为填充会把买家真正需要的具体信息冲淡。

zh_faqs.question: 生成的草稿可以直接发布吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不可以，必须先用最新的商品清单复核一遍。基于过期数据写出的草稿可能描述了集合早已移除的商品，也可能漏掉现在撑起这个页面的变体，因此核验必须排在发布之前。

faqs.question: Where should the answer sit on the page?
faqs.answer: Directly under the first heading that matches the query, because an answer placed several scrolls down is effectively invisible to a reader who arrives with that question and leaves without finding it.

faqs.question: Should a new post be written for a query already ranking?
faqs.answer: No. The existing article is strengthened first and keeps the query, since adding a second page splits attention and leaves it unclear which one should be shown to the reader.

faqs.question: How are internal links chosen?
faqs.answer: By the next question a reader will have, so a link sits inside the section that raises it; links repeating one destination add nothing and only dilute the useful ones.

title: Identify useful internal linking opportunities
scenarioDescription: Key pages sit buried with almost no internal links leading to them, and past link lists were full of unjustifiable suggestions. In this case, the immediate task is to identify useful internal linking opportunities. The workflow should test each candidate link against the existing paths and keep only those that genuinely help a shopper or crawler arrive.
howToSolve: Take the priority pages, the existing link inventory with the anchor text in use, the navigation and collection paths that already reach them, the click depth of each page from the home page and the canonical each page declares. Keep a candidate link only where the source page is topically related to the target, the link creates the first path or shortens the depth recorded for that target and the target is the canonical the merchant intends, dropping any link that leaves reachability unchanged or points at a duplicate URL. Deliver a URL-level diagnosis with evidence and follow-up checks in which each suggested link names its source page, the depth before and after and the reason it qualifies, then confirm that every source page exists and is indexable and that the counted depth after the change matches the number of paths actually added.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me identify useful internal linking opportunities. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the priority pages, the existing link inventory with the anchor text in use, the navigation and collection paths that already reach them, the click depth of each page from the home page, and the canonical each page declares]. Keep a candidate link only where the source page is topically related to the target, the link creates the first path or shortens the depth recorded for that target and the target is the canonical the merchant intends, dropping any link that leaves reachability unchanged or points at a duplicate URL. Return a URL-level diagnosis with evidence and follow-up checks, with each suggested link tied to its source page for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: When does a link actually help?
faqs.answer: When it changes reachability: it either creates the first path to a page that had none or shortens the depth already recorded for it, and the source is topically related enough that a shopper would follow it. A link between two pages already one step apart adds nothing, so it is rejected with that reason.

faqs.question: Should the link go in a template or in page copy?
faqs.answer: Record which one, because they behave differently: a template link appears across a whole section and scales at once, while a link in page copy carries context and reads as a next step. Both count toward depth, so each suggestion names its placement and template links are flagged where they would repeat on unintended pages.

faqs.question: Does a link from an excluded page help?
faqs.answer: Barely. A source page the merchant does not intend to be public offers little to a crawler that may never return to it, so the suggestion is marked low value instead of counted as a new path. Where the same target can be reached from an indexable page, that link is preferred and the excluded source is listed as an alternative.

zh_faqs.question: 什么样的链接才算真正有用？

zh_faqs.question: 链接应放在模板里还是正文里？
zh_faqs.answer: 要记录清楚，因为两者表现不同：模板链接会在整个版块同时出现、可批量生效；正文链接则带有语境，读起来像一个自然的下一步。两者都会影响深度，因此每条建议都要写明版位类型，并对会出现在商家未预期页面上的模板链接加以标记。

zh_faqs.question: 来自被排除页面的链接有用吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 作用很小。抓取程序未必会回访商家并不打算公开的来源页，因此这类建议标为低价值，而不计入新增路径。若同一目标还能从可收录的页面到达，就优先采用那条链接，把被排除的来源页作为备选列出。

title: Find actionable SEO content and metadata issues

faqs.question: How does the backlog enter the ranking?
faqs.answer: Each backlog entry is first classified as confirmed or unconfirmed against the records the merchant holds, and only confirmed issues are ranked, by evidence strength and fix effort on the stated scale. Unconfirmed entries move to a separate list with the check they still need. This keeps the week's shortlist defensible.

faqs.question: What separates a confirmed issue from an assumption?
faqs.answer: A confirmed issue can be pointed to in the records: the field that is empty, the pages that share a title, the heading that is missing. An assumption is a claim with no record behind it yet. The shortlist names the record for every confirmed item, so a developer can verify any line before spending time on it.

faqs.question: What does the shortlist record per finding?
faqs.answer: The affected URLs, the evidence and where it sits, the proposed fix, the effort grade on the merchant's stated scale, and the rank position. Unconfirmed items carry the missing check instead of a fix. With those fields a reviewer can challenge any ranking without reopening the whole backlog.

zh_faqs.question: 问题清单如何进入排序？

zh_faqs.question: 已确认问题与推测的分界在哪里？
zh_faqs.answer: 已确认问题能在记录中指出：哪个字段为空、哪些页面共用标题、哪个标题层级缺失；推测是尚无记录支撑的说法。短名单为每条已确认项注明其记录出处，开发者动手前可以逐条核实。

zh_faqs.question: 短名单为每条发现记录什么？
zh_faqs.answer: 受影响URL、证据及其出处、修复建议、按商家等级标注的成本，以及排序位置。未确认项记录的是尚缺的核查而不是修复建议。凭借这些字段，复核者可以质疑任何一项排序而不必重开整份清单。

title: Identify unanswered topics in the existing content
scenarioDescription: Existing guides keep circling the same handful of topics while buyers ask things no page answers. In this case, the immediate task is to identify unanswered topics in the existing content. The workflow should produce a keyword-to-page map and research priorities derived from the merchant's own pages and keyword evidence.
howToSolve: List every published page with its URL, handle, target topic and the terms it currently ranks for or is assigned, together with the catalog collections it covers and the keyword evidence the merchant holds for those topics. Mark as a gap each buyer question that no published page answers in its own copy, distinguishing it from a term that is simply absent while the answer already exists, rank the gaps by catalog coverage and the evidence held, and mark unsupported ones as hypotheses. Deliver a keyword-to-page map showing each gap with the question, the page that should own it or the new page it requires, the evidence and the priority, then confirm every gap traces to a published page's missing answer and that no mapped term duplicates an existing page's target.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Mark as a gap each buyer question that no published page answers in its own copy, distinguishing it from a term that is simply absent while the answer already exists, rank the gaps by catalog coverage and the evidence held, and mark unsupported ones as hypotheses. Return a keyword-to-page map and research priorities confirmed against the supplied records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How do we tell a gap from a page that just ranks poorly?
faqs.answer: A gap is a question no published copy answers at all, while a ranking problem is an answered question that is not being found; the first need is new or extended content, the second is a page or promotion issue, and the two go into different backlogs.

faqs.question: Should a gap always close with a new page?
faqs.answer: No: when an existing page already targets the same intent, the cheaper fix is to extend that page's answer, and a new page is reserved for a question no current page can absorb without competing with its own target term.

faqs.question: What keeps the gap list evidence-based?
faqs.answer: Every gap cites the record that supports it, such as a term with tracked data or a repeated customer question, and anything without such a source is labelled a hypothesis and ranked below the evidenced items rather than being presented as a finding.

zh_faqs.question: 内容缺口与页面排名不佳如何区分？
zh_faqs.answer: 缺口是现有文案完全没有回答的问题，排名不佳则是答案已存在却没有被找到：前者需要新增或扩充内容，后者属于页面或推广问题，两者应进入不同的待办清单。

zh_faqs.question: 缺口是否都要靠新建页面来补？
zh_faqs.answer: 不一定。若现有页面已经面向同一意图，成本更低的做法是扩充该页的回答；只有当没有任何现有页面能在不与自身目标词冲突的前提下承接该问题时，才新建页面。

zh_faqs.question: 如何保证缺口清单有据可依？
zh_faqs.answer: 每个缺口都引用支撑它的记录，例如有跟踪数据的关键词或反复出现的顾客提问；找不到这类来源的项标注为假设，排序低于有证据的项，不作为结论呈现。

title: Find keyword opportunities that fit the catalog
scenarioDescription: Topic ideas arrive from generic tools without anyone checking whether the store actually sells anything matching them. In this case, the immediate task is to find keyword opportunities that fit the catalog. The workflow should produce the opportunity shortlist and research priorities rooted in the merchant's own product attributes.
howToSolve: Start from the catalog's categories, the product attributes and variants actually in stock, the audience and buyer stages the merchant describes, and the keyword evidence supplied, recording which items are live and which are only planned. Test each candidate term against those items by asking which live product or collection would win the click and whether the store can serve the intent behind it, keeping only terms with a concrete destination and dropping or deferring terms whose best match is out of stock or unplanned. Deliver the opportunity shortlist with each term's destination page, matched items, intent, supporting evidence and expected buyer stage, then verify against the supplied catalog that every listed destination exists or is explicitly marked as to be built, and that no term points at a discontinued item.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the catalog's categories, the product attributes and variants actually in stock, the audience and buyer stages the merchant describes, and the supplied keyword evidence]. Test each candidate term against those items by asking which live product or collection would win the click and whether the store can serve the intent behind it, keeping only terms with a concrete destination and dropping or deferring terms whose best match is out of stock or unplanned. Return the opportunity shortlist mapped to pages, verified against the catalog and supplied evidence for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is an opportunity different from any keyword with volume?
faqs.answer: An opportunity must have a destination the store can serve now: a live product, collection or page that answers the intent; a term whose best match is a discontinued item or an unbuilt page is recorded as deferred, with the missing piece named.

faqs.question: Should terms be judged on volume before fit?
faqs.answer: Fit first, because traffic that lands on a page with nothing to buy wastes the visit; volume then orders the shortlist among terms that already fit, and a low-volume term with an exact catalog match can outrank a broader one.

faqs.question: How do we avoid two pages chasing the same term?
faqs.answer: Assign one owner page per term in the shortlist and mark close variants as secondary to it, so the map shows which page should rank; where two existing pages already target the same intent, the overlap is flagged for consolidation instead of adding a third.

zh_faqs.question: 关键词机会与「有搜索量的词」有什么不同？

zh_faqs.question: 应该先看搜索量还是先看匹配度？

zh_faqs.question: 如何避免两个页面争抢同一个词？

title: Plan a homepage that guides visitors to relevant products
scenarioDescription: Visitors land on a homepage showing products but not which entry point suits their purpose. In this case, the immediate task is to plan a homepage that guides visitors to relevant products. The workflow should produce a homepage structure and content draft, ordering sections around visitor tasks using the merchant's own positioning and product groups.
howToSolve: Collect the brand positioning statement, the main audiences in priority order, the product groups each audience buys from, the offers currently active and the imagery cleared for homepage use. Order sections so each audience's first question is answered at the point it arises, giving every product group one entry path, and place time-bound offers only where they serve a task shared by most visitors. Deliver a homepage structure and content draft naming the audience task, the product group and the entry path per section, then check every section against the catalogue and report groups left without a path.

Order sections so each audience's first question is answered at the point it arises, giving every product group one entry path, and place time-bound offers only where they serve a task shared by most visitors. Return a homepage structure and content draft for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. faqs.question: How many sections should the homepage carry?
faqs.answer: One section per audience task that has a product group behind it and no more, because extra sections compete for the same click and dilute the entry paths that actually match how visitors arrive.

faqs.question: Where does the primary audience's entry point go?
faqs.answer: High enough to be seen without scrolling past an unrelated message, since the priority audience should not scroll through another audience's task to reach its own, but after the positioning line that frames the store.

faqs.question: What if two audiences want the same product group?
faqs.answer: Keep one entry path and let the section copy address the shared intent, because duplicating the group splits clicks and makes the same products look like two different promises.

faqs.question: How is a layout chosen when several look workable?
faqs.answer: Pick the one whose slots hold the priority tasks at the depth they need, because a layout that fits the copy only after trimming product detail has quietly reordered the merchandising plan instead of serving it.

faqs.question: Does catalogue breadth change which template fits?

faqs.answer: Record it as a gap with the task it was meant to serve, then either place that task in the closest supported slot or flag the theme limitation, rather than filling a slot with content serving no task.

zh_faqs.question: 多个版式看起来都可行时如何取舍？
zh_faqs.answer: 选择版块位能以所需深度承载优先任务的那个，因为要靠删减商品细节才装得下文案的版式，实际上已经悄悄重排了陈列规划，而不是在服务于它。

zh_faqs.question: 商品目录广度会影响模板选择吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 目录广需要能暴露多个入口和搜索引导的版块位，目录窄则适合直接展示大部分商品的模板，因此广度要先于任何版式特性来核查。

zh_faqs.question: 主题中没有所需的版块怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 把它记为缺口并注明原本要承担的任务，然后将该任务放入最接近的可用版块位，或者直接标注主题限制，而不是用没有任务的内容填满版块位。

faqs.question: How specific should delivery wording be?

faqs.answer: Close to the point of hesitation, usually after the product sections, and always in the exact wording of the policy record rather than a shortened version that quietly drops a condition.

faqs.question: What makes a claim removable?
faqs.answer: Anything stating a fact, price or commitment with no matching record, such as a quality or speed claim the merchant cannot evidence; softening the wording is not enough, the line is deleted and logged.

zh_faqs.question: 配送表述应具体到什么程度？

zh_faqs.question: 保障与退货说明应放在哪里？

faqs.question: Should the page carry the store navigation?
faqs.answer: Only where the campaign intent allows it: a page serving one offer works better with the exits the merchant has chosen to keep, while a page meant to introduce the brand can retain navigation; the rule is that every exit must be a deliberate choice, not a default.

faqs.question: Where does the primary button go?
faqs.answer: Once above the fold for visitors who already decided, and again after the proof section for those who need it, always with the same wording as the campaign; placing it only at the end forces a decided visitor to scroll past content they did not need.

faqs.question: How many offers can one page promote?
faqs.answer: One primary offer, because two offers make the visitor compare instead of act; supporting points may explain the offer's terms or prove it, but any second promotion belongs on its own page or in a later message.

zh_faqs.question: 页面上要不要保留店铺导航？

zh_faqs.question: 主按钮应该放在哪些位置？

zh_faqs.question: 一个页面可以推多少个优惠？

title: Design a controlled landing-page experiment
scenarioDescription: A rebuilt landing page is ready, but the change and the measurement rule were never written down. In this case, the immediate task is to design a controlled landing-page experiment. The workflow should produce an A/B test plan and decision framework, using the merchant's own page records, traffic split and observation window.
howToSolve: Collect the control and variant landing pages, the single change that separates them, the assignment rule and traffic split, the primary metric with its guardrails, and the merchant's stated observation window and stopping rule. Assign each visitor by a stable rule that keeps them in one variant for the whole window, measure the primary metric with one definition throughout, and stop early only on a stated guardrail breach or a confirmed setup error, recording any other early stop as invalid. Deliver an A/B test plan with the decision framework including the rule for inconclusive results, verify the assignment and metric definitions against the supplied page records, and report the outcome with the audience actually tested named.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me design a controlled landing-page experiment. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the control and variant landing pages, the single change separating them, the assignment rule and traffic split, the primary metric with its guardrails, and the merchant's stated observation window and stopping rule]. Assign each visitor by a stable rule that keeps them in one variant for the whole window, measure the primary metric with one definition throughout, and stop early only on a stated guardrail breach or a confirmed setup error, recording any other early stop as invalid. Return an A/B test plan and decision framework for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How are visitors kept in one variant?
faqs.answer: Assignment uses a stable rule recorded per visitor so they see the same variant for the whole window, because reassigning mid-run mixes the two experiences and neither result can be trusted; visitors who clear their identifier are counted once and those switching variants are excluded from the analysis.

faqs.question: Can the test cover only new visitors?
faqs.answer: It can, provided the plan says so, since returning visitors arrive with expectations the variant may not meet and behave differently; the finding then applies only to the audience actually tested, and the plan states that boundary rather than letting it be read as store-wide.

faqs.question: When is an early stop allowed?
faqs.answer: Only for a stated guardrail breach or a confirmed setup error such as a variant that does not render, because stopping when the result merely looks favourable captures a random high and the decision does not hold; any other early stop is marked invalid and the run is repeated.

faqs.question: When is a rebuild justified?

faqs.answer: The shape of the product data: how many items the set holds, which attributes vary and whether the images share one aspect ratio. A template that only looks right but relies on comparison fields the catalog lacks will fail the moment real products are loaded.

faqs.question: When should a plain grid template be ruled out?
faqs.answer: When shoppers must compare two or three attributes to choose, or when the set mixes portrait, square and landscape images. A dense grid crops precisely the difference that carries the decision, leaving products that look interchangeable.

faqs.question: How is a template rolled out safely?
faqs.answer: Onto one representative collection first, then check the rendered page against the product list to confirm every filter, badge and variant still displays. Only after that pass should the layout be extended to further collections.

faqs.question: Which content deserves a reusable section?

zh_faqs.question: 响应式布局必须覆盖哪些尺寸？

zh_faqs.question: 移动端可以调整版块顺序吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 可以调整，前提是桌面端出现的每个版块在手机上仍然可达，因为重排正是为了让关键控件留在可触达的位置；不允许为省空间而删除版块，除非商家规则允许，且这种删除要在交付物中列明。

zh_faqs.question: 记录缺少配套图片时怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 模板中为无图片的记录定义兜底方案，使版块仍能正常渲染，因为资源缺失会留下布局并未考虑的空洞；走了兜底的记录会单独列出以便商家补齐，页面本身不会仅因缺图而被搁置。

zh_faqs.question: 第一批应该覆盖哪些页面？

faqs.question: What blocks a page from publishing?
faqs.answer: Any failed required check, such as a link that does not resolve or metadata that is missing, blocks the page and sends it back with the reason recorded, because a batch publish repeats the same defect everywhere; a page is never published by default and an unreviewed draft is treated as failing.

faqs.question: Should the batch go live all at once?
faqs.answer: It goes in stages, starting with a subset that is re-checked before the rest are released, since a template error in one stage is far cheaper to correct than a store-wide one; the stage size follows the merchant's stated rollout rule rather than convenience.

faqs.question: How is visibility set for scheduled pages?

zh_faqs.question: 整批应一次性上线还是分批？

zh_howToSolve: 收集首页主题使用的版块尺寸、当前主视觉素材及其文件名、带字数限制的标题与辅助文案、必须始终可见的活动条款，以及主题在每个断点上执行的裁切方式。把信息排成一条核心主张、一句辅助说明加活动条款的层级，逐一放到每种必要裁切下检验，凡是条款或行动号召落在可见区之外的版本都先挂起不发布。交付横幅需求说明并附变体清单，逐个文件注明所属展示位、尺寸与文件限制，标出信息层级失效的裁切，并在交付前确认没有变体丢失活动条款。

zh_faqs.question: 活动条款应放在信息层级的什么位置？
zh_faqs.answer: 放在辅助说明之下、最小裁切的安全区之内，因为只出现在桌面端变体上的条款，正是小屏买家永远看不到的那部分。

zh_faqs.question: 标题长度如何确定？
zh_faqs.answer: 依据版块文档记录的字数限制和最窄的裁切变体确定；标题换行或与辅助文案相撞时应改写缩短，而不是一味缩小字号到看不清。

zh_faqs.question: 怎样证明这份需求说明可以发布？
zh_faqs.answer: 每个列出的变体都要有明确的展示位、尺寸集合与符合限制的文件，且最小尺寸变体无需二次点击就能呈现完整信息层级。

title: Prepare banner crops for required dimensions
scenarioDescription: Existing images were made for one size, and the placements now in use crop them until the message disappears. In this case, the immediate task is to prepare banner crops for required dimensions. The workflow should produce banner or collection-image briefs and size variants, each crop verified against the supplied placements.
howToSolve: Collect each source image with its original dimensions and file name, the placements now in use with the exact dimensions they require, the safe area the message must stay inside, and the file format and weight limits for uploads. Crop every image from the largest available source rather than upscaling a smaller one, keep the subject and the message inside the safe area at the smallest required size, and flag any source whose resolution cannot fill its placement without visible softening. Deliver the crop set with a per-file note of source name, target dimensions and review status, verify every supplied placement has exactly one matching file, and list the crops held back for a human decision.

Crop every image from the largest available source rather than upscaling a smaller one, keep the subject and the message inside the safe area at the smallest required size, and flag any source whose resolution cannot fill its placement without visible softening. faqs.question: Should a small source image be enlarged to fit?
faqs.answer: No. Enlarging softens both the product and the text, so a source too small for a placement is reported as needing a new file instead of being stretched until it reaches the required dimensions.

faqs.question: How is a crop confirmed against a placement?
faqs.answer: By comparing the delivered file's dimensions with the dimensions that placement requires, then opening it at the smallest supported size to confirm the message and the product are both still inside the safe area.

faqs.question: What happens to crops that cannot be resolved?
faqs.answer: They are listed with the reason, such as insufficient source resolution or a subject that leaves the safe area at the required aspect ratio, so the merchant can supply a new source or change the placement.

zh_howToSolve: 汇总每张源图及其原始尺寸与文件名、当前在用的展示位及各自要求的精确尺寸、文案必须落在其中的安全区，以及上传文件的格式与体积限制。一律从可用的最大源文件出图而不是把小图放大，确保主体与文案在最小要求尺寸下仍处于安全区内，并标出分辨率不足以填满展示位而不出现明显模糊的源图。交付裁切图集时逐文件注明源文件名、目标尺寸与复核状态，核对每个提供的展示位都恰好有一个匹配文件，并列出挂起等待人工决定的裁切。

zh_faqs.question: 尺寸偏小的源图可以放大使用吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不建议。放大会让商品与文字同时变模糊，因此源图尺寸不足以支撑某个展示位时，应报告为需要新素材，而不是拉伸到所需尺寸。

zh_faqs.question: 裁切图如何对照展示位核验？
zh_faqs.answer: 把交付文件的尺寸与该展示位要求的尺寸逐一比对，并在最小支持尺寸下打开确认文案与商品主体都仍在安全区之内。

zh_faqs.question: 无法处理的裁切怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 应连同原因一起列出，例如源分辨率不足或主体在要求的宽高比下会越出安全区，以便商家补拍新素材或调整展示位。

title: Create collection imagery consistent with the assortment
scenarioDescription: Collection images borrowed from other ranges show products the collection does not actually contain. In this case, the immediate task is to create collection imagery consistent with the assortment. The workflow should produce image briefs and size variants reconciled against that collection's current product list.
howToSolve: Collect the collection's current product list with SKUs and handles, the imagery already held per product, the brand framing and background rules, and the display sizes used in grid, list and featured views. Match every visual to products that genuinely appear in that list, mark any image showing an item outside it, and treat a product with no usable imagery as a recorded gap rather than borrowing a shot from another range. Deliver the image brief with variants for each display size, reconcile the products shown against the collection's current list until the counts agree, and list every product still missing imagery with the display sizes it affects.

faqs.question: How is an image checked against the collection list?
faqs.answer: Every product visible in the frame is matched to a SKU in the collection's current list and any figure that cannot be matched is flagged, because shoppers read the image as a promise of what the collection actually contains.

faqs.question: What if a collection product has no usable image?
faqs.answer: It is recorded as a gap with the display sizes it affects and left out of the visual, since substituting a similar item from another range misrepresents the assortment and creates returns the merchant pays for.

faqs.question: Are variants needed for every listing view?
faqs.answer: Yes, for every display size the theme uses, because one file reused across grid and featured views is usually cropped differently and can cut out the product the collection is meant to show.

zh_scenarioDescription: 集合页直接沿用了其他系列的图，画面里的商品其实并不在这个集合内。本场景中，当前任务是制作与商品组合一致的集合页图片。该流程应基于商家的实际记录与约束，产出图片需求说明与尺寸变体，并与该集合当前的商品清单逐项核对。
zh_howToSolve: 收集该集合当前的商品清单及SKU与handle、每个商品已有的图片素材、品牌构图与背景规范，以及网格视图、列表视图与精选位使用的展示尺寸。让每个画面只对应商品清单中确实存在的商品，标出任何出现集合外商品的图片，并把缺少可用素材的商品记为缺口，而不是借用其他系列的图。交付图片需求说明与各展示尺寸的变体，把画面中的商品与该集合当前清单逐项核对至数量一致，并列出仍缺素材的商品及其影响的展示尺寸。

zh_faqs.question: 图片如何对照集合清单核验？

zh_faqs.question: 集合内某商品没有可用图片怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 记为素材缺口并注明受影响的展示尺寸，同时在画面中留空；用其他系列的相似商品顶替会歪曲商品组合，并带来由商家承担的退货。

zh_faqs.question: 每个列表视图都需要单独变体吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 主题使用的每种展示尺寸都需要，因为同一文件在网格视图与精选位上的裁切方式通常不同，可能把集合想展示的商品裁掉。

title: Create promotional image briefs reflecting real offer terms
scenarioDescription: Designers receive a vague ask for sale artwork and end up guessing the discount and end date on the banner. In this case, the immediate task is to create promotional image briefs reflecting real offer terms. The workflow should produce one brief per asset restating the offer, range and dates exactly as the merchant recorded them.
howToSolve: Collect the offer terms exactly as recorded, the eligible products, the campaign start and end dates, the brand assets with their usage rules, and the channel sizes and placements each asset version must fit. Write one brief per asset version stating the offer value, qualifying range and dates verbatim from the records, specifying the required safe area so the terms remain legible at each size, and marking any size where the full terms cannot fit as a layout problem rather than a copy cut. Deliver the brief set keyed by channel and size, verify each brief's terms against the supplied records word for word, and confirm every required element, including the terms, sits inside the stated safe area for its placement.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the offer terms as recorded, eligible products, campaign start and end dates, brand assets with usage rules, and channel sizes and placements per asset version]. Write one brief per asset version stating the offer value, qualifying range and dates verbatim from the records, specifying the required safe area so the terms remain legible at each size, and marking any size where the full terms cannot fit as a layout problem rather than a copy cut. Return the promotional content package, then verify each brief against the supplied records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is legibility of the terms guaranteed at small sizes?
faqs.answer: Each brief specifies a safe area per size, and the terms must sit inside it. Cropped or unreadable terms invite disputes at checkout because the visual implied a broader offer. Sizes that cannot fit the full terms go back for a layout change, never a wording cut.

faqs.question: Can designers adjust the stated offer wording for space?
faqs.answer: No, the wording is verbatim from the records. Paraphrasing a discount can change its legal meaning, not just its length. Any change requires merchant approval and a record update before the brief is issued.

faqs.question: How are brand asset rules enforced in briefs?
faqs.answer: Each brief lists the required assets and their usage rules exactly as the brand records state them. Guesswork with logos or imagery recreates design work later. Assets missing from the approved set block the brief rather than being substituted.

zh_faqs.question: 设计师可以为省空间改写优惠措辞吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不可以，措辞以记录为准逐字使用。改写折扣表述可能改变其法律含义而不只是长度。任何改动都需商家批准并先更新记录。

zh_faqs.question: 需求说明如何落实品牌素材的使用规则？
zh_faqs.answer: 每份说明按品牌记录原文列出必需素材及其使用规则。凭感觉处理logo或图像只会返工。品牌素材库中缺失的素材应阻止出说明，而不是找替代品。

title: Create social image concepts for product campaigns
scenarioDescription: A merchant has a campaign to run but no visuals yet, and anything published has to stay inside the approved brand assets. In this case, the immediate task is to create social image concepts for product campaigns. The workflow should produce a visual brief per concept naming subject, framing and overlay text taken only from supplied product details.
howToSolve: Take the product facts and the campaign goal, the approved brand asset library with the licence or usage scope attached to each asset, the formats and aspect ratios each channel accepts, and any overlay text the merchant has approved. Turn each concept into a visual brief naming the subject, the framing and crop for the target aspect ratio, the approved asset it draws on and the overlay text, keeping overlay wording to the claim the merchant supplied and to characters that stay legible at the size the channel renders, and rejecting any concept that needs an asset outside the approved library or a crop that cuts the product's identifying detail. Deliver one brief per concept with the subject, the framing, the asset reference, the overlay text and the target format, mark each brief with the assets it consumes so two posts do not run the same visual in one period, and flag any concept whose overlay states something absent from the supplied product facts.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Turn each concept into a visual brief naming the subject, the framing and crop for the target aspect ratio, the approved asset it draws on and the overlay text, keeping overlay wording to the claim the merchant supplied and to characters that stay legible at the size the channel renders, and rejecting any concept that needs an asset outside the approved library or a crop that cuts the product's identifying detail. Return image concepts with matching asset briefs for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Can existing product photography be reused as is?
faqs.answer: Only within the licence or usage scope attached to that asset in the library, and only where the raw image suits the channel's aspect ratio, since catalog shots are often square or tall and need reframing for a vertical placement. Reuse outside the recorded scope is flagged rather than assumed.

faqs.question: How much text should sit on the image?
faqs.answer: Only the claim the merchant supplied, and only as much as stays legible at the size the channel renders. Overlay text must never introduce a detail the product record lacks, because an image claim is harder to retract than a caption.

faqs.question: Should every concept carry a call to action?
faqs.answer: Where the campaign goal depends on a click, yes, and then short enough to read at thumbnail size. Purely informational or brand-led concepts work better without one, and forcing a directive onto them adds clutter without producing a measurable action.

faqs.question: What if the script runs longer than the permitted length?
faqs.answer: Cut content rather than narration pace, because rushed delivery hides the offer and often breaks approved wording anyway; drop the weakest beat, usually a secondary feature, then retime the sections while leaving the hook and the call to action intact.

faqs.question: Can an approved claim be reworded to sound better?
faqs.answer: No, only the reviewed wording may be spoken or captioned, since the claim was cleared in that exact form; a stronger line is worth putting to whoever signed it off, and until approval arrives the beat either uses the original wording or carries no claim at all.

faqs.question: Should price or discount details appear on screen?
faqs.answer: Only when the amount is fixed for the whole flight and matches the page the shopper lands on; if the offer varies by date, audience or currency, show the offer name instead and re-check the number in the caption at each scheduled review.

zh_faqs.question: 已批准的表述可以换个更好的说法吗？

faqs.question: How is a benefit verified rather than assumed?
faqs.answer: It traces to a confirmed attribute on the product record or to a verified review and the concept names that source; a benefit that only sounds true from the product name is treated as an assumption and left out.

zh_faqs.question: 怎样让创意测试读得清而不是一堆噪声？

zh_faqs.question: 几乎没有获得投放量的版本怎么处理？

zh_faqs.question: 测试可以提前结束吗？

zh_faqs.question: 什么样的剪切点是错误的？
zh_faqs.answer: 在演示动作尚未完成时结束的剪切，观众会看到被截断的结果并误以为商品做不完整个动作；剪切必须落在动作完成之后。

zh_faqs.question: 方案如何与素材核对？

zh_faqs.question: 库存数据流真的能做到实时吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 每个来源在实物移动与事件进入报告之间都存在延迟，因此真正重要的是可接受的延迟范围和可见的时间戳。页面如实标明每个来源的实测延迟，并统计尚未应用的事件，而不是宣称一个即时视图。

zh_faqs.question: 乱序到达的事件如何处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 按记录的事件时间而不是到达时间排序，并从最近一次已确认的库存水平重放重建，使迟到的销售不会被较早的收货覆盖。事件时间未知的事件保持未应用，不做猜测性排序。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么时间戳要对运营人员可见？
zh_faqs.answer: 因为在向订单承诺库存或答复发货日期时，没有数据时间的数字不可信。时间戳让运营人员判断当前状况是否已包含最新的流动，超出容差的事件单独计数，使缺口一眼可见。

faqs.question: Which figure should a storefront promise against?
faqs.answer: The sellable quantity of the location that will fulfil the order, not the sum across all locations, because stock sitting in a distant warehouse may not reach the shopper inside the promised window. Where the fulfilling location is chosen later, the report shows each location's sellable figure separately.

faqs.question: Does a transfer between locations raise availability?
faqs.answer: Only once the receiving location confirms it. Until then the units are shown as in transit and excluded from both locations' sellable figures, since counting them twice oversells the SKU while counting them nowhere hides stock the merchant has already paid for.

faqs.question: How is a SKU with conflicting location records reported?
faqs.answer: Both readings are kept, the newer timestamp is labelled, and the conflict is resolved from the source of record before any total is published. Where it stays unresolved the SKU appears with both values and no summed line, so a wrong total never reaches a decision.

zh_faqs.question: 同一SKU的各仓记录冲突时如何上报？

faqs.question: Which numbers belong on the opening view?
faqs.answer: Physical, committed and sellable quantities side by side with the age of each figure, because a single number invites the reader to treat held stock as instantly available. Anything needed only occasionally, such as location splits or movement history, belongs in a drill-down so the main view stays answerable at a glance.

faqs.question: How should missing or stale data be shown?
faqs.answer: In an exception panel, never as zero, because a blank reading rendered as zero hides a real stockout risk behind a confident number. Those SKUs carry a missing or stale label with the last successful refresh, and the panel is the first thing the team works through each day.

faqs.question: What proves the dashboard can be trusted?
faqs.answer: Before handover its figures are checked against the source snapshot for a sample of SKUs, and every panel names the source and refresh interval behind it. A panel without a named source or interval is not published, since nobody could then tell how old its numbers are.

title: Define useful low-stock alerts
scenarioDescription: A merchant currently learns that stock is low only once an item has already sold out, so the warning arrives too late to reorder. In this case, the immediate task is to define useful low-stock alerts. The workflow should produce one threshold per SKU set against that item's own lead time, with a named recipient and an escalation path.
howToSolve: Gather sellable stock per SKU with the location it sits in, the recent demand per SKU over the merchant's stated observation window, the replenishment lead time on record for each SKU, and the person who can raise a purchase order for it. Set the trigger per SKU at the level its own demand and lead time require rather than one catalog-wide number, so the alert arrives while a reorder can still land before stock runs out, attach a named recipient and an escalation path with the time to escalation, and set any SKU with no lead time on record to the merchant's default with a note. Deliver one alert rule per SKU stating the trigger, the recipient, the repeat interval and the escalation step, recalculate stock coverage after each receipt and close only when the recovery condition is met, keeping partial receipts below the trigger open, then test each rule against the supplied stock and demand records to confirm it would have fired before the SKU reached zero, and list the SKUs whose rules never fire because demand or lead time is missing.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [sellable stock per SKU with location, recent demand per SKU over the stated observation window, replenishment lead times on record, and the person who can raise a purchase order per SKU]. Set the trigger per SKU at the level its own demand and lead time require rather than one catalog-wide number, so the alert arrives while a reorder can still land before stock runs out, attach a named recipient and an escalation path with the time to escalation, and set any SKU with no lead time on record to the merchant's default with a note. After each receipt, recalculate coverage and keep partial receipts below the trigger open; close only when recovery conditions are met. Return low-stock alert rules with recipients and escalation for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why not use one threshold for the whole catalog?
faqs.answer: A single number over-triggers on slow movers and under-triggers on fast ones, so the trigger should follow each SKU's own demand and lead time and fire while action still helps. One shared number is acceptable only where a group of SKUs genuinely shares both.

faqs.question: Who should the alert reach?
faqs.answer: The person who can raise the purchase order, with escalation to their backup after the merchant's stated interval. Sending to a shared mailbox produces awareness without replenishment, because nobody named in the message owns the reorder.

faqs.question: Should the alert keep firing until stock arrives?
faqs.answer: Repeat at the stated interval while the risk remains unresolved. After every receipt, recalculate sellable stock and days of cover; close the alert only when the recovery condition is met, and keep it open or escalate if a partial delivery leaves stock below the trigger.

zh_faqs.question: 补货到货前要一直重复提醒吗？

zh_faqs.answer: 在截止时间点之前做的盘点会漏掉其后发生的流动，直接比较原始数字报出的差异往往只是时点差。把这些流动加回盘点侧，使两侧落在同一时刻，剩下的才是真正的账实差异，而不是日历造成的假差异。

zh_faqs.question: 差异的成因如何判定？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有在有记录支撑时才判定，例如截止点之后的流动、破损核销、未登记的调拨或计量单位错误，并在该行写明所引用的记录。没有支撑记录的差异保持未解释状态并单独计量，不套用一个顺手的成因。

zh_faqs.question: 已核对一致的项目还要进报告吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 只作为汇总行和计数出现，因为细节篇幅应留给仍需调查的未决差异。但每一处列出的差异都要带上两个数量、各自的时间戳和来源，让复核人无需重开整个周期就能重现这一差额。

faqs.question: How is a duplicated deduction told from a real second sale?
faqs.answer: By matching movements to order lines instead of counting deductions: one line should carry one deduction of its quantity, so a second movement sharing the same order reference and timestamp pattern is a duplicate. A movement tied to a different order line is a genuine second sale.

faqs.question: Why does stock go negative after a cancellation?
faqs.answer: Because the deduction was applied and the restoring movement never was. The cancelled or refunded line is expected to return its units, so where that movement is absent the line is listed as unrestored with the quantity to reinstate rather than written off as unexplained shrinkage.

faqs.question: Which corrections can be applied without review?
faqs.answer: Only those for a state the merchant defined in advance, such as a confirmed cancellation where the restoring movement is unambiguous. Exchanges, partial refunds and manual adjustments move stock on separate lines and are routed to review, since applying them automatically repeats the error that caused the mismatch.

zh_title: 排查库存与订单流动之间的差异

zh_faqs.question: 如何区分重复扣减与真实的第二笔销售？
zh_faqs.answer: 通过把流动与订单行匹配来判断，而不是只数扣减次数：一个订单行应只产生一次与其数量相符的扣减，因此订单引用与时间戳形态相同的第二次流动就是重复，而挂在另一个订单行下的流动则是真实的第二笔销售。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么取消订单之后库存会变成负数？
zh_faqs.answer: 因为扣减已执行而回补流动从未发生。被取消或退款的订单行本应把单位退回，缺少这笔流动时，该行列为未回补并写明需补回的数量，而不是当作无法解释的损耗核销掉。

zh_faqs.question: 哪些更正可以不经复核直接应用？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有商家事先明确定义的状态才可以，例如已确认取消且应有的回补流动毫无歧义的情形。换货、部分退款和手工调整在各自的行上产生库存变动，一律转人工复核，因为自动应用它们会重复制造本次不一致的那个错误。

faqs.question: When is a stock figure too old to use?
faqs.answer: Once it is older than the source's expected refresh window, because orders, receipts and adjustments since then have moved the real position. Age is measured per source rather than against one store-wide rule, since a warehouse feed and a nightly export cannot be held to the same interval.

faqs.question: Should a stale quantity be hidden?
faqs.answer: No, it is displayed with its age and status marked, because replacing it with a blank or a zero makes the view look complete while a real stockout risk sits behind it. If the source cannot refresh, the owner records why and the figure stays flagged.

faqs.question: Who fixes a source that failed to refresh?
faqs.answer: The team named in advance as owning that system; alerts are addressed to them rather than to a shared inbox, and a monitoring cycle is not signed off while a stale source has no named owner. An alert nobody can act on is the same as no alert.

zh_faqs.question: 什么情况下库存数字过旧、不能再使用？

zh_faqs.question: 过期数量应该隐藏吗？

zh_faqs.question: 刷新失败的来源由谁修复？

title: Compare product sales with inventory position
scenarioDescription: Sales and stock are reviewed separately, which hides products overstocked in one variant and short in another. faqs.question: How are returns treated in the sales figure?
faqs.answer: Returned units are subtracted from sold units in the period where the return was recorded, because they re-enter stock; using gross sales overstates consumption and makes a well-stocked product look short. A return landing after the period end is noted beside the figure rather than pushed back into a closed number.

faqs.question: Why break a product total into variants?
faqs.answer: A parent product can look balanced while one size sells out and another barely moves. The report rolls up to the product for the ranking, then reopens the variants behind each flag so the action, whether reorder, rebalance or markdown, is written against the variant that actually needs it.

faqs.question: When is a stock level unusable in the comparison?
faqs.answer: When the product has no stock record at either period boundary, or when its only movements in the period are manual adjustments rather than sales. Those products are listed with the quantities that do exist and marked as not yet comparable instead of being ranked alongside products measured on a full basis.

zh_faqs.question: 退货在销量中如何处理？

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要把商品合计拆到变体？

zh_faqs.question: 哪些商品的库存数字不可用于本对比？

title: Analyze inventory turnover using a consistent basis
scenarioDescription: Turnover was calculated differently in the last two reviews, so the results cannot be compared across periods. Compute turnover as cost of goods sold for the period divided by average stock value, taking average stock as the mean of opening and closing values, apply that one formula to every SKU without switching basis part way down the list, and mark SKUs with no stock value at either boundary as not comparable rather than giving them a rate. Compute turnover as cost of goods sold for the period divided by average stock value, taking average stock as the mean of opening and closing values, apply that one formula to every SKU without switching basis part way down the list, and mark SKUs with no stock value at either boundary as not comparable rather than giving them a rate. faqs.question: How is average stock calculated?
faqs.answer: As the mean of the opening and closing stock values for the period, both taken at the same cost basis. A closing-only figure penalises a SKU that was building stock up, and mixing bases between the two boundaries moves the rate without any real change in what is held.

faqs.question: Why must one formula cover every SKU?
faqs.answer: Because the report exists for comparison: if some SKUs are cost-based and others unit-based, the ranking measures the choice of formula rather than the stock. The documented formula is applied unchanged to every row and any deviation is listed as a caveat beside the rate.

faqs.question: When is a turnover figure not comparable?
faqs.answer: When the SKU has no stock value at either boundary, when the period's movements are mostly adjustments rather than sales, or when an earlier review used a different basis. Such SKUs are listed with their raw values and the reason, not ranked against SKUs measured on the full basis.

zh_scenarioDescription: 最近两次复核使用了不同的周转率算法，导致各期结果无法相互比较。本场景的即时任务是按统一口径分析库存周转。流程应产出库存健康度分析与优先级行动清单，对所有 SKU 采用同一套书面确认的公式，并保持口径不变。
zh_howToSolve: 按SKU与约定的分析周期，收集按商家成本口径计算的销售成本、以同一口径计量的期初与期末库存金额、本周期覆盖的期数，以及商家书面确认的周转率公式。周转率按周期销售成本除以平均库存金额计算，平均库存取期初与期末金额的均值，这一条公式不加切换地套用到所有SKU；两端没有库存金额的SKU标注为不可比，而不是硬算出一个比率。输出库存健康度分析，每个SKU同时列出周转率及其分子与分母，使口径始终可见，并附优先级行动建议；发布前把销售成本合计与商家的销售和成本记录核对一致，并注明口径与上次复核不同的SKU。

zh_faqs.question: 平均库存如何计算？
zh_faqs.answer: 取周期内期初与期末库存金额的均值，两端必须使用同一成本口径。只用期末数会冤枉正在备货的SKU，而两端口径不一致则会让比率在没有真实变化的情况下变好或变差。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么所有SKU必须用同一条公式？
zh_faqs.answer: 因为这份报告的价值在于可比：若一部分SKU按成本、另一部分按件数计算，排名衡量的就是公式选择而不是库存本身。因此书面确认的公式要原样套用到每一行，任何偏离都在比率旁注明。

zh_faqs.question: 什么情况下周转率不可比？
zh_faqs.answer: 周期两端缺少库存金额、期内流动以调整为主而非销售、或上次复核使用了不同口径时，该SKU均不可比。这些SKU连同原始数值和原因一并列出，不与按完整口径计量的SKU一起排名。

title: Estimate remaining inventory coverage in days
scenarioDescription: Replenishment decisions are made without knowing how long stock lasts at the recorded demand rate. The workflow should produce an inventory health analysis and prioritized actions, dividing available stock by the stated demand rate and labelling the result an estimate.
howToSolve: Take each SKU's sellable stock at the reporting moment, its recorded sales over the demand window the merchant names, the returns and adjustments falling inside that window, and the unit or cost basis the figure is stated in. Divide sellable stock by the average daily demand observed in that window, report rather than divide the SKUs that recorded no demand at all by showing their stock with an undetermined coverage label, and note beside any figure whose window caught a promotion or a stockout. Deliver an inventory health analysis listing coverage days with the window and demand rate used on every row, label each figure an estimate, add prioritized actions, and reconcile sellable stock with the current inventory export before publishing.

faqs.question: Why is the coverage figure called an estimate?
faqs.answer: Because it assumes the demand rate observed inside the window continues unchanged. A promotion, a stockout or one large order distorts that rate, so the number is published as an estimate with the window stated beside it rather than as a promise about when stock runs out.

faqs.question: How is a SKU with no recent sales handled?
faqs.answer: It is given no coverage number at all, since dividing by zero demand produces an infinite figure that outranks every other SKU and hides the real problem. Its stock on hand is reported with an undetermined label and the SKU is routed to the dead or slow stock review instead.

faqs.question: Should stock on order extend the coverage?
faqs.answer: Only where the merchant's policy says so, and then in a separate column, because folding an expected receipt into current coverage makes a SKU look safe today. The estimate column stays sellable stock on hand, and the expected receipt appears with its own date.

zh_howToSolve: 取每个SKU在报告时点的可售库存、商家指定需求窗口内记录的销售、落入该窗口的退货与调整，以及该数值所采用的件数或成本口径。用可售库存除以该窗口内观察到的日均需求；窗口内完全没有需求的SKU不做除法，改为连同库存数量标注为可支撑天数待定；窗口内包含促销或断货情形的，在数值旁注明。输出库存健康度分析，每一行列出可支撑天数并注明所用窗口与需求速率，把每个数值标注为估算值，并附优先级行动建议；发布前先把可售库存与当前库存导出核对一致。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么可支撑天数被称为估算值？
zh_faqs.answer: 因为它假定窗口内观察到的需求速率会原样延续，而促销、断货或单笔大额订单都会扭曲这个速率。因此该数字是连同窗口一起发布的估算值，而不是对库存耗尽日期的承诺。

zh_faqs.question: 近期完全没有销售记录的SKU如何处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 不给它计算可支撑天数，因为除以零需求会得到一个无穷大的数值，它会排在所有SKU之前并掩盖真正的问题。改为连同在手库存标注为待定，并把该SKU转入呆滞或滞销复核。

zh_faqs.question: 在途补货可以延长可支撑天数吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有商家政策允许时才计入，并且单列一栏，因为把预期到货混入当前可售量会让SKU在今天看起来很安全。估算列只保留在手可售库存，预期到货另附其预计日期。

title: Identify stock with little or no recent movement

Flag a SKU as unmoved only when neither a sale, a receipt, a transfer nor an adjustment appears for it inside the period, then check the flagged units against open orders and drop from the dead list every SKU whose remaining units are already committed, reporting only the uncommitted remainder. faqs.question: Does no movement alone make a SKU dead?
faqs.answer: No; a SKU is only called dead after its flagged units are checked against open orders, because stock already promised to a customer is working stock even when no movement posted inside the window. Only the uncommitted remainder is reported as dead, and the committed portion is listed separately with the order it belongs to.

faqs.question: Which movements clear a SKU from the flag?
faqs.answer: Any recorded sale, receipt, transfer or adjustment inside the period, not sales alone, since a restock or an internal transfer shows the SKU is still being handled. A manual adjustment counts too but is shown with its reason, so a correction is never mistaken for real demand.

faqs.question: How should discontinued SKUs be treated?
faqs.answer: Kept in the report rather than dropped, because the units still hold cost and still need a disposition decision. They are labelled discontinued where that status is recorded and ranked by value tied up, so they are not quietly written off through omission.

zh_scenarioDescription: 部分 SKU 近期没有流动，但未结订单可能已经占用了这些库存，仅凭流动缺口不足以判定。本场景的即时任务是识别近期几乎无出入库流动的库存。流程应产出库存健康度分析与优先级行动清单，在判定呆滞前先对照未结订单核查每个被标记的 SKU。
zh_howToSolve: 收集每个SKU的在手库存与成本口径、最后一次流动的发生日期与类型、商家设定的分析周期，以及已经预留或承诺这些单位的未结订单行。只有当该周期内既没有销售、收货、调拨，也没有任何调整记录时，才把该SKU标记为无流动；随后把被标记的单位对照未结订单核查，剩余单位已被占用的SKU从呆滞清单中移除，只上报真正未占用的部分。输出库存健康度分析，每个被标记的SKU一行，列出未占用单位、占用资金和距上次流动的时长，并按涉及金额排序给出分级行动建议；发布前把标记数量同库存导出与未结订单清单逐项核对。

zh_faqs.question: 仅凭没有流动就能判定呆滞吗？

zh_faqs.question: 哪些流动可以解除标记？
zh_faqs.answer: 周期内任何已记录的销售、收货、调拨或调整都可以，而不只是销售，因为补货或内部调拨同样说明该SKU仍在处理中。手工调整也计入，但要注明原因，避免把一次更正误读为真实需求。

zh_faqs.question: 停产商品如何处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 保留在报告中而不是剔除，因为这些单位仍然占用成本、仍需做出处置决定。有明确停产记录的标注为停产，并按占用资金排序，避免它们因为被省略而被悄悄核销。

faqs.question: Why judge a SKU against its own group?
faqs.answer: Because demand varies by category: a rate that is poor in one group is normal in another, and comparing everyone with the catalogue average flags entire groups at once. Grouping also separates genuine weakness from uneven demand across sizes, so the action lands on the SKU that is truly slow.

faqs.question: Where does the slow-moving threshold come from?
faqs.answer: From the merchant's own movement records and review cycle, written down with the report so the next review measures the same thing. No fixed percentage is assumed, and if the threshold changes the report states both the old and the new basis for one period.

faqs.question: How are new and seasonal SKUs kept out of the ranking?
faqs.answer: They stay in the file but are listed separately: a SKU launched inside the window has too little history to compare, and one measured in a recorded off-season looks slow for calendar reasons. Each excluded SKU carries its reason and the date from which it can be ranked.

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要把SKU放在自己的品类里比较？

zh_faqs.question: 滞销阈值从哪里来？
zh_faqs.answer: 来自商家自身的流动记录和复核周期，并随报告书面注明，使下一次复核衡量的是同一件事。不预设任何固定百分比；商家调整阈值时，报告会在一个周期内同时标注新旧两种口径。

zh_faqs.question: 新品和季节性商品如何避免进入排名？
zh_faqs.answer: 它们保留在文件中但单列：窗口内上架的SKU历史太短无法比较，窗口落在已记录淡季的SKU会因日历原因显得滞销。每个被排除的SKU都写明原因以及可以纳入排名的日期。

title: Assess excess inventory and possible actions
scenarioDescription: Surplus stock is known to exist, but no option has been weighed against margin, storage space and vendor terms. In this case, the immediate task is to assess excess inventory and possible actions. The workflow should produce an inventory health analysis and prioritized actions, quantifying the surplus against expected demand before recommending one.
howToSolve: Collect current stock per SKU, the demand recorded over the comparison period, the units already on order or committed, supplier lead times, and the merchant's stated margin floor, storage limit and vendor return terms. Quantify surplus as stock on hand plus committed inbound units minus the demand expected over the coverage period the merchant names, then test each disposal option against the margin floor, the storage limit and the vendor terms, rejecting any option that would push a SKU below the floor or breach those terms. Deliver an inventory health analysis with one recommended action per surplus SKU together with the surplus quantity and the constraint that ruled out each rejected option, rank the actions by capital released, and reconcile surplus quantities with the inventory export and open purchase orders before publishing.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [current stock per SKU, demand recorded over the comparison period, committed inbound units, supplier lead times, and the merchant's stated margin floor, storage limit and vendor return terms]. Quantify surplus as stock on hand plus committed inbound units minus the demand expected over the coverage period the merchant names, then test each disposal option against the margin floor, the storage limit and the vendor terms, rejecting any option that would push a SKU below the floor or breach those terms. Return an inventory health analysis and prioritized actions for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is the surplus quantity defined?
faqs.answer: Stock on hand plus units already committed inbound, less the demand expected over the coverage period the merchant sets. Counting only stock on hand understates surplus while a purchase order is still arriving, so the coverage period is stated on every row and the figure can be recomputed later.

faqs.question: Does cancelling the next order clear the excess?
faqs.answer: No, because inbound commitments and stock already held are separate decisions: cancelling a future order stops the problem growing but leaves the existing units untouched. The report gives the existing surplus its own action and treats order reduction as a separate recommendation.

faqs.question: Why not simply discount every surplus SKU?
faqs.answer: Because the margin floor, the storage limit and the vendor terms each rule options out. Where terms allow, bundling, deferred reordering or a supplier return may release the same capital without cutting price, and every rejected option is recorded with the constraint that killed it.

zh_title: 评估过量库存与可选处理方式
zh_scenarioDescription: 明知存在多余库存，却没有把处理方式放在毛利空间、仓储容量和供应商条款上一起衡量。本场景的即时任务是评估过量库存与可选处理方式。流程应产出库存健康度分析与优先级行动清单，先以预期需求为基准测算多余量，再提出建议。
zh_howToSolve: 收集每个SKU的当前库存、对比周期内记录的需求、已下单或已承诺的单位、供应商交货周期，以及商家给出的毛利底线、仓储上限和供应商退货条款。多余量按在手库存加已承诺在途单位、减去商家指定覆盖期内的预期需求计算；随后把每个处置选项放在毛利底线、仓储上限和供应商条款上逐一检验，凡会使SKU跌破底线或违反条款的选项直接否决。输出库存健康度分析，每个多余SKU给出一条建议动作，并列出多余数量以及每个被否决选项的否决约束，按可释放资金排序；发布前把多余数量同库存导出和未结采购订单核对一致。
