faqs.question: Should timing be event-based or day-based?
faqs.answer: Event-based wherever the event exists, because a message about delivery sent before delivery reads as noise; day-based timing is a fallback for events the store cannot observe and is flagged so its results are not read as the event version's.

faqs.question: What if the delivery confirmation never arrives?
faqs.answer: The flow waits rather than moving ahead, and after the merchant's stated waiting limit the message goes out with wording that does not assume delivery happened; sending the next step early answers a question the customer has not reached yet.

faqs.question: Can a customer re-enter after buying again?
faqs.answer: Not the new-customer flow, since a second purchase moves them to the next sequence and re-entry would repeat an introduction they have already had; re-entry needs an explicit rule and a suppression check against recent sends.

zh_faqs.question: 按事件还是按天数排期？

zh_faqs.question: 妥投确认一直没来怎么办？

zh_faqs.question: 客户再次购买后能重新进入吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不能回到新客序列，二次购买会把客户转入下一段流程，重新进入只会重复已经做过的介绍；确需重入时必须有明确规则，并核对近期发送记录做抑制。

title: Identify returning customers using purchase history
scenarioDescription: Guest checkout and shared accounts let one buyer appear under several records, so repeat counts move with whoever matched the export. faqs.question: Which identifier wins when a shared account holds two buyers?
faqs.answer: The precedence order the merchant states is applied top down, normally the registered customer record before the email and the phone, so one buyer is never counted twice; where two people genuinely share one email and no rule separates them, the page reports them as a single unresolved identity rather than splitting the orders.

faqs.question: Do refunded or cancelled orders count as the second purchase?
faqs.answer: Only if the merchant's qualifying rule admits them, and under a net treatment a fully refunded order fails that test so the customer stays single-order; the same treatment is applied to every customer, which keeps the segment from shifting when a refund is issued after the count was taken.

faqs.question: How does merging change the returning count?
faqs.answer: Merging pulls the count down wherever one buyer held several records and pushes it up where orders previously matched to the wrong buyer move to the right one; the page reports the pre-merge and post-merge figures side by side so the change is visible rather than silent.

zh_faqs.question: 共用账号下出现两位买家时以哪个标识为准？

zh_faqs.question: 已退款或已取消的订单算不算第二笔购买？

zh_faqs.question: 归并会怎样改变回头客户的人数？

title: Define a VIP segment from explicit value criteria
scenarioDescription: A loyalty tier is about to launch, but the proposal describes desirable customers in adjectives while the benefit budget only stretches so far. Turn every criterion into a testable condition with an explicit operator, unit and window, apply the full set to each customer in the order the merchant states, record which criterion each customer cleared or failed, and flag any customer the criteria disagree about plus any value sitting exactly on a stated boundary instead of rounding it into or out of the tier. faqs.question: How many criteria must a customer clear to qualify?
faqs.answer: The merchant's rule decides whether the criteria are conjunctive or alternatives, and the page states which it applied; requiring every criterion tends to produce a small stable tier, while accepting any one produces a wide tier whose members differ in kind rather than in degree.

faqs.question: Where should the threshold sit?
faqs.answer: At the point the benefit budget can actually carry, worked back from the merchant's stated capacity rather than from a round number; the page reports how the qualifying count moves around the chosen threshold so the merchant sees the trade before committing budget.

faqs.question: What happens to customers just below the line?
faqs.answer: They are listed as near-threshold with the gap to each criterion rather than silently dropped, because a boundary set without reference to the budget usually has to move, and those customers are the first ones the move affects.

zh_faqs.answer: 仅当客户没有既往复购、缺乏个人间隔可供比较时，才以商家记录的商品或类目周期替代，依据列会标注采用的是哪种数值。两者都没有的客户会被暂缓，而不是凭空造一个基准去评分。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么有些客户被暂缓不评？
zh_faqs.answer: 首购至今不足既定观察窗口的客户还没有获得公平的复购机会，此时低就绪度只是时间造成的假象。他们被暂缓并列出而不评分。窗口期满后，他们与其他客户按同一条件进入下一轮测算。

faqs.question: How is the send date derived for each customer?
faqs.answer: The send date is the projected run-out point, calculated as the purchase date plus the ordered quantity spread over the stated usage cycle, moved earlier by the merchant's chosen lead. This keeps the message inside the cycle instead of after it. Where a customer's own repeat history shows a different pace, the recorded pace overrides the generic cycle.

faqs.question: What happens when a customer reorders before the reminder date?
faqs.answer: Any later order for the same SKU removes that customer from the audience, because the run-out clock restarts from the new purchase. The rule checks later orders at send time, not only when the rule is built. A reorder on a different SKU does not suppress the reminder unless the merchant's rule says so.

faqs.question: Can one usage cycle serve every product?
faqs.answer: No. The cycle is stated per SKU, so customers who bought several products in one order receive reminders timed to each product's own run-out. A single store-wide cycle sends messages too early for slow-use products and too late for fast ones. Where no cycle is stated, the line is flagged rather than timed by assumption.

zh_faqs.question: 一个使用周期能通用于所有商品吗？

zh_howToSolve: 收集带日期的购买历史、每位客户所购商品对应的预期复购周期、含渠道的既往触达记录、现行有效的优惠额度与联系节奏，以及退订或屏蔽记录。把风险规则写成观察间隔与该客户预期周期的比较，把仍处在周期内、在既定节奏内已被触达过、以及持有退订标记的客户全部排除，按优惠额度限制决定每位入选客户可以收到什么，并把周期或触达历史不完整的客户标记为状态未定。交付流失风险定义与召回计划，逐位列出客户及其间隔、周期、上次触达时间与可用优惠，再把名单与订单导出核对以确认被标记客户此后没有下单，并与触达记录核对以避免同一位客户被重复联系。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要把仍处在周期内的客户排除掉？
zh_faqs.answer: 因为他们的间隔还没有超过这类产品正常所需的时间，此时给出的标记描述的是操之过急，而不是风险；只有间隔超过预期周期，才能把推迟的复购与正常的节奏区分开。

zh_faqs.question: 近期已被触达过的客户要移出名单吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 他们会被移出本次发送，但仍留在风险定义中，依据是商家既定的联系节奏。这样分群规模保持不变，而触达动作避免在规定间隔内再次联系同一位客户。

zh_faqs.question: 状态未定的客户如何呈现？
zh_faqs.answer: 单独成组并写明缺失的字段是周期还是触达历史，不做默认归类；因为默认归类会在没有任何新证据的情况下改变发送名单的规模。

title: Build a targeted customer winback workflow
scenarioDescription: Follow-up runs in manual batches, so some customers hear twice in one week while others are never contacted at all. In this case, the immediate task is to build a targeted customer winback workflow. The workflow should produce a winback automation with measurement points set from the merchant's triggers, channels and ownership rules.
howToSolve: Collect the at-risk definition that feeds the flow, the channels available with their sending limits, the message frequency cap and contact cadence in force, the owner responsible for each step, and the suppression and consent rules that gate any send. Map each trigger to its entry conditions, the message it sends and the exits that stop it, so a customer leaves the flow on a completed order, an opt-out, a suppression match or the end of the stated plan, and resolve conflicting triggers by the precedence the merchant states instead of letting one customer run through two flows at once. Deliver the workflow with its measurement points at entry, send, order and exit, dry-run it against the supplied customer records to confirm the trigger fires for the intended segment and stays silent for everyone else, and note which conditions could not be tested and what must be watched after launch.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me build a targeted customer winback workflow. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the at-risk definition, available channels with sending limits, the message frequency cap and cadence, the owner for each step, and the suppression and consent rules]. Map each trigger to its entry conditions, the message it sends and the exits that stop it, so a customer leaves the flow on a completed order, an opt-out, a suppression match or the end of the stated plan, and resolve conflicting triggers by the precedence the merchant states instead of letting one customer run through two flows at once. Return a winback workflow with its measurement points for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: What happens when two triggers match the same customer?
faqs.answer: The precedence order the merchant states decides, with the higher-priority flow taking the customer and the other suppressed, because running both sends overlapping messages and leaves the measurement unable to attribute any order to a single flow.

faqs.question: Which events should exit the flow?
faqs.answer: A completed order, an opt-out or suppression match, and the end of the stated plan, each recorded as a separate exit reason so the flow can report how many customers left by ordering rather than by exhausting the sequence.

faqs.question: How is the dry run checked before launch?
faqs.answer: By running the trigger against the supplied records and comparing the customers it selects with the at-risk list, then confirming every excluded customer has a recorded reason, so a silent misconfiguration shows up as a mismatch rather than as a missing send.

zh_howToSolve: 收集作为流程输入的风险客户定义、可用渠道及其发送上限、现行有效的消息频次与联系节奏、每一步的责任人，以及决定能否发送的任何屏蔽与同意规则。把每个触发条件对应到进入条件、所发消息与退出条件，使客户在完成下单、主动退订、命中屏蔽名单或走完既定方案任一情况发生时退出流程；多个触发条件同时命中时，按商家既定的优先级处理，避免同一位客户同时跑在两条流程里。交付这套流程及其在进入、发送、下单与退出各处的衡量节点，并用提供的客户记录做一次试跑，确认触发条件对目标分群生效、对其他人保持静默，同时注明哪些条件无法在上线前测试、上线后需要重点观察。

zh_faqs.question: 两个触发条件同时命中同一位客户怎么办？

zh_faqs.question: 哪些事件应当让客户退出流程？

zh_faqs.question: 上线前的试跑要检查什么？

title: Draft a reactivation email campaign
scenarioDescription: One blanket discount was planned for the whole lapsed list even though the products those customers buy follow different seasonal timing. In this case, the immediate task is to draft a reactivation email campaign. The workflow should produce a campaign plan with sequence, subjects and send timing checked against the merchant's own offer rules.
howToSolve: Collect the eligible inactive segment with each customer's last order date and product timing, the offer rules that apply including whatever needs approval, the seasonal or product timing the merchant has stated, and the campaign calendar the send has to fit around. Plan the sequence, subjects and send timing so each variant reaches customers when the product they last bought is due again rather than on one date for the whole list, keep every offer inside the merchant's stated rules and approvals, and split the list by purchase context only where the records support a difference. Deliver the campaign inside the winback plan with the sequence, subjects, send dates and offer for each variant, verify the recipient list against the eligible segment to confirm nobody outside it is included and no eligible customer is silently dropped, and flag anyone whose eligibility the records do not settle.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the eligible inactive segment with last order dates and product timing, the applicable offer rules and approvals, the stated seasonal timing, and the campaign calendar]. Plan the sequence, subjects and send timing so each variant reaches customers when the product they last bought is due again rather than on one date for the whole list, keep every offer inside the merchant's stated rules and approvals, and split the list by purchase context only where the records support a difference. Return a reactivation email campaign inside a winback plan for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Should the whole list receive the send on one date?
faqs.answer: Only when the products share a repurchase timing; where they do not, the send dates follow each group's cycle, because a single date reaches part of the list before it is due and part of it long afterwards.

faqs.question: How is each offer checked before the send?
faqs.answer: Against the merchant's stated offer rules and approvals, variant by variant, with the rule recorded next to the offer; an offer that needs approval and lacks it is reported as blocked rather than sent with the risk of honouring an unapproved discount.

faqs.question: What belongs in the pre-send check?
faqs.answer: Recipient count against the eligible segment, suppression and opt-out matches, the offer applied per variant and a rendered test of each message, so a mismatch is caught before the send rather than after customers receive the wrong version.

zh_title: 策划并起草一轮客户召回邮件活动

zh_howToSolve: 收集符合条件的沉默分群及每位客户的最近下单日期与产品时间节奏、适用的优惠规则及其中需要审批的部分、商家提出的季节或产品时点要求，以及本次发送必须避让的活动日历。安排发送顺序、邮件主题与发送节奏，使每个版本在其客户上次购买的商品真正到复购时点时送达，而不是全名单共用同一天；所有优惠都控制在商家既定规则与审批范围内，并且只在记录确实支撑差异时才按购买背景拆分名单。把活动方案纳入召回计划交付，包含各版本的发送顺序、邮件主题、发送日期与所用优惠，再把收件名单与合格分群核对，确认既没有圈入分群之外的人、也没有静默漏掉合格客户，并标记记录无法判定资格的客户。

zh_faqs.question: 整个名单要在同一天发送吗？

zh_faqs.question: 发送前如何核对每个优惠？

zh_faqs.question: 发前检查应包含哪些内容？

title: Tailor marketing to supported customer needs
scenarioDescription: Segments already exist in the store, but the messaging sent to them was written from assumptions. In this case, the immediate task is to tailor marketing to supported customer needs. The workflow should produce personalized message variants and targeting rules, with the audience logic verified against the merchant's own segment records.
howToSolve: Collect the customer segments in use, the needs or preferences recorded for each one, the channels and messaging already approved, the consent status on each contact, and one merchant-defined window of orders to test the audience logic against. Write one variant per segment supported by a recorded need, set a targeting rule and a suppression rule for each, and hold back any segment whose need appears in no record, keeping the message to what the records support rather than what seems likely. Deliver the message variants with their targeting and suppression rules, run them over the window's customers and count who each variant would reach, then confirm against the supplied segment records that no customer falls into two variants and none who opted out is included.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me tailor marketing to supported customer needs. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the customer segments in use, the needs or preferences recorded for each, the approved channels and messaging, the consent status per contact, and one review window of orders to test the audience logic]. Write one variant per segment supported by a recorded need, set a targeting rule and a suppression rule for each, and hold back any segment whose need appears in no record, keeping the message to what the records support rather than what seems likely. Return personalized message variants and targeting rules for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Which customer signals are safe to use?
faqs.answer: Only signals present in the merchant's records, such as a stated preference or a purchase already on file, because inferring interest from unrelated activity produces messages the customer never asked for; a signal appearing for one customer and not the segment shapes no variant.

faqs.question: How many variants should be prepared?
faqs.answer: One per segment with a supported need rather than one per customer, since variants nobody can review quickly drift and go stale; segments without a recorded need receive the standard message or nothing, and that choice is written into the targeting rules.

faqs.question: How is overlap between segments checked?
faqs.answer: Every customer in the window is run through the targeting rules and must land in at most one variant, because a customer receiving two conflicting messages notices immediately; overlaps are resolved by the rule stated in the specification, and anyone who has opted out is removed by the suppression rule.

zh_faqs.question: 哪些客户信号可以安全使用？

zh_faqs.question: 应该准备多少个文案变体？
zh_faqs.answer: 每个有依据的客群准备一个变体，而不是每个客户一个，因为变体过多会来不及复核并逐渐过时；没有记录支撑需求的分群则使用标准文案或不发送，这一选择会写入定向规则。

zh_faqs.question: 如何检查分群之间的重叠？
zh_faqs.answer: 把窗口内的每位客户跑一遍定向规则，每位客户最多只能落入一个变体，因为同时收到两条互相矛盾消息的顾客会立刻察觉；重叠按规格中既定的规则消解，已选择退订的客户由免打扰规则排除。

title: Define relevant personalized offers within stated limits

In this case, the immediate task is to define relevant personalized offers within stated limits. The workflow should produce personalized message variants and targeting rules, with eligibility checked against the merchant's own customer records.

Match each offer to a segment the records support, state its conditions and expiry, and compute the margin the offer leaves per product against the stated floor in the merchant's own currency, holding back any offer that breaches it. Deliver the message variants with their targeting rules, eligibility checks and expiry dates, verify each eligible customer against the supplied customer and product records, and list the offers held back with the margin or rule that stopped them.

faqs.question: How is an offer checked against the margin floor?
faqs.answer: The margin each offer leaves is computed per product from the merchant's cost basis in the store currency and compared with the stated floor, because a percentage that looks safe on one product clears nothing on another; an offer below the floor is held back with the figure recorded rather than sent and explained later.

faqs.question: Should every segment receive a discount?
faqs.answer: No, a segment with no supported need or no margin room receives nothing, since a generic discount trains customers to wait for the next one and spends margin the merchant never approved; the targeting rules name which segments are excluded and why, so the silence is deliberate.

faqs.question: Why record an expiry with each offer?
faqs.answer: An offer without a stated end runs past its intent and collides with later pricing, and a customer quoting it months later has to be refused; the expiry travels with the offer in the specification, and anyone asking after it is pointed to what is currently approved.

zh_title: 在既定限制内定义有针对性的个性化优惠
zh_scenarioDescription: 优惠目前按临时名单发放，既没有写明毛利下限，也没有记录哪些商品真正可参与。本场景的具体任务是在既定限制内定义有针对性的个性化优惠。最终交付个性化文案变体与定向规则，并对照商家自己的客户与商品记录核验参与资格。
zh_howToSolve: 汇总已批准的优惠规则、每项优惠覆盖的商品及其成本依据与币种、商家既定的毛利下限、记录中可获得的客户信号，以及一个用于检验资格的商家自定订单窗口。把每项优惠对应到记录能够支撑的人群，写明适用条件与有效期，并按商家自身币种逐商品计算优惠后剩余毛利与既定下限的差距，凡是突破下限的优惠一律搁置。输出文案变体及其定向规则、资格校验方式与有效期，对照所提供的客户与商品记录核验每位符合条件的用户，并把被搁置的优惠连同使其止步的毛利或规则一并列出。

zh_faqs.question: 优惠如何对照毛利下限核验？
zh_faqs.answer: 按商家自己的成本依据与店铺币种，逐商品计算优惠后剩余毛利，再与既定下限比较，因为同一百分比在这个商品上安全，在另一个商品上可能一分不剩；低于下限的优惠连同具体数值一并记录后搁置，而不是先发放再解释。

zh_faqs.question: 是否每个客群都该拿到折扣？
zh_faqs.answer: 不是。没有明确需求依据或没有毛利空间的客群应当不发优惠，因为通用折扣会教会顾客等待下一次，并消耗商家并未批准的毛利；定向规则中会写明哪些客群被排除及原因，让沉默成为有意为之的选择。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要为每项优惠写明有效期？
zh_faqs.answer: 没有结束时间的优惠会超出原本意图，并与后续定价相冲突，几个月后顾客拿它来兑现时只能被拒绝；有效期会随优惠一起写入规格，过期后咨询的客户会被引导至当前已批准的优惠。

title: Identify practical ways to increase customer lifetime value
scenarioDescription: Growth targets rest on customer value, yet nobody has drawn the line between what the store already earns and what customers might spend later. In this case, the immediate task is to identify practical ways to increase customer lifetime value. The workflow should produce an LTV analysis with transparent assumptions and prioritised hypotheses.
howToSolve: Assemble the order history of existing customers grouped by acquisition cohort, the current value basis with its refund and discount treatment, and the retention and cross-sell constraints already in force such as discount ceilings, minimum order values and which products may be bundled. Measure on that same cohort and basis the second-order rate, the interval between first and second order, average basket size and the number of distinct categories bought, and turn each shortfall against the merchant's stated target into a hypothesis naming the customer group, the lever and the measure that would move. Deliver an LTV analysis with a prioritised hypothesis list ordered by gap size and by the effort the team can staff, each hypothesis paired with the check it will be read against, and confirm every one traces back to a record the merchant can query.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me identify practical ways to increase customer lifetime value. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [per-customer order history by acquisition cohort, the value basis with refund and discount treatment, existing discount and bundling constraints, and the merchant's targets for repeat rate, basket size and category breadth]. Measure on that same cohort and basis the second-order rate, the interval between first and second order, average basket size and the number of distinct categories bought, and turn each shortfall against the merchant's stated target into a hypothesis naming the customer group, the lever and the measure that would move. Return an LTV analysis with transparent assumptions and prioritised hypotheses for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: What makes a value hypothesis testable?
faqs.answer: It names the customer group, the lever being changed and the measure expected to move, so the result can be read against a comparable group; a hypothesis that shifts two levers at once cannot be attributed, and one with no measure cannot be judged at all.

faqs.question: Is projected future spend part of the analysis?
faqs.answer: Only as a separate line with its assumption written beside it, never folded into the observed baseline, because mixing the two makes an estimate look like a record; if the merchant cannot supply the assumption, the projection is left out rather than filled in.

faqs.question: How is a gap judged when no target is set?
faqs.answer: The store's own better-performing comparable cohort becomes the reference and is labelled as such, since a gap only means something against a stated level; where no comparable cohort exists, the shortfall is described in counts and left unprioritised.

zh_howToSolve: 按获客批次汇总存量客户的订单历史、当前采用的价值口径及其退款与折扣处理方式，以及已在生效的折扣上限、起订金额和可捆绑商品等留存与连带销售限制。在同一批次、同一口径下测算二次下单率、首单到二单的间隔、客单价与购买品类数，并把每项与商家既定目标的差距写成注明客群、杠杆与衡量指标的假设。交付附优先级排序的LTV分析，按差距大小与团队可承担的工作量排列，每条假设配好对应的验证方式，并逐条确认都能对回商家可查询的记录。

zh_faqs.question: 什么样的价值假设才可检验？
zh_faqs.answer: 它写明客群、要改动的杠杆和预期变化的指标，使结果能对照一组可比客户解读；同时改动两个杠杆的假设无法归因，没有指标的假设也无法判断成败。

zh_faqs.question: 未来消费的预测要计入分析吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 只作为单独一行并附上假设，不并入已实现基线，因为两者混在一起会让估算看起来像记录；商家给不出假设依据时宁可省略预测，也不要自行填补。

zh_faqs.question: 没有设定目标时如何判断差距？
zh_faqs.answer: 以店铺自身表现更好的可比批次作为参照并明确标注，因为差距只有对照某个既定水平才有意义；若连可比批次都不存在，则只用数量描述缺口，暂不排序。

title: Recommend compatible complementary products
scenarioDescription: The merchant wants a cart recommendation that adds something usable with the item already chosen, not a random bestseller. In this case, the immediate task is to recommend compatible complementary products. The workflow should produce a recommendation matrix and offer copy, checking every pairing against the compatibility and inventory records supplied.
howToSolve: Collect the product relationships and compatibility notes on file, the category and price band of each candidate, the inventory state per item, the contents of the cart being served and the placement the merchant intends the suggestion to appear in. Keep a complement only where the compatibility records support the pairing, the item is purchasable at the time of the check and it is not already in the cart, drop anything whose availability the inventory records do not confirm, and limit the set shown to the number the merchant's placement allows. Deliver a recommendation matrix and offer copy with each pairing tied to the compatibility record that supports it and a plain statement of what the item adds, then confirm that every recommended item is still purchasable and that the matrix covers each cart item the merchant named.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Keep a complement only where the compatibility records support the pairing, the item is purchasable at the time of the check and it is not already in the cart, drop anything whose availability the inventory records do not confirm, and limit the set shown to the number the merchant's placement allows. Return a recommendation matrix and offer copy, checking every pairing against the supplied compatibility records for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: What makes a pairing compatible?
faqs.answer: A relationship recorded in the compatibility notes or a shared use the merchant has documented, such as an accessory listed for that product. A pairing with no record behind it is excluded even when the two items look related, because the matrix has to stay defensible when a shopper asks why the item was offered.

faqs.question: Should the cheapest complement come first?
faqs.answer: No. Compatibility and availability decide the set, and price only orders within it, following the price relationship the merchant states for the cart item. Leading with the lowest price tends to surface small accessories that add little to the purchase and push the genuinely useful pairing off the placement.

faqs.question: What happens when stock runs low?
faqs.answer: The item leaves the set once the inventory records show it is not purchasable, and the row records the reason and the restock date where the merchant keeps one. Recommending something that cannot be bought creates a dead end just as the shopper was ready to add it, which is worse than an empty slot.

zh_howToSolve: 先收集在案的商品关联关系与兼容性说明、每个候选商品的类目与价格带、各商品的库存状态、当前购物车的内容，以及商家打算展示推荐的版位。再筛选互补品，只保留兼容性记录支持该组合、核查时点可正常购买、且尚未出现在购物车中的商品，剔除库存记录无法确认可售的商品，并把展示数量控制在商家为该版位设定的上限内。最后输出推荐矩阵与推荐文案，每个组合都附上支持它的兼容性记录并直白说明该商品带来的额外价值，同时确认每件推荐商品在核查时仍可购买，且矩阵覆盖了商家指定的每个购物车商品。

zh_faqs.question: 什么样的组合才算兼容？
zh_faqs.answer: 兼容性说明中有记录的关系，或商家已记录的共同用途，例如某商品明确列出的配件。即使两件商品看起来相关，只要背后没有记录就排除，因为当顾客问起为什么推荐这件时，推荐矩阵必须站得住脚。

zh_faqs.question: 应优先推荐最便宜的互补品吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不应该。兼容性与可售状态决定入选集合，价格只在集合内部排序，并遵循商家为购物车商品设定的价格关系。一味从最低价排起，往往把价值不大的小配件顶到前面，反而把真正有用的组合挤出推荐位。

zh_faqs.question: 库存不足时会怎样？
zh_faqs.answer: 一旦库存记录显示该商品不可购买，它就退出推荐集合，并在该行注明原因，以及商家有记录时的补货日期。在顾客正准备加购时推荐买不到的商品，等于制造死路，这比推荐位空着更糟。

title: Recommend appropriate product upgrades
scenarioDescription: A shopper is choosing inside a product with several tiers, and the merchant wants the upgrade offered only where it is a real step up. In this case, the immediate task is to recommend appropriate product upgrades. The workflow should produce a recommendation matrix and offer copy naming the variant, price and stock record behind each upgrade rule.
howToSolve: Gather the product's variant and tier structure with the option values behind it, the price and inventory state of each tier, the differences recorded between tiers such as capacity, materials or included items, and the tier the shopper has currently selected. Offer the next tier only where it adds a difference the shopper plausibly needs, its inventory records show it can be supplied and the price step is one the merchant has accepted, suppress it where the higher tier only raises the price with no recorded difference, and never present a tier the records show as unavailable. Deliver a recommendation matrix and offer copy naming the variant, price and stock record behind each upgrade rule, then confirm that each recommended tier resolves to a live variant, that the originally selected tier stays selectable, and that every suppressed rule carries the reason it was held back.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me recommend appropriate product upgrades. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the product's variant and tier structure with its option values, the price and inventory state of each tier, the differences recorded between tiers such as capacity, materials or included items, and the tier the shopper has currently selected]. Offer the next tier only where it adds a difference the shopper plausibly needs, its inventory records show it can be supplied and the price step is one the merchant has accepted, suppress it where the higher tier only raises the price with no recorded difference, and never present a tier the records show as unavailable. Return a recommendation matrix and offer copy, listing the rules and the records behind each one for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Should the top tier always be offered?
faqs.answer: No. The rule offers the next tier that adds a difference the shopper plausibly needs, because the top tier is often a price jump the shopper did not come for and can stall the purchase. The highest tier still appears in the matrix with the reason it was skipped, so the choice stays visible.

faqs.question: What if the next tier is out of stock?
faqs.answer: The rule is suppressed and recorded with the inventory record behind that decision, and no tier the merchant did not name is substituted. Where a lower tier is available and still a real step up, it can be offered under its own rule, but an unavailable tier is never shown with a promise to restock.

faqs.question: Does the upgrade replace the shopper's choice?
faqs.answer: No. It is presented alongside the selected tier, which stays selectable, so the shopper keeps control and the change list records both options. Replacing the choice turns a suggestion into a substitution, and the merchant loses the ability to tell whether the upgrade was wanted or merely accepted by default.

zh_title: 为顾客推荐合适的商品升级选项
zh_scenarioDescription: 顾客正在多档位商品中挑选，商家希望只在真正构成提升时才推荐升级。此时的首要任务是为顾客推荐合适的商品升级选项。流程应说明每条升级规则背后的变体结构、价格与库存依据，产出推荐矩阵与推荐文案。
zh_howToSolve: 先收集商品的变体与档位结构及其选项取值、每个档位的价格与库存状态、档位之间记录在案的差异（如容量、材质或随附内容），以及顾客当前选中的档位。再判断是否推荐：只有当更高档位带来顾客可能确实需要的差异、库存记录显示可以供货、且价格跨度在商家已接受的范围内时才推荐；若更高档位只是涨价而没有任何记录在案的差异则抑制推荐，且绝不展示记录显示为不可售的档位。最后输出推荐矩阵与推荐文案，写明每条升级规则背后的变体、价格与库存记录，并确认每个被推荐的档位都能解析到在线变体、顾客原先选中的档位仍可选择，且每条被抑制的规则都写明了原因。
zh_aiPrompt:
你是一名 Shopify 运营专家。请帮我处理「shopify upsell app」这一问题，所属方向为「加购与交叉销售」。

店铺背景：[填写品类、目标市场、目标客群]
处理范围：[填写商品、页面、客户、活动或日期范围]
可提供的数据：[填写已有资料]

请按以下方式工作：
1. 先说明完成该任务需要哪些关键数据，并标记缺失项。
2. 再判断是否推荐：只有当更高档位带来顾客可能确实需要的差异、库存记录显示可以供货、且价格跨度在商家已接受的范围内时才推荐；若更高档位只是涨价而没有任何记录在案的差异则抑制推荐，且绝不展示记录显示为不可售的档位。
3. 输出问题判断、建议方案、优先级、所需人工确认事项和验证方法。
4. 所有商品属性、指标、客户信息和营销结论必须以我提供的数据为依据；没有证据时请明确写“待确认”，不要猜测。
5. 如涉及发布、发信、改价、修改商品或账户操作，在我明确授权且工具已连接前，仅输出草案或操作步骤；完成操作后再报告已验证的结果。

zh_faqs.question: 是否总该推荐最高档位？
zh_faqs.answer: 不是。规则只推荐能带来顾客可能确实需要的差异的下一个档位，因为最高档往往是顾客并未预期的价格跳跃，反而会让购买停滞。最高档仍会出现在矩阵中并注明被跳过的原因，让这个取舍始终可见。

zh_faqs.question: 下一个档位缺货怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 抑制该规则，并附上作出该判断的库存记录，同时不替换成商家未指定过的档位。若有更低的档位可售且仍构成真实提升，可以另立一条规则推荐；但绝不展示不可售档位并附带补货承诺。

zh_faqs.question: 升级选项会取代顾客已选的商品吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不会。它与顾客已选档位并列呈现，原档位保持可选，让顾客始终掌握决定权，变更清单也会同时记录两个选项。取代顾客的选择等于把建议变成替顾客做主，商家也就无法分辨顾客是真想要升级还是默认接受了。

title: Plan a measurable customer retention initiative
scenarioDescription: Several retention ideas compete for the same team capacity, and no one has said which one answers the gap visible in the records. In this case, the immediate task is to plan a measurable customer retention initiative. The workflow should produce a retention plan and evaluation framework with success measures and a review point agreed before rollout.
howToSolve: Pull the repeat-purchase records that show where customers stop returning, the cancellation and refund reasons recorded on those orders, the size of each affected group, and the staff and budget the team can commit to a single initiative. Choose the one gap the records support most strongly and scope the initiative to a single customer group with a start date, a comparison group held out of the treatment, and success measures taken from the merchant's own records rather than from the app dashboard. Deliver the retention plan and evaluation framework with the review date fixed before rollout, then confirm the target group can be rebuilt from the records on that date and note each assumption the result will depend on.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me plan a measurable customer retention initiative. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [repeat-purchase records, recorded cancellation and refund reasons, the size of each affected group, and committed staff and budget]. Choose the one gap the records support most strongly and scope the initiative to a single customer group with a start date, a comparison group held out of the treatment, and success measures taken from the merchant's own records rather than from the app dashboard. Return a retention plan and evaluation framework for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why hold out a comparison group?
faqs.answer: Without one, any improvement is read against the previous period, which moves for seasonal and assortment reasons; the held-out group stays untouched by the initiative and is measured on the same dates, and when it is too small to compare, the result is reported as a direction rather than a size.

faqs.question: When should the review date fall?
faqs.answer: At least one full repurchase cycle after launch, so the measure has time to register behaviour rather than immediate reaction; interim checks cover delivery and participation only, and moving the review date afterwards is recorded as a change to the plan.

faqs.question: What if the app reports a different figure?
faqs.answer: The dashboard may count members, orders or revenue on its own definitions, so the plan fixes one definition and reconciles it to the merchant's records; where the two cannot be reconciled, the record-based figure drives the decision and the difference is noted.

zh_title: 规划一项可衡量的客户留存举措
zh_scenarioDescription: 多个留存设想在争夺同一批人力，却没人指出哪个针对的是记录中真正存在的缺口。本场景的任务是规划一项可衡量的客户留存举措，产出留存计划与评估框架，并在启动前先约定衡量口径与复核时点。
zh_howToSolve: 调取复购记录以定位客户停止回头的环节，连同该批订单上记录的取消与退款原因、受影响客群的实际规模，以及团队能为单一举措投入的人力与预算。选定记录支持最强的一处缺口，把举措限定在一个客群，设定启动日期、不参与处理的对照组，以及取自商家自有记录而非应用看板的成效指标。交付留存计划与评估框架并在启动前固定复核日期，同时确认届时可依据记录重建目标客群，并注明结论所依赖的假设。

5. 如涉及发布、发信、改价、修改商品或账户操作，在我明确授权且工具已连接前，仅输出草案或操作步骤；完成操作后再报告已验证的结果。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要留出对照组？
zh_faqs.answer: 没有对照组就只能与上一周期比较，而上一周期的变化常来自季节和商品结构；对照组不参与举措并在同一日期计量，样本太小时结论只报方向、不报幅度。

zh_faqs.question: 复核日期应定在什么时候？
zh_faqs.answer: 至少在启动后一个完整复购周期，使指标有时间反映行为而非即时反应；期间只检查触达与参与情况，启动后再改动复核日期须作为计划变更记录。

zh_faqs.question: 应用看板与记录数字不一致怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 看板对会员、订单与收入的统计口径可能不同，因此计划只固定一套口径并与商家记录对账；两者无法对齐时以记录口径用于决策，并注明差异所在。

title: Build a lifecycle email sequence with entry and exit rules
scenarioDescription: Welcome, browse abandonment and post-purchase flows overlap, so one person can receive three messages in a day and none the following week. In this case, the immediate task is to build a lifecycle email sequence with entry and exit rules. The workflow should produce an email automation map and test scenarios covering duplicate events and shifting states.
howToSolve: Gather the event definitions with the properties each one carries, the segment rules, the approved messages, the eligibility conditions that admit a customer, and the suppression list already honoured across channels. Map each entry trigger to its wait, its branch and its exit, resolve what happens when a customer qualifies for two flows on the same day through a written precedence order, and test duplicate events to confirm one customer cannot be enrolled twice for the same event. Deliver the lifecycle map with test scenarios covering a duplicate event, a state change mid-flow and a suppressed contact, then verify each scenario against the supplied records and list any branch with no defined exit.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me build a lifecycle email sequence with entry and exit rules. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [event definitions with their properties, segment rules, approved messages, eligibility conditions, and the cross-channel suppression list]. Map each entry trigger to its wait, its branch and its exit, resolve what happens when a customer qualifies for two flows on the same day through a written precedence order, and test duplicate events to confirm one customer cannot be enrolled twice for the same event. Return an email automation map and test scenarios for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is a same-day double qualification resolved?
faqs.answer: A precedence order written into the map decides which flow holds the customer while the other records the hold; the held flow may resume only if the customer still qualifies once the first ends, so the overlap produces one message rather than two.

faqs.question: What does a state change mid-flow require?
faqs.answer: Re-evaluation at the next wait point against both the entry and the exit conditions, since the customer who entered may no longer match; messages already queued are cancelled rather than sent late, and the cancellation shows in the contact history.

faqs.question: How is suppression applied across channels?
faqs.answer: The suppression list is checked at send time, not only at entry, because consent can change while a customer waits inside a flow; opting out of one channel does not remove consent for another unless the merchant's policy says it does.

zh_scenarioDescription: 欢迎、浏览未购买和购后跟进的序列彼此重叠，同一位客户可能在一天内收到三封邮件，下一周却一封都没有。本场景的任务是搭建带进入与退出规则的生命周期邮件序列，产出邮件自动化地图与测试场景，覆盖重复事件与客户状态变化。
zh_howToSolve: 收集各事件定义及其携带属性、分群规则、已审批邮件内容、准入条件，以及已跨渠道生效的抑制名单。为每个进入触发条件写明等待时长、分支与退出条件，对同一天同时符合两条流程的客户按书面优先级裁定归属，并测试重复事件，确认同一事件不会让客户两次进入。交付生命周期地图与覆盖重复事件、流程中途状态变化和被抑制联系人的测试场景，逐条对照所提供记录核验，并列出任何未定义退出条件的分支。

zh_faqs.question: 同一天同时符合两条流程怎么定？
zh_faqs.answer: 由写进地图的优先级决定归属，另一条流程记录为暂挂；只有第一条结束后客户仍符合条件才可恢复，使重叠情形只产生一条消息而不是两条。

zh_faqs.question: 流程中途状态变化要做什么？
zh_faqs.answer: 在下一个等待点重新对照进入与退出条件，因为已进入的客户可能不再符合；已排队的消息取消而不延后发送，取消动作在客户发送历史中可见。

zh_faqs.question: 抑制名单如何跨渠道生效？
zh_faqs.answer: 在发送时校验而不只在进入时校验，因为客户在流程内等待期间同意状态可能变化；除非商家政策另有规定，退出某一渠道不等于解除其他渠道的同意。

title: Personalize email messages using supported customer context
scenarioDescription: The store wants tailored messages, but coverage of the fields behind each personalisation rule differs. In this case, the immediate task is to personalize email messages using supported customer context. The workflow should produce an email automation map and test scenarios, using only attributes the merchant's records hold and a stated fallback.
howToSolve: List the customer fields the store actually holds, the source and last-updated date of each, how much of the audience carries a value, and the rules the merchant has approved for using each field in a message. Personalise only where a field holds a value and an approved rule covers it, write fallback text for every personalised line so it reads correctly when the value is missing, and keep any inferred attribute out of the copy until it is confirmed against the record. Deliver the automation map with test scenarios for a complete record, a partial record and a contradicting record, then verify that every personalised line renders its fallback rather than a blank and that no message exposes a field the merchant has not approved.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me personalize email messages using supported customer context. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [customer fields actually held with source and last-updated date, field coverage across the audience, approved personalisation rules, and required fallback text]. Personalise only where a field holds a value and an approved rule covers it, write fallback text for every personalised line so it reads correctly when the value is missing, and keep any inferred attribute out of the copy until it is confirmed against the record. Return an email automation map and test scenarios for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: How is field coverage checked before personalising?
faqs.answer: Count the customers holding a non-empty value at the time of build, because a line that is empty for most of the audience is not personalisation; a low-coverage field is used only inside the segments where it is populated, with the fallback carrying the rest.

faqs.question: Can an inferred preference be used in copy?
faqs.answer: Not until it is confirmed against the record, since an inference presented as a stated fact is wrong for every customer it misreads; it may select which approved message a segment receives, but it may not appear in the wording as something the customer told the store.

faqs.question: What should the fallback text avoid?
faqs.answer: Naming the missing value, apologising for it, or reading like an error, all of which make the message feel automated; the fallback is a complete sentence that still holds once the field is filled in, so one message serves both cases.

zh_faqs.question: 个性化前如何检查字段覆盖？
zh_faqs.answer: 统计构建时该字段有非空取值的客户数，因为对多数人都是空白的句子算不上个性化；覆盖偏低的字段只在其有值的分群里使用，其余由兜底文案承担。

zh_faqs.question: 推断出的偏好能写进文案吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 在对照记录确认之前不能，因为把推断当作客户陈述的事实，对被误判的客户就是错的；它可以决定哪个分群收到哪封已审批邮件，但不能以客户自述的口吻出现在正文里。

zh_faqs.question: 兜底文案要避免什么？
zh_faqs.answer: 不要点出缺失的取值、不要为此致歉，也不要读起来像报错，这些都会让邮件显得机械；兜底应是一句完整的话，在字段有值时同样成立，从而一套文案覆盖两种情况。

title: Define useful post-purchase follow-up messages
scenarioDescription: Customers receive one follow-up message whether their order is being packed, shipped or already delivered. In this case, the immediate task is to define useful post-purchase follow-up messages. The workflow should produce an email automation map and test scenarios, assigning onboarding, delivery and retention messages to the recorded order stage.

Assign each message to the stage it serves, sending onboarding while the item is still in transit, delivery follow-up once the carrier records handover, and retention contact only after the stated post-delivery window, and treat any order whose stage cannot be resolved from the records as ineligible rather than guessing. Deliver an email automation map and test scenarios naming the stage, trigger, timing and stop rule for every message, then reconcile the message count against the order stage export and list each order left unassigned with the field that blocked it.

zh_faqs.answer: 按包裹分别发送，并写明该包裹内含的商品，因为顾客只收到一半订单时若收到订单已完成的通知会立即误解；订单级汇总消息保持静默，除非每个包裹都到达同一事件，这一点需对照履约记录确认。

zh_faqs.question: 事件乱序到达时如何处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 消息以事件类型和包裹为键，迟到的较早事件不会重复播报收件人已知悉的状态，因为按接收时间排序会产生倒退式的更新；签收事件始终覆盖在其之后才到达的投递尝试事件。

faqs.question: Which delivery states can carry a message?
faqs.answer: Only the states the store can prove with evidence from the carrier, typically acceptance, delivery attempt and delivery, since a message on an unconfirmed state promises movement that may never happen; a state with no evidence rule in the specification is dropped rather than sent on trust.

faqs.question: Why not send on the label event?
faqs.answer: A label only means the parcel was prepared, not that the carrier holds it, so announcing dispatch there tells the customer to expect tracking that does not exist yet; the trigger is the carrier acceptance event, and the label event is recorded for internal use only.

faqs.question: How are repeated scans handled?
faqs.answer: Each order records the delivery messages it has already been sent and a repeated scan of the same state sends nothing, because duplicate delivery notices are the most common complaint about shipping automation; a genuinely new state always sends, so a failed attempt followed by a delivery produces two messages.

zh_faqs.question: 哪些配送状态可以发送消息？
zh_faqs.answer: 只有店铺能拿出承运商证据的状态才可以，通常是揽收、投递尝试和已签收，因为在未确认的状态上发消息等于承诺一个可能不会发生的运输动作；规格中没有证据规则的状态一律删除，而不是凭信任发送。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么不在打单事件时发送？
zh_faqs.answer: 打单只说明包裹已备好，并不代表承运商已经拿到，此时发出发货通知会让顾客去查一条还不存在的轨迹；触发条件应为承运商揽收事件，打单事件只作内部记录。

zh_faqs.question: 重复的扫描如何处理？
zh_faqs.answer: 每笔订单记录已发送过的配送消息，同一状态的重复扫描不再发送，因为重复的送达通知是物流自动化中最常见的投诉来源；真正的新状态一定会发送，因此投递失败后再签收会产生两条消息。

faqs.question: Can the copy mention products the customer never bought?
faqs.answer: Only as a clearly separated suggestion and only where the merchant's offer rules permit it; the default is to reference the recorded purchase, because inventing a preference is a claim the records cannot support and cannot be defended if the customer challenges it.

faqs.question: What if a customer has no usable purchase context?
faqs.answer: They receive a neutral version that references the store rather than a product and they are listed as context-missing instead of being given a guessed product, so the weaker copy is traceable to a data gap rather than hidden inside the results.

faqs.question: How is the last contact date used?
faqs.answer: It decides whether the customer is due another message under the merchant's cadence and keeps the copy from opening as though the store had never been in touch; a customer contacted recently is held back however strong the draft is.

Rehearse the design against a normal event, a repeated event and a failed event, recording for each what the workflow did, what it wrote and whether it stopped where it should, and mark any branch with no defined behaviour as a gap. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why rehearse a repeated event separately?
faqs.answer: The same trigger often fires twice for one real event, and a workflow without an idempotency check applies its action twice. The rehearsal shows whether the second run is detected and skipped.

faqs.question: What belongs in an acceptance check?
faqs.answer: A condition observable in the store afterwards, such as a field holding the expected value or a log row written. Vague checks let a broken run pass unnoticed.

faqs.question: Should the automation run on every matching record at once?
faqs.answer: Only after a single-record run passes its acceptance check. Starting wide turns a design mistake into a store-wide correction that then needs rollback.

title: Connect operational triggers with clearly scoped actions

The workflow should enumerate the available triggers and permitted actions, then bound each connection to intended records and stop it on failure.
howToSolve: Enumerate the triggers available, the fields each one carries, the actions each may start and the accounts or apps holding the permissions those actions need. Bound every trigger-to-action connection by naming the records it may read and write and the conditions that must hold, refuse any run reaching outside that boundary, and require the workflow to stop at the failing step rather than continue on a state never reached. Deliver the trigger-to-action map with each connection's scope, stop condition and the version of both sides, then run one live event per connection and confirm the written records match the declared scope and nothing outside it changed.

faqs.question: How is a connection kept away from the wrong records?
faqs.answer: By naming the records it may read and write plus the condition that must hold, and by refusing the run otherwise. A connection allowed to touch anything is one template change away from editing the wrong part of the catalog.

faqs.question: Should the workflow continue after a failed action?
faqs.answer: Stop at the failing step and report it. Later steps would act on a state that was never reached, producing records that look valid but rest on a step that never happened.

faqs.question: Why record trigger and action versions per run?
faqs.answer: Either side can change without notice, and the pairing explains why yesterday's run behaved differently. Without versions the difference cannot be reproduced.

zh_faqs.question: 如何避免连接误操作到不该碰的记录？
zh_faqs.answer: 写明允许读写的记录范围与必须成立的条件，不满足就拒绝执行。允许触碰一切的连接，只差一次模板改动就会改错目录数据。

zh_faqs.question: 动作失败后工作流应继续吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 应在失败步骤停止并上报。继续执行会让后续步骤作用于从未达成的状态，产出的记录看似有效，实则建立在一次从未发生的步骤之上。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么每次运行都要记录触发器与动作的版本？
zh_faqs.answer: 任一侧都可能在无通知的情况下变更，版本配对能解释昨天运行行为不同的原因。没有版本号，这种差异将无法复现。

faqs.question: How are incomplete source records handled?

faqs.question: What does draft verification compare?
faqs.answer: Each created draft is compared with its source record field by field, not just spot-checked. This catches mapping drift, where a field lands in the wrong place while validation still passes. A single mismatch invalidates the mapping for that whole record type.

faqs.question: When can created drafts move toward publication?
faqs.answer: Only after sample verification passes and the merchant approves the mapping. Publishing directly removes the review step that catches mapping errors and incomplete records. Approval covers the record types tested, so a new source type needs re-verification.

zh_faqs.question: 生成的草稿何时可以走向发布？

faqs.question: How is a duplicate run detected after go-live?
faqs.answer: Each trigger event carries a run identifier checked before any edit applies, so replaying the event changes nothing. This is the idempotence that keeps reruns from writing the same change twice. Triggers arriving without an identifier are held rather than executed.

faqs.question: What does the failure log need to capture?
faqs.answer: The product, the rule, the failure reason, the timestamp and the prior value for every failed or skipped item. Silent gaps otherwise read as successful updates. Failed items are retried only through a new run that reuses the same rollback record.

faqs.question: How is a run rolled back?
faqs.answer: Prior values are restored from the rollback record for exactly the products listed in that run's log, which bounds the blast radius. A product edited more than once needs its earliest prior value, so the value chain is checked before restoring. Anything outside the log is untouched.

faqs.question: What proves the test pass before the full run?
faqs.answer: The diff of the first batch against the snapshot, showing only the intended fields changed on only the intended products. The full run will repeat exactly that behaviour, so unintended changes scale with it. Any diff outside the plan cancels the schedule.

faqs.question: How is batch order decided?
faqs.answer: Related products are grouped so an error stays isolated inside one batch that can be reviewed and reversed on its own. The order is written into the plan before the window opens. Order improvised at run time defeats the isolation the batching was built for.

faqs.question: How is the final edit verified?
faqs.answer: The edited count must equal the in-scope count minus exclusions, each changed value must match the plan's new value, and untouched fields must be identical to the snapshot. A count mismatch means something ran outside the plan. Mismatches trigger a rollback review, not a patch.

faqs.question: What happens when the signal is stale or missing?

zh_faqs.question: 自动改动事后如何追溯？
zh_faqs.answer: 运行日志按商品记录信号值、条件判定结果、改动前值与新值。正是这条链路把日后的疑点变成可核查的事实。发现无日志的改动按错误处理并恢复原值。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么要在方案中列未确认输入？

Map the dependencies between steps so every handoff carries a trigger, a completion check that can be tested and a defined failure path, marking as manual any step whose output the merchant still has to approve before it reaches a customer. faqs.question: Which tasks should be connected first?
faqs.answer: The recurring ones with a clear trigger and a testable output, such as audience refresh, content assembly and reporting. Starting with a step whose output nobody can verify gives you automation that fails silently.

faqs.question: What happens when one step fails?
faqs.answer: Define the fallback in advance, whether it retries, blocks the later steps or routes the failure to a named owner. A workflow without a failure path leaves a campaign half sent with no record of where it stopped.

faqs.question: Can the workflow send without approval?
faqs.answer: Not for anything customer-facing. Keep a review point wherever the workflow publishes or sends on the merchant's behalf, and log who approved each send so the record shows a person was accountable.

zh_faqs.question: 某个环节执行失败时怎么办？

zh_faqs.question: 工作流可以未经审批直接发送吗？

title: Automate blog publishing after required checks
scenarioDescription: Posts go live without a consistent check, so incomplete entries and unapproved drafts reach the blog. In this case, the immediate task is to automate blog publishing after required checks. The output should hold anything missing fields or approval and log every check with the resulting publication state.
howToSolve: Collect the post sources with their identifiers, the required-field list together with the rule that decides whether a field is complete, the approval records showing which drafts were cleared, the key used to detect a duplicate such as the handle or title, the destination blog and author, the access the publisher runs under, and each item's last published state so a repeat run can be told from a first publication. Run the checks in one fixed order before anything publishes, holding an item whose required fields are incomplete or whose approval is missing, marking as a suspected duplicate any item whose duplicate key matches an existing post, and recording for every item the check name, the result, the timestamp and the identifier of the run that produced it. Deliver a content workflow and a sample output batch logging every check, every failure and the resulting publication state for each item, then reconcile the published count against the merchant's post list, confirm no item carries two published entries from one run, and confirm every held item names the check that blocked it and the condition that releases it.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [post sources with their identifiers, the required-field list and completeness rule, approval records showing which drafts were cleared, the duplicate-check key such as handle or title, the destination blog and author, publisher access scope, and each item's last published state]. Run the checks in one fixed order before anything publishes, holding an item whose required fields are incomplete or whose approval is missing, marking as a suspected duplicate any item whose duplicate key matches an existing post, and recording for every item the check name, the result, the timestamp and the identifier of the run that produced it. Return a content workflow and sample output batch logging every check, failure and resulting publication state for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Which fields must be complete before a post can publish?
faqs.answer: The merchant supplies the required-field list and the rule for completeness, covering the fields a post cannot ship without, and every one of them is checked before publication. Completeness is judged by content and not by presence, so a field holding a placeholder fails; any field the sources cannot fill blocks the item rather than being skipped.

faqs.question: How is a duplicate post detected before publication?
faqs.answer: Posts are compared on the key the merchant names, usually the handle or the title, against the existing post list before publication. A match holds the item for review instead of publishing it, because a duplicate handle is treated as the same address; near-matches differing only in punctuation are reported as suspected duplicates for a person to decide.

faqs.question: Can a failed publish be retried safely?
faqs.answer: A retry is safe only when the run recorded the state before publishing and the failure is visible in that log. The item stays unpublished until the check passes, and the log shows whether the earlier attempt reached the blog; if it did, the merchant's records decide whether to edit the existing post instead of publishing a second copy.

title: Generate advertising creatives from a repeatable brief
scenarioDescription: Creative is needed for many products and channels, and comparing the results only works if every request runs through one documented brief. In this case, the immediate task is to generate advertising creatives from a repeatable brief. The workflow should return the creatives with the filled brief attached and flag any field the merchant's records left empty.
howToSolve: Fix the brief template first with one field for each product fact, audience, offer, format, tone and approval rule, and fill it from the merchant's product, offer and channel records rather than from the previous run's output. Run every request through the same template and the same step order so two runs differ only in their inputs, and stop the run at any empty field instead of filling it from a similar product or an earlier campaign. Deliver each generated creative with its filled brief attached and every unresolved field flagged with the record needed to fill it, then reconcile the number of creatives produced with the number of products and channels requested and confirm that no creative shipped with a flagged field still open.

Run every request through the same template and the same step order so two runs differ only in their inputs, and stop the run at any empty field instead of filling it from a similar product or an earlier campaign. Return the generated creatives with the filled brief attached and any field the supplied records left empty flagged for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. faqs.question: Why fill the brief from records rather than the last run?
faqs.answer: A brief copied from the previous run inherits that product's claims and offer, which is how an expired promotion reaches a new creative; filling from the current product and offer records keeps each run independent and auditable.

faqs.question: What should an empty brief field produce?
faqs.answer: A flag naming the record needed, never a guessed value, because the whole point of the template is that two runs stay comparable, and a guessed field silently breaks that comparison while looking complete.

faqs.question: How is output compared across products and channels?
faqs.answer: By the brief, since identical step order and identical fields make any difference in the creatives traceable to an input; where two runs used different fields, the outputs are marked non-comparable rather than ranked.

faqs.question: What qualifies as a lifecycle moment worth automating?

faqs.question: What should an automated flow do at its end?

faqs.question: Why show the last refresh time?

zh_faqs.answer: 不应。零表示确实没有发生，不可用表示什么都没采集到，两者混用会完全掩盖一次失败的采集。缺失值保留自己的标注，报表还需说明该周期是哪个数据源没有交付。

zh_faqs.question: 分发名单上应有哪些人？
zh_faqs.answer: 会依据这些数字采取行动、并且能说清自己会做什么的人。名单过宽会分散注意力，每多一位从不响应的收件人，都会拖慢那个本可及时行动的人；责任人变更时应重新审视名单。

title: Prepare scheduled report delivery after successful refreshes
scenarioDescription: Scheduled report emails go out even when the collection behind them has failed, so recipients receive half-filled numbers. In this case, the immediate task is to prepare scheduled report delivery after successful refreshes. The workflow should produce an automation specification and sample report structure noting each dependency and fallback action.
howToSolve: Collect the recipients and their roles, the delivery cadence and send time, the report formats and attachment limits accepted by the mail system, and the refresh and validation steps each send depends on with their expected completion times. Gate every send on a successful refresh and a passed validation so no delivery publishes an incomplete collection, holding the send when a dependency fails and triggering the fallback action stated for that dependency instead of releasing the previous figures as if they were current. Deliver the automation specification and sample report structure noting each dependency and fallback action, then verify by checking a recent send against the run log, confirming that the attachment passed validation before release, that failures notified the owner with a reason and that no recipient received a report built on a failed refresh.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me prepare scheduled report delivery after successful refreshes. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [recipients and their roles, delivery cadence and send time, accepted report formats and attachment limits, and the refresh and validation steps each send depends on with expected completion times]. Gate every send on a successful refresh and a passed validation so no delivery publishes an incomplete collection, holding the send when a dependency fails and triggering the fallback action stated for that dependency instead of releasing the previous figures as if they were current. Return an automation specification and sample report structure noting each dependency and fallback action for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Should delivery wait for a refresh?
faqs.answer: Yes, and for the validation that follows it. A send released early publishes figures from a collection that never finished, and recipients cannot tell the difference because the message looks exactly like a complete one, only with lower numbers.

faqs.question: What follows a failed refresh on send day?
faqs.answer: The send is held and the owner receives the failure reason and the affected period, rather than a report repeating last period's figures behind a current date. Recipients get a short note saying no report is coming and why.

faqs.question: How much detail belongs in the email body?
faqs.answer: Enough to interpret the attachment: period covered, refresh time, any provisional period and the main movement. The full structure stays in the file, so the body never becomes a second copy that drifts from the attachment after the first edit.

zh_category: 数据采集与报表自动化

zh_scenarioDescription: 即便后台采集已经失败，定时报表邮件照样会发出去，收件人拿到的数字并不完整。本场景中，当前任务是在刷新成功后安排报表定时投递。该流程应基于商家的实际记录与约束，产出自动化规格说明与样例报表结构，注明每个依赖环节与兜底处理方式。
zh_howToSolve: 收集收件人及其角色、投递节奏与发送时间、邮件系统可接受的报表格式与附件大小限制，以及每次发送所依赖的刷新与校验步骤及其预期完成时间。把每次发送都设为以刷新成功且校验通过为前提，确保采集不完整时不会发布报表；依赖环节失败时暂停发送，并执行为该环节设定的兜底处理方式，而不是把上一次的数字当作最新结果发出去。交付自动化规格说明与样例报表结构，注明每个依赖环节与兜底处理方式，并通过把最近一次发送与运行日志比对来验证：附件在发布前已通过校验、失败时已把原因通知负责人、且没有收件人收到基于失败刷新生成的报表。

zh_faqs.question: 投递是否应等待刷新完成？
zh_faqs.answer: 应该，而且要等随之而来的校验也通过。提前发出的邮件会发布来自一次并未跑完的采集的数字，而收件人无法分辨，因为这封邮件看上去与完整的那封完全一样，只是数字偏低。

zh_faqs.question: 投递当天刷新失败应如何处置？
zh_faqs.answer: 暂停发送，并把失败原因与受影响的周期通知负责人，而不是发出一份顶着当天日期、内容却是上一周期数字的报表。收件人应收到一句简短说明，告知本期报表不发及原因。

zh_faqs.question: 邮件正文中应包含多少信息？
zh_faqs.answer: 足以正确解读附件即可：覆盖周期、刷新时间、是否存在暂定周期以及主要变化。完整结构仍保留在附件文件中，这样正文不会变成另一份副本，并在第一次修改后就与附件脱节。

title: Monitor operational KPIs against defined baselines
scenarioDescription: Numbers get pulled ad hoc on request, so the team never knows whether the KPIs are drifting. In this case, the immediate task is to monitor operational KPIs against defined baselines. The workflow should fix KPI definitions, baseline period and cadence up front, then compare every current value with its own baseline and flag gaps needing action.
howToSolve: Record each KPI in scope with its calculation definition, the source export or report it is read from, the baseline period chosen and the review cadence assigned to it. Compare every current value against its own baseline using that fixed definition, mark the direction and size of the gap, and mark a KPI unmeasurable rather than flat when its source holds no value for the period. Deliver a monitoring sheet with one row per KPI carrying its current value, baseline, gap, threshold, owner and next review date, then reconcile the extracted values against the source exports and list any KPI whose definition changed since the last cycle.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me monitor operational KPIs against defined baselines. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the KPI list with each definition, the source export or report it is read from, the baseline period, the threshold, the owner and the assigned review cadence]. Compare every current value against its own baseline using that fixed definition, mark the direction and size of the gap, and mark a KPI unmeasurable rather than flat when its source holds no value for the period. Return a KPI monitoring sheet with thresholds and owners for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why fix the definition before comparing values?
faqs.answer: The same KPI name can be calculated several ways, and a change of definition looks like a change in performance. With the definition fixed, a gap means the store moved rather than the arithmetic.

faqs.question: What if a source has no value for this period?
faqs.answer: Mark the KPI unmeasurable and name the missing source. Carrying the previous value forward would show a flat line that nobody produced.

faqs.question: Should every KPI share one review cadence?
faqs.answer: No. Match the cadence to how fast the metric moves, so a metric that shifts weekly is not watched daily and one that breaks overnight is not reviewed monthly.

zh_title: 对照既定基准监控运营 KPI
zh_scenarioDescription: 指标数据总是在有人过问时才临时拉取，团队从不知道 KPI 是否正在偏离。本场景的任务是对照既定基准监控运营 KPI，先固定口径定义、基准区间与查看节奏，再把每个当前值与自身基准对比，标出需要采取行动的差距。
zh_howToSolve: 先记录纳入范围的每个KPI及其计算口径、读取的来源导出或报表、所选基准区间与分配的查看节奏。再用固定口径把每个当前值与自身基准对比，标注差距方向与大小；当来源在该区间没有数值时标记为无法度量，而不是持平。输出每个KPI一行的监控表，含当前值、基准、差距、阈值、负责人与下次复核日期，再与来源导出对账，并列出上一轮之后口径发生变化的KPI。

3. 输出问题判断、建议方案、优先级、所需人工确认事项和验证方法。
4. 所有商品属性、指标、客户信息和营销结论必须以我提供的数据为依据；没有证据时请明确写“待确认”，不要猜测。
5. 如涉及发布、发信、改价、修改商品或账户操作，在我明确授权且工具已连接前，仅输出草案或操作步骤；完成操作后再报告已验证的结果。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么对比数值前要先固定口径？
zh_faqs.answer: 同一个KPI名称可能有多种算法，口径一变看起来就像业绩变了。口径固定后，出现差距才说明是店铺在变化，而不是算式在变化。

zh_faqs.question: 来源在该区间没有数值怎么办？
zh_faqs.answer: 标记为无法度量并写明缺失的来源。沿用上期数值会画出一条无人真正算出来的持平线。

zh_faqs.question: 所有KPI都该用同一个查看节奏吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 不应如此。节奏要与指标变化速度匹配，按周波动的指标不必每天看，而可能一夜之间出错的指标不能按月才复核。

title: Detect unusual store metrics with sufficient evidence
scenarioDescription: Dashboard numbers wiggle constantly, and the merchant cannot tell a real shift from ordinary noise at low volume. In this case, the immediate task is to detect unusual store metrics with sufficient evidence. The workflow should hold each deviation against the merchant's own baselines and minimum-volume rules until persistence and materiality hold.
howToSolve: Fix the metric definitions, the historical baseline window each metric is measured against and the minimum volume below which a change is treated as noise. Test every deviation against the merchant's stated materiality threshold and its persistence across consecutive periods, and withhold the anomaly label from any deviation failing either test, recording it as ordinary variation instead. Deliver an anomaly summary naming each confirmed metric with its baseline, deviation, period and supporting figures, then re-run the same tests on the previous cycle and confirm the rules would not have flagged that period too.
aiPrompt: Act as a Shopify operations specialist. Help me detect unusual store metrics with sufficient evidence. My store context is [describe the business, products and target audience]. My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [the metric definitions, the historical baseline window for each metric, the minimum volume rule, the merchant's stated materiality threshold and the required persistence across consecutive periods]. Test every deviation against the merchant's stated materiality threshold and its persistence across consecutive periods, and withhold the anomaly label from any deviation failing either test, recording it as ordinary variation instead. Return an anomaly summary with supporting figures and limits for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why does a low-volume metric need its own rule?
faqs.answer: Small counts swing sharply in percentage terms without meaning anything, so a minimum volume stops noise from becoming an alert. Below that volume a metric is reported with raw counts and carries no anomaly claim.

faqs.question: How long must a deviation persist?
faqs.answer: For the number of consecutive periods the merchant sets. A single period can be a timing artefact, while persistence across periods is what separates a real shift from a wobble.

faqs.question: Should a confirmed anomaly name a cause?
faqs.answer: It should name what the evidence supports and leave the rest as hypotheses to check. Attributing a cause without a check turns a measurement into a guess that is hard to retract.

zh_title: 在证据充分的前提下识别异常指标
zh_scenarioDescription: 仪表盘上的数字经常小幅波动，商家分不清哪次摆动是真实变化、哪次只是低销量下的正常噪声。本场景的任务是在证据充分的前提下识别异常指标，把每次偏离放到商家自己的历史基准与最小数据量规则下，检验其持续性与影响量级。
zh_howToSolve: 先固定指标定义、每个指标所对照的历史基准区间，以及低于该数据量即视为噪声的最小数据量规则。再把每个偏离放到商家设定的影响量级阈值与连续周期持续性要求下检验，任一检验不通过的都不贴异常标签，改记为常规波动。输出异常说明，逐个列出已确认指标的基准、偏离幅度、所处区间与支撑数据，再用同一套规则回跑上一周期，确认这些规则不会把该周期也判为异常。

5. 如涉及发布、发信、改价、修改商品或账户操作，在我明确授权且工具已连接前，仅输出草案或操作步骤；完成操作后再报告已验证的结果。

zh_faqs.question: 为什么数据量小的指标要单独定规则？
zh_faqs.answer: 基数小的计数在百分比上会剧烈摆动却毫无意义，因此要用最小数据量把噪声挡在预警之外。低于该数据量时只报原始计数，不做异常判定。

zh_faqs.question: 偏离要持续多久才算数？
zh_faqs.answer: 持续商家设定的连续周期数。单个周期可能只是时点假象，跨周期持续才是真实变化与普通抖动的分界。

zh_faqs.question: 已确认的异常要写明原因吗？
zh_faqs.answer: 只写证据能支撑的部分，其余列为待检验的假设。未经验证就归因，会把一次测量变成难以收回的猜测。

title: Route actionable notifications to relevant owners
scenarioDescription: Alerts fire but land where nobody looks, or flood a channel until the team ignores them. In this case, the immediate task is to route actionable notifications to relevant owners. The workflow should assign each alert type to an accountable person and a channel they actually monitor, with content, repeat and suppression rules drawn from the merchant's setup.
howToSolve: List each alert type with the condition that raises it, the person or team accountable for the response, the channel that person actually monitors and the fallback channel used for escalation. Define for every alert what the message contains, the repeat interval while it stays unacknowledged, and the suppression rule that stops repeats once it is acknowledged, resolved or superseded by a newer alert of the same type. Deliver the routing plan with one row per alert type carrying owner, channel, content, repeat and suppression rules, then send a test message for each row and confirm the delivery record shows it reached the intended channel and owner.

My scope is [specify the affected products, pages, customers or reporting period]. Use these inputs: [each alert type with its raising condition, the accountable person or team, the channel that person monitors, the escalation fallback channel and the merchant's repeat and suppression preferences]. Define for every alert what the message contains, the repeat interval while it stays unacknowledged, and the suppression rule that stops repeats once it is acknowledged, resolved or superseded by a newer alert of the same type. Return a routing plan with owners and escalation rules for the specified task. Show the relevant evidence or before-and-after examples and explain how I can verify the result. If essential data is missing, ask for it and mark unsupported conclusions as unknown. Do not invent metrics, product claims or customer facts. For any publication, message, account or store change, use only connected tools within my explicitly authorized scope and report success only after verification; otherwise provide the draft or proposed steps.

faqs.question: Why route an alert to one owner rather than a shared channel?
faqs.answer: A shared channel leaves the response to whoever happens to look, and often to nobody. Naming an owner makes the next action somebody's job, which is what turns a notification into a fix.

faqs.question: When should an alert stop repeating?
faqs.answer: On acknowledgement or resolution, or when a newer alert of the same type supersedes it. Repeats that continue after acknowledgement teach the team to ignore that alert type entirely.

faqs.question: What should the message body contain?
faqs.answer: The condition that fired, the record affected, the owner and the action expected. A bare number forces the reader back into the dashboard to work out what happened.

zh_scenarioDescription: 预警发了却落在没人看的渠道，或者刷屏到团队干脆屏蔽。本场景的任务是把可执行的通知路由到对应负责人，按预警类型找到真正会看的渠道与责任团队，并明确消息内容、重复与抑制规则。
